idea_en: A causal probing framework based on activation steering for systematically intervening and analyzing internal visual representations in Multimodal Large Language Models.
A method for discriminating between localized memorization of entity concepts and globally distributed encoding of abstract concepts in MLLMs.
A mechanistic explanation of scaling laws revealing that increasing model depth is essential for encoding distributed abstract concepts while entity localization remains scale-invariant.
A reverse steering technique that uncovers a compensatory mechanism between perception and generation by blocking explicit output and detecting latent activation surges.
A diagnostic framework exposing the disconnect between perception and reasoning in MLLMs, where geometric relations are treated as static visual features rather than procedural execution triggers.
idea_ch: 一种基于激活引导的因果探测框架，用于系统性干预和分析多模态大语言模型内部视觉表征。
一种区分多模态大语言模型中实体概念局部记忆化与抽象概念全局分布编码的方法。
一种缩放定律的机制解释方法，揭示模型深度增加对编码分布式抽象概念的必要性，而实体定位对规模不敏感。
一种反向引导技术，通过阻塞显式输出检测潜在激活激增，揭示感知与生成之间的补偿机制。
一种诊断框架，暴露多模态大语言模型在视觉推理中感知与推理的脱节——将几何关系视为静态视觉特征而非触发程序性执行。

title: Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development
comment: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.

AI.tldr: Prober.ai 是一个反传统AI辅导范式的写作平台，通过约束LLM仅生成针对论证弱点的探究式问题，并要求学生在获得修改建议前完成强制性反思，从而保护并促进学生的批判性思维能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在教学中导致学生外包批判性思维，产生认知债务和论证推理能力下降，亟需一种保护认知过程的AI写作辅助系统。
AI.method: 采用"Challenge（挑战）– Unlock（解锁）"两阶段交互架构实现教学摩擦机制；通过人物特定系统提示和结构化JSON输出模式约束LLM仅生成探究式问题；基于Toulmin论证理论、同伴前馈提问机制和AI写作反馈证据进行设计。
AI.result: 在36小时内的NY EdTech Hackathon中开发出功能原型并获第二名。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种可扩展、保护认知的AI写作教育集成方案，通过设计约束而非替代来维护学生批判性思维能力。
idea_en: A two-phase interaction architecture (Challenge and Unlock) for AI-assisted writing that gates revision suggestions behind mandatory student reflection, implementing pedagogical friction to prevent cognitive outsourcing.

Method of constraining LLM output through persona-specific system prompts combined with structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions instead of generated or rewritten text.
A web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm where AI generates questions about argumentative weaknesses rather than providing answers or polished text.
System design grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory for generating AI questions that specifically target argumentative structure weaknesses in student writing.
Prompt engineering methodology for restricting LLM to produce pedagogically aligned JSON-formatted questions that probe specific cognitive gaps in student arguments.
idea_ch: 一种用于AI辅助写作的两阶段交互架构（Challenge-Unlock），将修改建议锁定在学生的强制反思之后，通过教学摩擦机制防止认知外包
将人物特定系统提示与结构化JSON输出模式相结合的方法，约束LLM仅生成针对性的探究式问题而非生成或重写学生文本
颠覆传统AI辅导范式的网页写作环境，AI仅就论证弱点提出问题而非提供答案或润色文本
基于Toulmin论证理论设计AI问题生成机制，专门针对学生写作中论证结构的薄弱环节进行提问
约束LLM生成教育学对齐的JSON格式问题的提示工程方法，用于探测学生论证中的特定认知缺口

title: Text-Graph Synergy: A Bidirectional Verification and Completion Framework for RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a core paradigm for enhancing factual grounding and multi-hop reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional text-based RAG often retrieves logically irrelevant pseudo-evidence, while graph-based RAG is frequently hindered by search-time pruning, which may discard potentially valid reasoning paths. Existing hybrid approaches primarily adopt simple evidence concatenation or unidirectional enhancement, which fails to address the fundamental "Information Island" problem caused by asymmetric reasoning flows between unstructured text and structured graphs. We propose \textbf{TGS-RAG}, a unified framework for \textbf{T}ext-\textbf{G}raph \textbf{S}ynergistic enhancement. TGS-RAG introduces a bidirectional mechanism: (i) a \textbf{Graph-to-Text} channel that employs a Global Voting strategy from visited graph nodes to re-rank and refine textual evidence, filtering out semantic noise; and (ii) a \textbf{Text-to-Graph} channel that utilizes the \textbf{Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging} algorithm. This algorithm utilizes textual cues to proactively resurrect valid but previously pruned reasoning paths from the search history without additional database overhead. Experimental results on multiple multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TGS-RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a superior balance between retrieval precision and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: TGS-RAG是一个统一的文本-图协同增强框架，通过双向机制（图到文本的全局投票重排序 + 文本到图的记忆性孤立实体桥接算法）解决RAG中文本与图结构之间的"信息孤岛"问题，在多跳推理基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统文本RAG检索到逻辑无关的伪证据，图RAG在搜索时剪枝可能丢弃有效推理路径，现有混合方法仅做简单拼接或单向增强，无法解决非结构化文本与结构化图之间不对称推理流导致的"信息孤岛"问题。
AI.method: 提出TGS-RAG统一框架，包含两个双向通道：1) Graph-to-Text通道：通过访问图节点的全局投票策略对文本证据进行重排序和精炼，过滤语义噪声；2) Text-to-Graph通道：使用基于记忆的孤立实体桥接算法，利用文本线索主动从搜索历史中复活已被剪枝但有效的推理路径，无需额外数据库开销。
AI.result: 在多跳推理基准上，TGS-RAG显著优于最先进基线方法，在检索精度和计算效率之间达到了优越平衡。
AI.conclusion: TGS-RAG通过双向文本-图协同增强有效解决了信息孤岛问题，是一种高效且精确的RAG框架。
idea_en: A bidirectional text-graph synergistic enhancement framework (TGS-RAG) for unified retrieval-augmented generation, featuring a Graph-to-Text channel with Global Voting strategy that re-ranks and refines textual evidence by aggregating votes from visited graph nodes to filter semantic noise.

A Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging algorithm for Text-to-Graph channel that proactively resurrects valid but previously pruned reasoning paths from search history using textual cues, without requiring additional database overhead.
A Global Voting mechanism that utilizes graph node visitation information to collectively re-rank textual evidence, improving retrieval precision by eliminating logically irrelevant pseudo-evidence.
A method for addressing the Information Island problem in hybrid RAG by establishing bidirectional asymmetric reasoning flows between unstructured text and structured graphs.
idea_ch: 一种双向文本-图协同增强的统一检索增强生成框架（TGS-RAG），包含图到文本通道，利用已访问图节点的全局投票策略对文本证据进行重排序和精炼，过滤语义噪声。
一种基于记忆的孤立实体桥接算法用于文本到图通道，通过文本线索主动从搜索历史中复活已被剪枝但有效的推理路径，无需额外数据库开销。
一种全局投票机制，利用图节点访问信息对文本证据进行集体重排序，通过消除逻辑无关的伪证据提高检索精度。
一种通过建立非结构化文本与结构化图之间双向不对称推理流来解决混合RAG中信息岛问题的方法。

title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track Submission Under review
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-Agent, a multi-agent framework whose sub-agents are governed by formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors. Our headline contribution is the composition of two previously separate lines of work -- complexity-conditioned LLM routing and formal resource algebras -- yielding a property neither admits alone: provable budget conservation under retrieval-conditioned dynamic topology selection. Concretely we contribute: (1) a complexity-conditioned topology router that reduces proxy-measured misrouting from 30.1% to 8.2%; (2) a budget algebra with a structural-induction conservation theorem; and (3) a hierarchical code retrieval engine. Empirical evaluation demonstrates sub-millisecond DAG construction and linear tree-index scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出检索引导的自适应编排（RGAO），通过层次化代码索引提取结构复杂度向量，动态选择多智能体LLM系统的最佳编排拓扑，并形式化预算守恒定理。
AI.motivation: 现有面向代码生成的多智能体LLM系统在选择编排拓扑时未考虑待修改代码的结构复杂度，导致路由次优，存在根本性的路由问题。
AI.method: (1) 从层次化代码索引中提取结构复杂度向量；(2) 复杂度条件拓扑路由器（将误路由率从30.1%降至8.2%）；(3) 基于形式化合同与六维预算向量的预算代数系统及结构归纳守恒定理；(4) 层次化代码检索引擎。
AI.result: 亚毫秒级DAG构建、线性树索引可扩展性，误路由率从30.1%降至8.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将复杂度条件LLM路由与形式化资源代数两个独立工作流结合，实现了检索条件下动态拓扑选择的预算守恒性质。
idea_en: A complexity-conditioned topology routing method for multi-agent LLM code generation systems, which extracts a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index to dynamically select optimal orchestration topology.
A formal budget algebra system with six-dimensional budget vectors and a structural-induction conservation theorem for governing sub-agent resource allocation in multi-agent frameworks.

A retrieval-guided adaptive orchestration architecture that closes the loop between codebase structural analysis and topology selection, achieving provable budget conservation under retrieval-conditioned dynamic topology selection.
A hierarchical code retrieval engine that constructs complexity vectors for routing decisions in multi-agent code generation systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向多智能体LLM代码生成系统的复杂度条件拓扑路由方法，通过从层次化代码索引中提取结构复杂度向量，动态选择最优编排拓扑。
一种形式化预算代数系统，采用六维预算向量和结构归纳守恒定理，用于多智能体框架中子智能体的资源分配管理。
一种检索引导的自适应编排架构，通过闭环连接代码库结构分析与拓扑选择，在检索条件下实现可证明的动态拓扑选择预算守恒。
一种层次化代码检索引擎，为多智能体代码生成系统的路由决策构建复杂度向量。

title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
summary: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture. Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization. While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework grounded in information theory and geometry to quantify the geometric and entropic nature of residual updates. Applying this unified framework reveals a fundamental functional decoupling: Attention acts as a subspace-preserving operator focused on reconfiguration, whereas FFNs serve as subspace-expanding operators driving semantic innovation. Strikingly, further experiments demonstrate that replacing learned attention weights with predefined values (e.g., Gaussian noise) yields comparable or even superior performance across a majority of datasets relative to vanilla models. These results expose severe misallocation and redundancy in current mechanisms, suggesting that state-of-the-art LVLMs effectively ``get lost in attention'' rather than efficiently leveraging visual context.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个基于信息论和几何学的统一框架，用于量化残差更新模块的几何和熵特性，揭示了注意力机制和FFN在视觉-语言模型中的功能解耦：注意力是子空间保持算子（重配置），FFN是子空间扩展算子（语义创新）。实验发现用预定义值（如高斯噪声）替换学习到的注意力权重，在大多数数据集上性能相当甚至更优，表明当前模型存在严重的注意力冗余和资源错配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏统一的理论基础来分析大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中残差连接Transformer架构内部模块的不同角色，需要一种理论框架来量化注意力机制和前馈网络（FFN）的功能差异。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，基于信息论和几何学量化残差更新的几何和熵特性，分析注意力层和FFN层在子空间保持与扩展方面的作用，并通过替换注意力权重为预定义值（高斯噪声等）进行实验验证。
AI.result: 发现注意力是子空间保持算子（重配置），FFN是子空间扩展算子（语义创新）；用预定义值替换学习到的注意力权重在大多数数据集上表现相当或更优，暴露了注意力的冗余和资源错配。
AI.conclusion: 当前LVLMs存在严重的注意力冗余问题，模型"迷失在注意力中"而非有效利用视觉上下文，为架构优化提供了新方向。
idea_en: A unified information-theoretic and geometric framework for quantifying residual update characteristics in Transformer-based LVLMs, enabling functional decoupling analysis of attention and FFN modules.

An attention mechanism optimization method that replaces learned attention weights with predefined static values (e.g., Gaussian noise) to reduce redundancy while maintaining or improving performance.
A subspace-preserving vs. subspace-expanding classification method for Transformer internal modules, based on geometric and entropy measurements of residual updates.
A diagnostic method for detecting attention resource misallocation in LVLMs by comparing learned attention outputs with predefined baseline attention patterns.
An architecture optimization technique that selectively disables or simplifies attention modules in certain layers based on functional decoupling analysis results.
idea_ch: 一种基于信息论和几何学的统一框架，用于量化Transformer-based LVLMs中残差更新的特征，实现对注意力机制和FFN模块的功能解耦分析。
一种注意力机制优化方法，用预定义的静态值（如高斯噪声）替换学习到的注意力权重，在减少冗余的同时保持或提升模型性能。
一种基于残差更新几何与熵测量的Transformer内部模块分类方法，将模块划分为子空间保持型（注意力）和子空间扩展型（FFN）。
一种通过对比学习注意力输出与预定义基线注意力模式来检测LVLMs注意力资源错配的诊断方法。
一种基于功能解耦分析结果，选择性禁用或简化特定层注意力模块的架构优化技术。

title: Chain of Risk: Safety Failures in Large Reasoning Models and Mitigation via Adaptive Multi-Principle Steering
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) increasingly expose chain-of-thought-like reasoning for transparency, verification, and deliberate problem solving. This creates a safety blind spot: harmful or policy-violating content may appear in reasoning traces even when final answers appear safe. We test whether final-answer safety is a sufficient proxy for the full reasoning-answer trajectory by scoring both stages under a unified twenty-principle safety rubric. Using prompts from seven public harmfulness and jailbreak sources, plus four out-of-distribution (OOD) sources, we evaluate 15 open-weight and API-based LRMs across 41K prompts per model. Reasoning traces consistently reveal additional safety risks beyond final answers, especially in high-severity stage-wise failures: leak cases, where unsafe reasoning precedes a safe-looking answer, and escape cases, where benign-looking reasoning precedes an unsafe final response. Principle-level analysis shows that risk concentrates in misinformation, legal compliance, discrimination, physical harm, and psychological harm. We further propose adaptive multi-principle steering, a white-box test-time mitigation that learns one unsafe-to-safe activation direction per safety principle and activates only directions whose current hidden state is closer to the unsafe than safe centroid. On three steerable open reasoning models, adaptive steering reduces unsafe counts in both reasoning traces and final answers on held-out and OOD benchmarks. DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B achieves a 40.8% average unsafe-count reduction while retaining 97.7% macro-averaged accuracy on BBH, GSM8K, and MMLU. These results suggest that LRM safety should be evaluated and mitigated over the full exposed reasoning-answer trajectory, not only at the final-answer stage.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型推理模型（LRM）的链式推理痕迹中可能存在安全风险，即使最终答案看起来安全。作者提出自适应多原则 steering 方法，在推理过程中进行干预，平均降低40.8%的不安全计数，同时保持97.7%的准确率。
AI.motivation: LRM暴露的推理痕迹可能包含违反政策的内容，但最终答案可能看起来安全，造成安全盲点。需要评估和缓解整个推理-答案轨迹的安全风险。
AI.method: 1) 使用统一的20原则安全评估体系对推理痕迹和最终答案分别评分；2) 提出自适应多原则 steering（adaptive multi-principle steering），学习每个安全原则的不安全到安全激活方向，在测试时根据当前隐藏状态选择干预方向。
AI.result: 在7个有害/越狱提示源和4个OOD源上评估15个模型共41K提示。推理痕迹比最终答案暴露更多安全风险。自适应steering在DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B上降低40.8%不安全计数，保持97.7%准确率。
AI.conclusion: LRM安全评估应覆盖完整的推理-答案轨迹，而不仅是最终答案。自适应多原则 steering 是一种有效的白盒测试时缓解方法。
idea_en: A method for comprehensive safety evaluation of large reasoning models by separately scoring reasoning traces and final answers using a unified multi-principle safety rubric, enabling detection of leak cases (unsafe reasoning + safe answer) and escape cases (safe reasoning + unsafe answer).

Adaptive multi-principle steering: a white-box test-time mitigation technique that learns one unsafe-to-safe activation direction per safety principle and dynamically activates only those directions whose current hidden state is closer to the unsafe centroid than the safe centroid.
A unified twenty-principle safety rubric for systematically evaluating safety risks across both reasoning traces and final answers in large reasoning models.
idea_ch: 一种综合性大型推理模型安全评估方法：使用统一的多个安全原则评估体系分别对推理痕迹和最终答案进行评分，能够检测泄漏案例（不安全推理+安全答案）和逃脱案例（安全推理+不安全答案）。
自适应多原则 steering：一种白盒测试时缓解技术，为每个安全原则学习一个从"不安全"到"安全"的激活方向，并动态激活那些当前隐藏状态更接近不安全质心而非安全质心的方向。
统一的二十原则安全评估体系，用于系统性地评估大型推理模型中推理痕迹和最终答案的安全风险。

title: Attractor Geometry of Transformer Memory: From Conflict Arbitration to Confident Hallucination
summary: Language models draw on two knowledge sources: facts baked into weights (parametric memory, PM) and information in context (working memory, WM). We study two mechanistically distinct failure modes--conflict, when PM and WM disagree and interfere; and hallucination, when the queried fact was never learned. Both produce confident output regardless, making output-based monitoring blind by design. We show both failures share a unified geometric account. In the hidden-state space of autoregressive generation, learned facts form attractor basins. Conflict is basin competition: WM disrupts convergence to the correct basin without raising output entropy. Hallucination is basin absence: the hidden state drifts freely when no memorized basin exists. The frozen LM head, designed for next-token prediction, cannot distinguish these cases and fires confidently either way. We verify this account in a controlled synthetic task--entity identifiers mapped to unique codes with PM installed via LoRA adapters--where ground truth is exact and component roles can be causally isolated through targeted adapter placement. Geometric margin--the hidden state's distance to the nearest memorized basin--reads this geometry directly and separates correct recall from hallucination far more cleanly than output entropy, with zero false refusals where entropy-based detection cannot avoid rejecting the vast majority of correct outputs. The separation holds on natural-language factual queries from the pretrained model with no adaptation, confirming attractor geometry is structural rather than a fine-tuning artifact. The fraction of confident hallucinations follows a scaling law $C = \exp(-c/\barΔ)$, growing with scale even as overall error rates fall. Hidden states reliably encode epistemic state; the frozen output head systematically erases it--and this erasure worsens with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了语言模型中两种失败模式（冲突与幻觉）的统一几何解释：记忆事实形成吸引子盆地，冲突是盆地竞争，幻觉是盆地缺失。通过几何距离度量可更好地区分正确召回与幻觉，且发现输出头部系统性擦除认知状态，且随模型规模扩大而恶化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型依赖参数记忆（PM）和上下文工作记忆（WM）两种知识来源，现有方法无法区分由两者冲突导致的错误和模型从未学习过事实导致的幻觉，因为两种情况下模型都自信输出。需要从机制层面理解这些失败模式。
AI.method: 提出统一几何解释：隐藏状态空间中学习到的事实形成吸引子盆地。冲突是WM干扰导致无法收敛到正确盆地；幻觉是缺乏记忆盆地导致隐藏状态自由漂移。通过LoRA适配器在合成任务中因果隔离组件角色，并引入几何间距（隐藏状态到最近记忆盆地的距离）作为检测指标。
AI.result: 几何间距能比输出熵更干净地区分正确召回与幻觉，零错误拒绝率。在自然语言事实查询上也成立。自信幻觉的比例服从标度律C=exp(-c/Δ̄)，随模型规模扩大而增长，尽管整体错误率下降。隐藏状态可靠编码认知状态，但冻结的输出头系统性擦除该状态，且随规模增大而恶化。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的失败模式源于隐藏状态空间的几何结构，可通过几何度量检测。输出头部是认知状态擦除的瓶颈，这为改进模型可靠性提供了新方向。
idea_en: A method for detecting hallucination in language models by computing geometric margin (distance from hidden state to nearest memorized attractor basin) in the hidden state space, enabling zero false refusal rate detection.
A system for distinguishing parametric memory conflict from working memory interference in autoregressive generation by analyzing attractor basin competition patterns in hidden state space.
A scaling law based approach for predicting the fraction of confident hallucinations in language models using C = exp(-c/Δ̄), where Δ̄ represents geometric margin metrics.
A method for preserving epistemic state information in language models by modifying the frozen output head that systematically erases hidden state uncertainty signals.
A causal isolation technique using targeted LoRA adapter placement to differentiate between parametric memory and working memory contributions in language model outputs.
idea_ch: 一种通过计算隐藏状态空间中几何间距（隐藏状态到最近记忆吸引子盆地的距离）来检测语言模型幻觉的方法，实现零错误拒绝率。
一种通过分析自回归生成中隐藏状态空间的吸引子盆地竞争模式，区分参数记忆冲突与工作记忆干扰的系统。
一种基于标度律C=exp(-c/Δ̄)预测语言模型中自信幻觉比例的方法，其中Δ̄表示几何间距度量。
一种通过修改冻结输出头来保留语言模型中认知状态信息的方法，该输出头系统性擦除隐藏状态的不确定性信号。
一种使用目标性LoRA适配器放置的因果隔离技术，用于区分语言模型输出中参数记忆和工作记忆的贡献。

title: DataDignity: Training Data Attribution for Large Language Models
summary: Auditing language-model outputs often requires more than judging correctness: an auditor may need to identify which source document most likely supports the knowledge expressed in a response. We study this as pinpoint provenance: given a prompt, a target-model response, and a candidate corpus, rank the documents that best support the response. We introduce FakeWiki, a controlled benchmark of 3,537 fabricated Wikipedia-style articles designed to preserve ground-truth provenance while weakening lexical shortcuts. FakeWiki includes QA probes, source-preserving paraphrases, retro-generated variants, hard anti-documents that remain topically similar while removing answer-critical facts, and five query conditions: clean prompting plus four jailbreak-inspired transformations. We evaluate seven retrieval baselines, a training-free activation-steering retrieval-fusion method, SteerFuse, and a supervised contrastive provenance ranker, ScoringModel. ScoringModel maps response and document features into a shared space and is trained with InfoNCE using in-batch, retrieval-mined, and anti-document negatives. Across nine open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs and five query conditions, ScoringModel improves mean Recall@10 from 35.0 for the strongest retrieval baseline to 52.2, without inference-time fusion, and wins 41/45 model-by-condition cells. SteerFuse is usually second-best despite requiring no supervised training, showing that activation-space evidence can efficiently complement text retrieval. On jailbreak-inspired transformed queries, ScoringModel improves Recall@10 by 15.7 points on average over the best baseline. Overall, our work shows that robust training data attribution requires evaluation settings that separate true answer support from topical or lexical resemblance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出监督对比溯源排序模型ScoringModel和无训练激活引导检索融合方法SteerFuse，用于语言模型输出的精准溯源。在基于维基百科风格伪造文章的FakeWiki基准上，ScoringModel将Recall@10从35.0提升至52.2，远超最强检索基线。
AI.motivation: 审计语言模型输出不仅需要判断正确性，还需定位支持该回答的源文档。现有方法在区分真正的事实支持与主题或词汇相似性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 构建FakeWiki基准（3,537篇伪造维基百科文章，去除词汇捷径保留真实溯源），提出ScoringModel（监督对比学习，将回答与文档映射到共享空间，使用InfoNCE损失和多种负样本）和SteerFuse（无训练激活引导检索融合方法）。
AI.result: 在9个开源指令微调LLM和5种查询条件下，ScoringModel的均值Recall@10从基线35.0提升至52.2，在41/45个模型-条件组合中获胜。对越狱提示变换查询，Recall@10平均提升15.7点。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒的训练数据归因需要能够区分真正答案支持与主题或词汇相似性的评估设置。激活空间证据可有效补充文本检索。
idea_en: A supervised contrastive provenance ranking model (ScoringModel) that maps response and document features into a shared embedding space using InfoNCE loss with in-batch, retrieval-mined, and anti-document negatives for pinpoint provenance.
A training-free activation-steering retrieval-fusion method (SteerFuse) that combines activation-space evidence with text retrieval without supervised training.

A controlled benchmark (FakeWiki) of fabricated Wikipedia-style articles with preserved ground-truth provenance, weakened lexical shortcuts, and anti-documents that remove answer-critical facts while remaining topically similar.
A multi-condition query evaluation framework including clean prompting and four jailbreak-inspired transformations for robustness testing of provenance methods.
The use of anti-documents as hard negatives that are topically similar but lack answer-critical facts, enabling the model to distinguish true factual support from topical resemblance.
idea_ch: 一种监督对比溯源排序模型(ScoringModel)，利用InfoNCE损失函数，将回答和文档特征映射到共享嵌入空间，并通过批内负样本、检索挖掘负样本和反文档负样本进行训练，实现精准溯源。
一种无需训练的激活引导检索融合方法(SteerFuse)，通过结合激活空间证据与文本检索，无需监督训练即可提升溯源性能。
一种受控基准数据集(FakeWiki)，由伪造维基百科文章构成，保留真实溯源标签的同时削弱词汇捷径，并包含移除答案关键事实但保持主题相似的反文档。
一种多条件查询评估框架，包括纯净提示和四种越狱风格转换查询，用于测试溯源方法的鲁棒性。
利用反文档作为硬负样本，这些文档主题相似但缺乏答案关键事实，从而训练模型区分真正的事实支持与主题相似性。

title: GCCM: Enhancing Generative Graph Prediction via Contrastive Consistency Model
summary: Conditional generative models, particularly diffusion-based methods, have recently been applied to graph prediction by modeling the target as a conditional distribution given the input graph, yielding competitive results compared to deterministic predictor. However, existing diffusion-based prediction methods typically require expensive iterative denoising at inference and often suffer from unstable sampling, which motivates recent efforts to reduce inference denoising steps and enable stable sampling via techniques such as consistency training. Despite this progress, we find that existing consistency training methods for graph prediction could potentially fall into a shortcut solution: the model may attempt to satisfy the self-consistency constraint by ignoring the noisy target (i.e., assigning it negligible weight), ultimately collapsing into a purely deterministic predictor. To mitigate such shortcut solution, we propose GCCM, a graph contrastive consistency model that goes beyond isolated pairwise matching between the same target at different noise levels by introducing negative pairs into a contrastive consistency objective. This adds an additional separation requirement, making the shortcut solution no longer trivially sufficient to satisfy the proposed objective. Moreover, we apply feature perturbation to the input node/edge features to break identical conditioning on the input graph, so that the shortcut no longer yields the same predictions across noise levels and becomes less attractive. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that GCCM mitigates the shortcut solution and yields consistent performance improvements in graph prediction compared to deterministic predictors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GCCM（图对比一致性模型），通过引入对比一致性目标和特征扰动机制，解决现有图预测一致性训练方法中的捷径解问题（模型忽略噪声目标退化为确定性预测器），在多个基准数据集上取得一致性改进。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型用于图预测时推理成本高且采样不稳定。一致性训练虽能减少推理步数，但在图预测任务中容易陷入捷径解：模型通过忽略含噪目标来满足自一致性约束，最终退化为纯确定性预测器，丧失了生成模型的优势。
AI.method: 1) 提出对比一致性目标函数：在原有正对（同一目标在不同噪声水平的匹配）基础上引入负对（不同目标之间的分离约束），使捷径解无法满足目标。2) 对输入节点/边特征施加特征扰动，打破模型在输入图上的恒等条件，使得不同噪声水平下捷径解不再产生相同预测，降低其吸引力。
AI.result: 在多个基准图预测数据集上，GCCM能够有效缓解捷径解问题，相比于确定性预测器取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 对比一致性目标结合特征扰动能有效防止图一致性模型退化为确定性预测器，为高效且稳定的图生成式预测提供了新思路。
idea_en: A graph contrastive consistency model (GCCM) for graph prediction that introduces negative pairs (different targets) into the consistency objective, requiring separation between distinct targets beyond the conventional self-consistency constraint between the same target at different noise levels.

A feature perturbation mechanism applied to input node/edge features to break identical conditioning on the input graph, preventing the shortcut solution where the model produces identical predictions across noise levels.

A contrastive consistency training framework that combines positive pair matching (same target, different noise levels) and negative pair separation (different targets) to prevent degenerate deterministic predictor behavior in diffusion-based graph prediction.
idea_ch: 一种图对比一致性模型（GCCM），在一致性目标函数中引入负对（不同目标）约束，要求模型在匹配同一目标不同噪声水平的同时，还需将不同目标在潜在空间中分离，从而避免模型退化为纯确定性预测器。
一种输入节点/边特征扰动机制，通过随机扰动输入特征打破模型在输入图上的恒等条件，使捷径解在不同噪声水平下无法产生相同预测，从而降低捷径解的吸引力。
一种结合正对匹配与负对分离的对比一致性训练框架，用于基于扩散的图预测任务，在保持少步推理优势的同时防止模型坍缩为确定性预测器。

title: Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration for Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is an effective approach for deploying large language models (LLMs) under memory and latency constraints. Most existing PTQ methods determine quantization parameters by minimizing a layer-wise reconstruction error on a predetermined calibration dataset, usually optimized via either scale search or Gram-based methods. However, from the perspective of generalization risk, existing calibration objectives of PTQ based only on empirical reconstruction error on limited or unrepresentative calibration data could move the quantized weights away from the original weights. This may cause the generalization risk to diverge, potentially degrading downstream performance. To address this issue, we propose \emph{Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration} (SARQC) a unified framework that augments the standard PTQ objective with a saliency-aware regularization term. This term encourages quantized weights to stay close to the original weights during calibration, leading to improved generalization during inference. SARQC integrates seamlessly into existing PTQ pipelines, enhancing both scale search and Gram-based methods under a unified formulation. Extensive experiments on dense and Mixture-of-Experts LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, without additional computational overhead during inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于显著性感知正则化的后训练量化校准框架(SARQC)，通过在标准PTQ目标中添加正则化项，使量化后的权重在校准过程中保持接近原始权重，从而提升大语言模型的泛化性能和下游任务表现，且不增加推理计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ方法仅基于有限或非代表性校准数据的经验重建误差来优化量化参数，导致量化权重偏离原始权重，泛化风险发散，损害下游性能。
AI.method: 提出SARQC统一框架，在标准PTQ目标中添加显著性感知的正则化项，鼓励量化权重在校准过程中保持接近原始权重，可无缝集成到现有PTQ流程中，同时增强尺度搜索和基于Gram的方法。
AI.result: 在稠密和混合专家(MoE)大语言模型上的大量实验表明，SARQC在困惑度和零样本准确率上取得一致性改进，且推理阶段无额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: SARQC通过正则化校准目标有效控制泛化风险，是一种通用、高效的PTQ增强框架，可广泛应用于各种LLM量化场景。
idea_en: A saliency-aware regularization term for post-training quantization that constrains quantized weights to remain close to original weights during calibration, preventing generalization risk divergence.
A unified PTQ framework (SARQC) that integrates both scale search and Gram-based quantization methods with a common regularization objective.
A calibration method that uses weight saliency information (importance of each weight to model output) to guide the regularization strength during quantization optimization.
A technique to improve post-training quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs by applying saliency-aware regularization to prevent performance degradation in expert modules.
idea_ch: 一种基于显著性感知正则化的后训练量化方法，在校准过程中约束量化权重接近原始权重，防止泛化风险发散。
一种统一的后训练量化校准框架(SARQC)，将尺度搜索和基于Gram的量化方法整合到同一正则化目标下。
一种利用权重显著性信息（每个权重对模型输出的重要程度）引导量化优化过程中正则化强度的校准技术。
一种针对混合专家(MoE)大语言模型的后训练量化改进方法，通过对专家模块应用显著性感知正则化来防止性能退化。

title: Inference-Time Budget Control for LLM Search Agents
summary: LLM search agents increasingly rely on tools at inference time, but their trajectories are often constrained by hard limits on both tool calls and generated tokens. Under such dual budgets, better answers require not only stronger models, but also explicit control over which search action should receive the next budget unit and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient to commit a final answer. We study this problem in multi-hop question answering (QA) and formulate it as two-stage inference-time budget control. At search time, our controller assigns each feasible action a task-level Value-of-Information (VOI) score, defined as an operational estimate of marginal task value per unit budget under the current search state and remaining dual budget, and uses this score to choose among retrieval, decomposition, and answer commitment. After search, a selective evidence-grounded finalizer compares the trajectory answer with a refined candidate and rewrites only when the residual error appears to be a low-risk answer-form error. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, three LLM backbones, and four budget levels, the method yields positive aggregate gains over four audited baselines under the same hard dual-budget protocol. Ablations show that search-time budget control, especially budget-dependent penalty, provides the main performance gain, while answer-time control helps mainly when the retrieval path is already adequate. These results suggest that inference-time budget control for LLM search agents should govern both how budget is spent during search and how the final answer is committed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多跳问答中LLM搜索代理在双预算约束（工具调用次数和生成token数）下的推理时预算控制问题，提出基于信息价值（VOI）的两阶段预算控制方法，包括搜索阶段的VOI引导动作选择和答案阶段的低风险纠错改写。
AI.motivation: LLM搜索代理在推理时依赖工具，但其轨迹受到工具调用次数和生成token数量的双重硬限制。在这种双预算约束下，如何高效分配预算、决定何时搜索、何时提交答案是一个关键问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段推理时预算控制方法：(1) 搜索阶段，控制器为每个可行动作计算任务级信息价值（VOI）分数（即当前状态和剩余预算下每单位预算的边际任务价值），据此选择检索、分解或答案提交；(2) 答案阶段，选择性证据驱动最终化器比较轨迹答案与精炼候选答案，仅在残差错误属于低风险答案形式错误时进行改写。
AI.result: 在4个多跳QA基准、3种LLM骨干和4种预算水平下，该方法在相同的硬双预算协议下相较于4个基线方法取得了正向总体增益。消融实验表明搜索阶段的预算控制（尤其是预算依赖惩罚）提供了主要性能提升，答案阶段控制主要在检索路径已足够好时起作用。
AI.conclusion: 推理时预算控制对LLM搜索代理至关重要，应同时控制搜索阶段的预算分配和最终答案的提交时机。
idea_en: A dual-budget constrained inference-time control method for LLM search agents that dynamically allocates budget units between search actions (retrieval, decomposition) and answer commitment based on task-level Value-of-Information (VOI) scoring.

A Value-of-Information (VOI) scoring mechanism that estimates marginal task value per unit budget under current search state and remaining dual budget (tool call + token budgets), enabling real-time prioritization of search actions.

A selective evidence-grounded finalizer that compares trajectory answer with a refined candidate and performs answer rewriting only when the residual error is identified as a low-risk answer-form error.
A budget-dependent penalty mechanism integrated into the VOI score that adjusts action selection based on remaining budget constraints, improving performance under hard dual-budget limits.
A two-stage inference-time budget control framework for multi-hop QA that separately governs search-time budget allocation and answer-time commitment decisions.
idea_ch: 一种基于双预算约束的LLM搜索代理推理时控制方法，通过任务级信息价值（VOI）评分在搜索动作（检索、分解）和答案提交之间动态分配预算单元。
一种信息价值（VOI）评分机制，在当前搜索状态和剩余双预算（工具调用预算+token预算）下估计每单位预算的边际任务价值，实现搜索动作的实时优先级排序。
一种选择性证据驱动最终化器，比较轨迹答案与精炼候选答案，仅在残差错误被识别为低风险答案形式错误时才执行答案改写。
一种集成到VOI评分中的预算依赖惩罚机制，根据剩余预算约束调整动作选择，在硬双预算限制下提升性能。
一种面向多跳QA的两阶段推理时预算控制框架，分别管理搜索阶段的预算分配和答案阶段的提交决策。

title: Knowledge-Graph Paths as Intermediate Supervision for Self-Evolving Search Agents
summary: Self-evolving search agents reduce reliance on human-written training questions by generating and solving their own search tasks. We build on Search Self-Play (SSP), a representative Proposer and Solver framework in which questions are generated and answered via multi-step search and reasoning. In practice, however, SSP faces two bottlenecks: the Proposer constructs questions from isolated answer entities without relational context, yielding many invalid or unverifiable questions in early self-play training, while the Solver receives only a binary outcome reward that discards useful signal from partially on-track search trajectories. We address both bottlenecks by reusing knowledge-graph paths as construction-derived intermediate supervision for both question construction and reward shaping. First, we ground question construction in LLM-guided knowledge-graph subgraphs, providing relational context for the Proposer. Second, we observe that constructing and solving a multi-hop question can involve overlapping intermediate entities: the factual bridges used to formulate the question may provide approximate waypoints for answering it. Exploiting this overlap, we introduce Waypoint Coverage Reward (WCR), which grants graded partial credit to incorrect Solver trajectories according to their coverage of entities on the construction path, while preserving full reward for correct answers. Across seven QA benchmarks and nine model configurations, our approach improves the average score over standard SSP in all configurations, including notable gains on multi-hop QA tasks. These results suggest that knowledge-graph paths can be reused as lightweight intermediate supervision, providing both relational guidance and process feedback without additional task-specific human annotations or manually labeled process steps.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自演化搜索代理中SSP框架的两大瓶颈（问题构建缺乏关系上下文、二值奖励信号粗糙），提出利用知识图谱路径作为中间监督：一方面用LLM引导的知识图谱子图来构建更有效的问题，另一方面引入路径覆盖率奖励（WCR）为部分正确的搜索轨迹提供分级奖励。
AI.motivation: SSP框架中，Proposer从孤立的答案实体构建问题，缺乏关系上下文，导致生成大量无效或不可验证的问题；而Solver只获得二值结果奖励，丢弃了部分正确的搜索轨迹中有用的中间信号。
AI.method: 1) 将问题构建过程锚定在LLM引导的知识图谱子图中，为Proposer提供关系上下文；2) 利用构建路径与求解路径中重叠的中间实体，提出路径覆盖率奖励（WCR），对不正确的Solver轨迹根据其覆盖构建路径实体的程度给予分级奖励，同时保留正确答案的全额奖励。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准和9个模型配置上，相比标准SSP，所有配置的平均得分均有提升，尤其在多跳QA任务上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱路径可以复用为轻量级中间监督，无需额外的人工标注或过程步骤标签，即可提供关系引导和过程反馈。
idea_en: A self-evolving search agent training method that grounds question construction in LLM-guided knowledge-graph subgraphs, providing relational context for generating valid and verifiable questions.
A reward shaping mechanism called Waypoint Coverage Reward (WCR) that provides graded partial credit to incorrect agent trajectories based on their coverage of entities on the construction path.
A method that reuses knowledge-graph paths as lightweight intermediate supervision for both question construction and reward shaping in search agent self-play frameworks.

An approach exploiting the overlap between construction paths and solving paths in multi-hop question answering, where factual bridges used to formulate the question serve as approximate waypoints for answering it.
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM引导的知识图谱子图来锚定问题构建的自演化搜索代理训练方法，为Proposer提供关系上下文以生成有效可验证的问题
一种称为路径覆盖率奖励（WCR）的奖励塑造机制，根据错误搜索轨迹对构建路径中实体的覆盖程度提供分级部分奖励
一种在搜索代理自博弈框架中重用知识图谱路径作为问题构建和奖励塑造的轻量级中间监督的方法
一种利用多跳问答中构建路径与求解路径之间重叠实体的方法，将用于构建问题的事实桥梁作为回答问题的近似路标

title: Resolving the bias-precision paradox with stochastic causal representation learning for personalized medicine
summary: Estimating individualized treatment effects from longitudinal observational data is central to data-driven medicine, yet existing methods face a fundamental limitation: reducing confounding bias often suppresses clinically informative heterogeneity, degrading patient-specific predictions. Here, we identify this tension as a bias-precision paradox in causal representation learning and introduce sampling-based maximum mean discrepancy (sMMD), a stochastic alignment strategy that replaces global adversarial balancing with subset-level matching. We instantiate this approach in a framework for counterfactual outcome prediction with attribution-grounded interpretability. Across two large-scale ICU cohorts (n = 27,783), our framework improves accuracy under distribution shift, reducing error by up to 11.5% and substantially increasing recall in high-risk tasks. Mechanistic analyses show that sMMD selectively preserves clinically decisive variables. In human-AI evaluation, our method outperforms clinicians-in-training and large language models, and improves clinician accuracy by 14.7% while reducing decision time, enabling interpretable, real-time clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出采样最大均值差异（sMMD）策略，解决因果表征学习中混淆偏差与临床异质性之间的偏倚-精度悖论，在两个大型ICU队列上实现了更高的预测精度和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在减少混淆偏差时往往抑制了临床上有信息的异质性，导致个体化预测性能下降，存在偏倚-精度悖论。
AI.method: 提出采样最大均值差异（sMMD），一种随机对齐策略，用子集级别的匹配替代全局对抗性平衡，实例化于反事实结果预测框架中，并支持归因可解释性。
AI.result: 在两个大型ICU队列（n=27,783）上，在分布偏移下误差降低最多11.5%，高风险任务召回率显著提升；人机评估中优于实习医生和大语言模型，临床医生准确率提升14.7%，决策时间缩短。
AI.conclusion: sMMD有效解决了因果表征学习中的偏倚-精度悖论，选择性保留临床决定性变量，实现了可解释、实时的临床决策支持。
idea_en: Sampling-based Maximum Mean Discrepancy (sMMD) for stochastic alignment in causal representation learning, replacing global adversarial balancing with subset-level matching to resolve bias-precision paradox.
Counterfactual outcome prediction framework with attribution-grounded interpretability that selectively preserves clinically decisive variables while reducing confounding bias.
Human-AI clinical decision support system integrating sMMD-based predictions that improves clinician accuracy by 14.7% and reduces decision time.
idea_ch: 基于采样的最大均值差异（sMMD）随机对齐策略，以子集级匹配替代全局对抗性平衡，解决因果表征学习中的偏倚-精度悖论。
具有归因可解释性的反事实结果预测框架，在减少混淆偏差的同时选择性保留临床决定性变量。
集成sMMD预测的人机协同临床决策支持系统，将临床医生准确率提升14.7%并缩短决策时间。

title: Conceal, Reconstruct, Jailbreak: Exploiting the Reconstruction-Concealment Tradeoff in MLLMs
summary: Intent-obfuscation-based jailbreak attacks on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) transform a harmful query into a concealed multimodal input to bypass safety mechanisms. We show that such attacks are governed by a \emph{reconstruction--concealment tradeoff}: the transformed input must hide harmful intent from safety filters while remaining recoverable enough for the victim model to reconstruct the original request. Through a reconstruction analysis of three representative black-box methods, we find that existing transformations struggle to balance this tradeoff, limiting their effectiveness. In contrast, we show that character-removed variants achieve a better balance. Building on this, we propose \emph{concealment-aware variant construction}, which greedily selects character-removed variants that are low in harmful-keyword alignment and mutually diverse, and instantiates them through five modality-aware prompting strategies. We further introduce \emph{keyword-related distractor images} that depict the harmful keyword in diverse contexts, providing more effective auxiliary visual context than generic distractor images. Experiments across closed-source and open-source MLLMs show the proposed strategies outperform strong baselines, revealing an underexplored vulnerability: a model's own reconstruction ability can be exploited to recover hidden harmful intent and produce unsafe responses.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大语言模型(MLLM)中基于意图混淆的越狱攻击受"重建-隐藏权衡"支配，并提出通过字符移除变体、隐蔽感知变体构建和关键词相关干扰图像等策略来更好地平衡该权衡，从而更有效地绕过安全机制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于意图混淆的黑盒越狱攻击方法在将有害查询转换为隐蔽的多模态输入时，难以在"隐藏有害意图"与"保持可恢复性"之间取得良好平衡，导致攻击效果受限。作者旨在发现并利用这一权衡中的新漏洞。
AI.method: 1) 对三种代表性黑盒方法进行重建分析，揭示重建-隐藏权衡；2) 提出"隐蔽感知变体构建"，贪心选择低有害关键词对齐且多样化的字符移除变体；3) 设计五种模态感知提示策略实例化变体；4) 引入"关键词相关干扰图像"，在多样上下文中呈现有害关键词，提供比通用干扰图像更有效的辅助视觉上下文。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的策略在闭源和开源MLLM上均优于强基线方法，揭示了模型自身的重建能力可被利用来恢复隐藏的有害意图并产生不安全响应这一未被充分探索的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 越狱攻击的关键在于平衡重建与隐藏的矛盾，字符移除变体比现有方法能更好实现这一平衡；模型自身的重建能力是一把双刃剑，可被攻击者利用。
idea_en: A method for constructing concealment-aware jailbreak attack variants by greedily selecting character-removed text variants with low harmful-keyword alignment and high mutual diversity
A technique using keyword-related distractor images that depict harmful keywords in diverse contexts to provide more effective auxiliary visual context for bypassing safety filters in MLLMs
A set of five modality-aware prompting strategies that instantiate character-removed variants across different input modalities to exploit reconstruction-concealment tradeoff
A reconstruction analysis framework for evaluating black-box intent-obfuscation jailbreak attacks on multimodal LLMs
idea_ch: 一种隐蔽感知的越狱攻击变体构建方法：贪心选择低有害关键词对齐且高多样性的字符移除文本变体
关键词相关干扰图像技术：在多样上下文中呈现有害关键词，作为辅助视觉上下文以绕过MLLM安全过滤机制
五种模态感知提示策略：在不同输入模态下实例化字符移除变体，利用重建-隐藏权衡实现越狱攻击
一种重建分析框架：用于评估多模态大语言模型上基于意图混淆的黑盒越狱攻击效果

title: Decodable but Not Corrected by Fixed Residual-Stream Linear Steering: Evidence from Medical LLM Failure Regimes
comment: 22 pages (14 main + 8 appendix), 5 figures, 7 tables. Under review
summary: Can linearly decodable failure signals in LLM hidden states be leveraged to correct those failures? We investigate this classification-correction gap via Overthinking (OT)--a stable behavioral regime (Jaccard >= 0.81, 94% inter-annotator agreement) in medical QA where models answer correctly under resampling yet fail in extended chain-of-thought. OT is linearly decodable at 71.6% balanced accuracy (p < 10^{-16}). Yet five families of fixed linear steering (29 configurations, n=1,273) all yield Delta ~= 0, with identical null results cross-architecture (Qwen2.5-7B) and cross-domain (MMLU-STEM). Three convergent lines of evidence suggest representational entanglement: the OT direction has 85-88% overlap with task-critical computation (specificity ratio <= 0.152); non-targeted shared-direction steering damages accuracy (-12.1pp); and LEACE concept erasure damages accuracy (-3.6pp, p=0.01), while 10 random erasures produce Delta=+0.3pp. The per-instance probe-steering correlation is r=-0.002 (p=0.97). Positively, the same probe enables selective abstention (held-out AUROC=0.610, exceeding all five uncertainty baselines, p=0.009): decodable failure structure supports post-generation reliability estimation even when the fixed linear steering family cannot exploit it for correction.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了LLM隐藏状态中的线性可解码失败信号（如“过度思考”现象）能够用于后生成的可靠性估计（选择性弃权），但无法通过固定线性干预进行修正，原因是失败方向与任务关键计算存在表征纠缠。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM隐藏状态中线性可解码的失败信号能否被用于纠正模型错误，即分类-修正差距（classification-correction gap）。
AI.method: 通过“过度思考”（Overthinking, OT）行为模式——模型在重采样下回答正确但在扩展思维链中失败——进行实验。使用线性探针（linear probe）检测OT状态，并测试五种固定线性干预策略（29种配置，n=1,273），以及概念擦除（LEACE）、共享方向干预等方法进行分析。
AI.result: OT呈线性可解码（平衡准确率71.6%），但所有固定线性干预均无效（Delta≈0），跨架构和跨领域结果一致。原因是OT方向与任务关键计算重叠85-88%（特异性比≤0.152），非目标干预会损害准确率（-12.1pp），概念擦除同样损害准确率（-3.6pp）。但同一探针可用于选择性弃权（AUROC=0.610，超越五种不确定性基线）。
AI.conclusion: 可解码的失败结构可用于后生成可靠性估计（选择性弃权），但固定线性干预无法利用该结构进行修正，原因在于表征纠缠。
idea_en: A method for post-generation reliability estimation in large language models using linear probes to detect overthinking (OT) failure patterns in hidden states, enabling selective abstention with AUROC exceeding traditional uncertainty baselines.

A system for identifying Overthinking (OT) behavioral regimes in LLMs during chain-of-thought reasoning, characterized by stable response patterns where models answer correctly under resampling but fail in extended reasoning chains.

A technique for linear decoding of failure signals from LLM hidden states at 71.6% balanced accuracy, combined with selective abstention mechanism for improving model reliability without attempting to correct the failure directly.
idea_ch: 一种利用线性探针检测大语言模型隐藏状态中的过度思考（OT）失败模式的方法，用于后生成可靠性估计，实现选择性弃权（AUROC超越传统不确定性基线）。
一种识别LLM思维链推理过程中过度思考（OT）行为模式的系统，该模式表现为模型在重采样下回答正确但在扩展推理链中失败。
一种从LLM隐藏状态线性解码失败信号（平衡准确率71.6%）并结合选择性弃权机制的技术，在不直接修正失败的情况下提高模型可靠性。
一种基于表征纠缠分析的方法，通过测量失败方向与任务关键计算的交叠程度（85-88%），预测固定线性干预策略的有效性。

title: More Is Not Always Better: Cross-Component Interference in LLM Agent Scaffolding
summary: LLM agent systems are built by stacking scaffolding components (planning, tools, memory, self-reflection, retrieval) assuming more is better. We study cross-component interference (CCI): degradation when components interact destructively. We run a full factorial experiment over all 2^5=32 subsets of five components on HotpotQA and GSM8K with Llama-3.1-8B/70B (96 conditions, up to 10 seeds). The All-In system is consistently suboptimal: on HotpotQA, a single-tool agent surpasses All-In by 32% (F1 0.233 vs 0.177, p=0.023); on GSM8K, a 3-component subset beats All-In by 79% (0.43 vs 0.24, p=0.010). Optimal component count is task-dependent (k*=1-4) and scale-sensitive: at 70B, combinations that hurt at 8B provide gains, though All-In still trails the best subset. We fit a main-effects regression (R^2=0.916, adj-R^2=0.899, LOOCV=0.872), compute exact Shapley values, and find 183/325 submodularity violations (56.3%), showing greedy selection is unreliable. A three-body synergy among Tool Use, Self-Reflection, and Retrieval (INT_3=+0.175, 95% CI [+0.003,+0.351]) is reported as exploratory. CCI replicates across model families (Qwen2.5) and is robust to prompt paraphrasing. Our findings suggest maximally-equipped agent defaults should be replaced by task-specific subset selection via interaction-aware analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全因子实验发现，LLM智能体系统中多个组件并存会导致交叉组件干扰(CCI)，全组件系统并非最优，任务特定的组件子集选择效果更好。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统默认堆叠更多组件（规划、工具、记忆、自反思、检索），认为"越多越好"，但组件间的交互可能产生负面干扰，目前缺乏系统性的研究来验证这一假设。
AI.method: 对5个组件进行2^5=32个子集的全体因子实验，在HotpotQA和GSM8K数据集上使用Llama-3.1-8B/70B（共96种条件，最多10个种子），并拟合主效应回归、计算Shapley值，分析子模性违反情况。
AI.result: 全组件系统一致次优：HotpotQA上单工具智能体比全组件高32%（F1 0.233 vs 0.177），GSM8K上3组件子集比全组件高79%（0.43 vs 0.24）。最优组件数因任务而异（k*=1-4），且对规模敏感（70B下8B时有害的组合反而有益）。183/325个子模性违反（56.3%），贪婪选择不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 应放弃最大装备的智能体默认配置，转而通过交互感知分析进行任务特定的子集选择。
idea_en: A method for task-adaptive LLM agent component subset selection that replaces the default all-components configuration with interaction-aware analysis to mitigate cross-component interference.
A system for detecting and quantifying cross-component interference (CCI) in LLM agent architectures using full factorial experimental design and main-effects regression modeling.
A technique for computing exact Shapley values of LLM agent components to identify submodularity violations and optimize component combinations for specific tasks.
An exploratory three-body synergy mechanism involving Tool Use, Self-Reflection, and Retrieval components that yields positive interaction effects (INT_3=+0.175) in LLM agent systems.
A cross-model and cross-prompt robustness validation framework for CCI patterns that generalizes findings across different LLM families (e.g., Qwen2.5) and prompt variations.
idea_ch: 一种任务自适应LLM智能体组件子集选择方法，用交互感知分析替代默认全组件配置，以减轻交叉组件干扰。
一种检测和量化LLM智能体架构中交叉组件干扰(CCI)的系统，采用全因子实验设计和主效应回归建模。
一种计算LLM智能体组件精确Shapley值的技术，用于识别子模性违反并优化特定任务的组件组合。
一种涉及工具使用、自反思和检索组件的三体协同机制，在LLM智能体系统中产生正向交互效应(INT_3=+0.175)。
一种CCI模式的跨模型和跨提示鲁棒性验证框架，可泛化至不同LLM家族（如Qwen2.5）和提示变体。

title: Detecting Time Series Anomalies Like an Expert: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Specialized Analyzers
comment: Preprint. 9 pages main text, 29 pages total, 8 figures, 9 tables, with appendix
summary: Recent studies have explored large language models for time-series anomaly detection, yet existing approaches often rely on a single general-purpose model to directly infer anomaly indices or intervals, limiting controllability, interpretability, and reliability for complex anomaly patterns. We propose SAGE (Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection), a multi-agent framework for structured anomaly diagnosis in univariate time series. It decomposes anomaly analysis into four specialized Analyzers for point, structural, seasonal, and pattern anomalies. Each Analyzer applies family-specific numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations to generate evidence, while an evidence-grounded Detector consolidates the evidence into confidence-scored anomaly records with intervals and candidate types. A Supervisor then converts these structured records into analyst-facing diagnostic reports. SAGE further constructs synthetic in-context examples from normal-reference training segments, without using real anomalous segments or anomaly-type labels as in-context examples. Across three benchmarks, SAGE achieves the best average performance among strong ML/DL and language-model-based baselines. Ablation studies and human evaluation further show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and the practical usefulness of diagnostic outputs.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个多智能体框架，将单变量时间序列异常检测分解为点异常、结构异常、季节异常和模式异常四种专业分析器，通过证据驱动的检测器和监督者生成置信度评分的异常记录和诊断报告。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的时间序列异常检测方法依赖单一通用模型直接推断异常指标或区间，对于复杂异常模式缺乏可控性、可解释性和可靠性。
AI.method: SAGE框架包含四个专业分析器（点异常、结构异常、季节异常、模式异常），各自使用特定数值工具和可视化生成证据；证据驱动的检测器整合证据生成置信度评分的异常记录；监督者将结构化记录转换为诊断报告。同时从正常参考训练段构建合成上下文示例。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，SAGE在平均性能上优于强ML/DL和基于语言模型的基线方法。消融研究和人工评估表明该框架提高了检测可靠性和诊断输出的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体分解方法能有效提升时间序列异常检测的可控性、可解释性和可靠性。
idea_en: Multi-agent framework for time-series anomaly detection that decomposes anomaly analysis into specialized analyzers (point, structural, seasonal, pattern) each using domain-specific numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations.
Evidence-grounded detector that consolidates multiple analyzer outputs into confidence-scored anomaly records with intervals and candidate anomaly types.
Method for constructing synthetic in-context examples from normal-reference training segments without using real anomalous segments or anomaly-type labels.
Supervisor module that converts structured anomaly records into human-readable diagnostic reports for analyst-facing applications.
Specialized numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations tailored to each anomaly family (point, structural, seasonal, pattern) for evidence generation.
idea_ch: 将时间序列异常检测分解为多个专业分析器（点异常、结构异常、季节异常、模式异常）的多智能体框架，每个分析器使用领域特定的数值工具和诊断可视化。
证据驱动的检测器，整合多个分析器输出，生成具有置信度评分、异常区间和候选异常类型的结构化异常记录。
从正常参考训练段构建合成上下文示例的方法，无需使用真实异常段或异常类型标签作为上下文示例。
监督者模块，将结构化异常记录转换为面向分析人员的可读诊断报告。
针对每种异常族（点异常、结构异常、季节异常、模式异常）定制的专业数值工具和诊断可视化方法，用于生成检测证据。

title: SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed with large libraries of reusable skills, selecting the right skill for a user request has become a critical systems challenge. In small libraries, users may invoke skills explicitly by name, but this assumption breaks down as skill ecosystems grow under tight context and latency budgets. Despite its practical importance, skill retrieval remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and little understanding of retrieval behavior on realistic skill libraries. To address this gap, we introduce SkillRet, a large-scale benchmark for skill retrieval in LLM agents. SkillRet contains 17,810 public agent skills, organized with structured semantic tags and a two-level taxonomy spanning 6 major categories and 18 sub-categories. It provides 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation queries with disjoint skill pools, enabling both benchmarking and retrieval-oriented training. Across a diverse set of retrievers, we find that skill retrieval remains far from solved: off-the-shelf models struggle on realistic large-scale skill libraries, and prior skill-retrieval models still leave substantial headroom. Task-specific fine-tuning on SkillRet substantially improves performance, improving NDCG@10 by +13.1 points over the strongest prior retriever and by +16.9 points over the strongest off-the-shelf retriever. Our analysis further suggests that these gains arise because fine-tuned models better focus on the small skill-relevant signals within long and noisy queries. These results establish SkillRet as a strong benchmark and foundation for future research on retrieval in large-scale agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SkillRet，一个大规模LLM智能体技能检索基准，包含17,810个公开技能和63,259个训练样本，发现现有检索器在大规模技能库上表现不佳，而任务特定微调可显著提升性能（NDCG@10提升+13.1至+16.9点）。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体部署大量可复用技能库，在严格的上下文和延迟预算下，从大型技能库中准确检索用户请求对应的技能成为关键系统挑战，但该领域缺乏大规模基准和对检索行为的深入理解。
AI.method: 构建了包含17,810个公开智能体技能的大规模基准SkillRet，技能通过结构化语义标签组织，采用两级分类体系（6大类别、18子类），提供63,259个训练样本和4,997个评估查询，并采用不相交的技能池设计。
AI.result: 现有现成检索器在大规模真实技能库上表现困难，先前技能检索模型仍有较大提升空间。任务特定微调显著提升性能，NDCG@10比最强先前检索器提升+13.1点，比最强现成检索器提升+16.9点。分析表明，微调模型能更好地聚焦于长噪声查询中的小技能相关信号。
AI.conclusion: SkillRet为大规模智能体系统中的技能检索提供了强有力的基准和基础，揭示了当前方法的不足，并展示了任务特定微调的有效性。
idea_en: A large-scale benchmark system (SkillRet) for skill retrieval in LLM agents, comprising 17,810 public agent skills organized with structured semantic tags and a two-level taxonomy spanning 6 major categories and 18 sub-categories, with 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation queries using disjoint skill pools.

A task-specific fine-tuning method for skill retrieval that improves NDCG@10 by +13.1 points over prior skill-retrieval models and +16.9 points over off-the-shelf retrievers, by focusing on small skill-relevant signals within long and noisy queries.
A structured semantic tagging and two-level taxonomy organization system for large-scale agent skill libraries that enables efficient retrieval under tight context and latency budgets.
idea_ch: 一种面向LLM智能体技能检索的大规模基准系统(SkillRet)，包含17,810个公开智能体技能，采用结构化语义标签和两级分类体系（6大类别、18子类），提供63,259个训练样本和4,997个使用不相交技能池的评估查询。
一种针对技能检索的任务特定微调方法，通过聚焦长噪声查询中的小技能相关信号，在NDCG@10上比先前最强技能检索模型提升+13.1点，比最强现成检索器提升+16.9点。
一种用于大规模智能体技能库的结构化语义标签和两级分类体系组织方法，能够在严格的上下文和延迟预算下实现高效检索。

title: Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading Using Optimized Deep Learning and LLM-Driven Intelligent AI on Computationally Limited Systems
comment: 6 pages, 11 figures, Accepted and presented at the 2nd International Conference on Emerging Computational Intelligence (ICECI 2026), IEEE. Published in conference proceedings. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is among the musculoskeletal disorders that considerably restrict joint mobility, cause severe chronic pain and impact negatively on quality life. It is one of the persistent health issues worldwide. Generally, subjectivity and inter-observer variability undermine conventional practices and evaluation process that are adopted to address such health issues. Hence precise and timely diagnosis would be one of the effective ways for the assessment of its severity. This paper proposes an automated diagnostic approach for severity grading of KOA by blending a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) with a device-based inference platform powered by TensorFlow Lite. It proposes a model based on the ResNet-18 convolutional neural network. The designed model is trained on publicly available database. Through a transfer learning approach obtained knee images are first classified into five Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grades. Further the developed model is optimised. During the training of the model test accuracy of 94.48% with stable convergence has been achieved. Subsequently the optimised model transformed into a lightweight TensorFlow Lite format, facilitating seamless deployment on resource-constrained devices. The designed model is capable enough to operate in the environment having no continuous internet connectivity. Also, an auxiliary Large Language Model (Gemini-2.0-flash) is applied to generate structured interpretive findings like potential symptoms, risk factors, and preventive majors etc. The LLM component functions as interface without influencing the classification process. The proposed model articulates the feasibility of an on-device, interpretable decision-support tools for early diagnosis and improve accessibility to Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted knee screening tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合ResNet-18 CNN与TensorFlow Lite的膝骨关节炎自动诊断方法，实现五级KL分级，准确率94.48%，并集成LLM生成结构化解读报告，可在离线环境下部署。
AI.motivation: 传统KOA诊断依赖主观评估，存在观察者间差异大、精度不足等问题，亟需一种自动化、可部署于资源受限设备的精准诊断工具。
AI.method: 基于ResNet-18的CNN模型，采用迁移学习在公开数据集上训练，将膝关节图像分为5个KL等级；模型优化后转换为TensorFlow Lite格式以适配边缘设备；辅助使用Gemini-2.0-flash大语言模型生成结构化诊断报告。
AI.result: 测试准确率达94.48%，模型收敛稳定；成功转换为轻量级TensorFlow Lite格式，可在无持续互联网连接的环境中运行。
AI.conclusion: 该方案验证了在设备端部署可解释性AI辅助诊断工具的可行性，有助于早期KOA筛查和提高AI辅助膝关节筛查的可及性。
idea_en: A method for automated severity grading of knee osteoarthritis using a ResNet-18 CNN model trained via transfer learning to classify knee images into five Kellgren-Lawrence grades.
Conversion of the optimized KOA classification model into TensorFlow Lite lightweight format for on-device deployment on resource-constrained edge devices without continuous internet connectivity.

Integration of an auxiliary Large Language Model (Gemini-2.0-flash) to generate structured interpretive findings (potential symptoms, risk factors, preventive measures) as an interpretable interface without interfering with the core classification process.
A complete pipeline combining CNN-based KOA grading with LLM-generated clinical interpretation for an on-device, interpretable decision-support tool for early diagnosis.
idea_ch: 一种基于ResNet-18卷积神经网络的膝骨关节炎严重程度自动分级方法，通过迁移学习将膝关节图像分类为五个Kellgren-Lawrence等级。
将优化的KOA分类模型转换为TensorFlow Lite轻量级格式，实现在无持续互联网连接的资源受限边缘设备上的部署。
集成辅助大语言模型（Gemini-2.0-flash）生成结构化解读报告（包括潜在症状、风险因素、预防措施等），作为可解释性接口而不干扰核心分类过程。
一种结合CNN膝关节分级与LLM临床解读的完整流程，构建设备端可解释的早期诊断决策支持工具。

title: SDFlow: Similarity-Driven Flow Matching for Time Series Generation
summary: Vector quantization (VQ) with autoregressive (AR) token modeling is a widely adopted and highly competitive paradigm for time-series generation. However, such models are fundamentally limited by exposure bias: during inference, errors can accumulate across sequential predictions, leading to pronounced quality degradation in long-horizon generation. To address this, we propose SDFlow ($\textbf{S}$imilarity-$\textbf{D}$riven $\textbf{Flow}$ Matching), a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching. We tackle three key challenges in making this transition: (1) eliminating exposure bias by replacing step-wise token prediction with a global transport map; (2) mitigating the high-dimensionality of VQ token spaces via a low-rank manifold decomposition with a learned anchor prior over the latent manifold; and (3) incorporating discrete supervision into continuous transport dynamics by introducing a categorical posterior over codebook indices within a variational flow-matching formulation. Extensive experiments show that SDFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Discriminative Score and substantially reducing Context-FID, particularly for challenging long-sequence generation. Moreover, SDFlow provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SDFlow-D6F3/

AI.tldr: SDFlow是一种基于流匹配的非自回归时间序列生成框架，在冻结的VQ潜在空间中实现并行序列生成，通过全局传输图、低秩流形分解和变分流匹配中的分类后验来消除暴露偏差，在长序列生成中取得SOTA性能并显著加速推理。
AI.motivation: 向量量化结合自回归token建模在时间序列生成中占主导地位，但存在暴露偏差问题：推理时顺序预测的误差累积导致长序列生成质量严重下降。现有方法无法从根本上解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出SDFlow框架：(1) 用全局传输图替代逐步token预测消除暴露偏差；(2) 通过低秩流形分解和学习锚定先验降低VQ token空间的高维度；(3) 在变分流匹配公式中引入码本索引的分类后验，将离散监督融入连续传输动力学。
AI.result: 在多个指标上达到SOTA，Discriminative Score提升，Context-FID显著降低，尤其在长序列生成任务中优势明显；同时推理速度相比自回归基线大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: SDFlow通过非自回归流匹配框架有效解决了VQ-AR范式的暴露偏差问题，在高保真度和计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，为时间序列生成提供了新的范式。
idea_en: A non-autoregressive time-series generation method operating entirely in a frozen VQ latent space, replacing sequential token prediction with parallel sequence generation via flow matching to eliminate exposure bias.

A low-rank manifold decomposition technique for high-dimensional VQ token spaces, combined with a learned anchor prior over the latent manifold to reduce dimensionality and improve generation quality.

A variational flow-matching formulation incorporating categorical posterior over codebook indices, enabling discrete supervision to be integrated into continuous transport dynamics for time-series generation.
A similarity-driven flow matching framework that uses global transport maps instead of step-wise autoregressive prediction for time-series generation, enabling efficient long-horizon generation.
idea_ch: 一种完全在冻结的VQ潜在空间中运行的非自回归时间序列生成方法，通过流匹配替代顺序token预测实现并行序列生成，从而消除暴露偏差。
一种针对高维VQ token空间的低秩流形分解技术，结合学习得到的潜在流形锚定先验，降低维度并提升生成质量。
一种变分流匹配公式，引入码本索引的分类后验，将离散监督融入连续传输动力学中用于时间序列生成。
一种基于相似性驱动的流匹配框架，使用全局传输图替代逐步自回归预测进行时间序列生成，实现高效的长视野生成。

title: ReFlect: An Effective Harness System for Complex Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
summary: Current reasoning paradigms for LLMs include chain-of-thought, ReAct, and post-hoc self-critique. These paradigms rely on two assumptions that fail on long-horizon, multi-stage tasks. As a result, errors accumulate silently across reasoning steps, leaving an open question: can a reasoning system effectively detect and recover from its own failures? We present ReFlect, a \emph{harness} system for LLM reasoning that creates standalone error detection and recovery logic as a deterministic wrapper around the model. Controlled experiments across 6 reasoning domains show that prompt-level self-critique produces formulaic templates that flag no issues in 90 of 100 audited reflection blocks, and the investigated LLMs wrongly accept a wrong answer in at least 76\% of cases. Our ReFlect harness achieves task success rates ranging from 41\% on gpt-4o-mini to 56\% on Claude Sonnet 4.5 across six models spanning small and frontier scale, with per-model gains over Direct CoT ranging from +7 pp on Qwen2.5-72B to +29 pp on Claude Sonnet 4.5, and additionally raises SWE-bench patch-structural quality from 0\% (Direct CoT) to between 82\% (Qwen2.5-72B) and 87\% (GPT-4o). Notably, the harness gain is inversely proportional to the model's Direct CoT task success rate (the fitted slope is -1.69 with r=-0.76): each pp lost in baseline success rate is mechanically recovered by 1.69 pp of harness gain. We spot that adding structured reasoning state and operators yields only 15.0--18.7\% pair-mean on Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B because models at this scale cannot reliably populate the state its operators require. ReFlect is model-agnostic, training-free, and operates entirely at inference time.

AI.tldr: ReFlect是一种用于LLM推理的确定性封装系统，通过独立的错误检测与恢复逻辑，在长周期多阶段任务中显著提升推理可靠性，在多个模型上取得7-29个百分点的性能提升，SWE-bench补丁质量从0%提升至82-87%。
AI.motivation: 现有推理范式（chain-of-thought、ReAct、事后自我批评）在长周期多阶段任务中存在两个根本性缺陷：错误在推理步骤间无声累积，且模型自身难以有效检测和恢复错误。因此，需要一种能够独立于LLM自身的推理监控与纠错机制。
AI.method: ReFlect是一个模型无关、无需训练、完全运行在推理阶段的"封装"系统。它将错误检测与恢复逻辑构建为包裹LLM的确定性外层，不依赖模型自身的自我批评能力，而是以独立的结构化逻辑来监控和修正推理过程。
AI.result: 在6个推理领域的实验中：提示级自我批评在90/100的审计块中产生无问题模板；LLM在至少76%的案例中错误接受错误答案。ReFlect在gpt-4o-mini上达41%任务成功率，在Claude Sonnet 4.5上达56%；相对Direct CoT的提升从Qwen2.5-72B的+7个百分点到Claude Sonnet 4.5的+29个百分点；SWE-bench补丁质量从0%提升至82%-87%。封装增益与基线成功率呈反比（斜率-1.69，r=-0.76）。
AI.conclusion: ReFlect证明了独立于LLM自身的确定性错误检测与恢复机制可以有效弥补模型在长周期推理任务中的固有缺陷，且增益效果在较弱模型上更为显著。简单的结构化推理状态与算子方法在中型模型上效果有限（仅15.0-18.7%）。
idea_en: A deterministic harness system for LLM reasoning that separates error detection and recovery logic from the model itself, operating as a wrapper without requiring model training or fine-tuning.

An inverse proportional relationship mechanism where the harness gain automatically compensates for baseline reasoning deficiencies, with a fitted slope of -1.69 (r=-0.76) between baseline success rate and harness improvement.
A model-agnostic inference-time architecture that creates standalone error detection and recovery logic as a deterministic wrapper, independent of the LLM's self-critique capabilities.
A method for detecting 'formulaic templates' in prompt-level self-critique that flag no issues in 90% of reflection blocks, revealing the systematic failure of LLM self-correction.
A structured reasoning state and operator system that achieves limited gains (15.0-18.7% pair-mean) on mid-scale models, identifying the capability threshold for reliable state population.
idea_ch: 一种将错误检测与恢复逻辑从LLM本身分离的确定性封装系统，作为模型的外部包装器运行，无需模型训练或微调。
一种基于反比关系的增益补偿机制，基线成功率与封装增益之间呈现-1.69的拟合斜率（r=-0.76），自动补偿模型在推理中的固有缺陷。
一种模型无关的推理时架构，创建独立于LLM自我批评能力的确定性错误检测与恢复逻辑包装器。
一种检测提示级自我批评中'公式化模板'的方法，发现90%的反思块中模型标记无问题，揭示了LLM自我纠正的系统性失败。
一种结构化推理状态与算子系统，在中型模型上获得有限增益（15.0-18.7%），识别了模型可靠填充状态的性能阈值。

title: HyperLens: Quantifying Cognitive Effort in LLMs with Fine-grained Confidence Trajectory
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, their inference dynamics remain poorly understood because of the limited resolution of existing analysis tools. In this work, we identify an intrinsic magnification mechanism in transformer architectures: deeper layers inherently magnify the small changes of layer-wise confidence, providing a fine-grained confidence trajectory. Building on this insight, we introduce HyperLens, a high-resolution probe designed to trace confidence trajectories and quantify the cognitive effort during inference. Across LLMs and datasets, HyperLens reveals a consistent divergence in confidence trajectories that separates complex from simple tasks. We abstract this pattern into a quantitative cognitive effort metric. Our analysis reveals a fundamental principle: complex tasks consistently require higher cognitive effort. Finally, we provide a mechanistic diagnosis of a common side effect of standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT): it can reduce cognitive effort and consequently degrade performance on in-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer深层具有内在的置信度放大机制，据此提出高分辨率探针HyperLens追踪模型的认知努力，并揭示复杂任务需要更高认知努力的原理，同时诊断了标准SFT会降低认知努力从而损害域内性能的副作用。
AI.motivation: 现有分析工具分辨率有限，无法有效理解LLM的推理动态，尤其缺乏对模型认知努力的量化手段。
AI.method: 识别Transformer深层对逐层置信度微小变化的放大机制，构建HyperLens高分辨率探针来追踪置信度轨迹并量化认知努力。
AI.result: HyperLens揭示了复杂/简单任务间置信度轨迹的持续分歧，将这一模式抽象为量化认知努力指标，并发现标准SFT会降低认知努力从而损害域内性能。
AI.conclusion: 复杂任务需要更高认知努力是一个基本原理，SFT的副作用可通过认知努力视角进行机制性诊断。
idea_en: A method for tracing confidence trajectories in transformer models by leveraging the intrinsic magnification mechanism of deeper layers to amplify layer-wise confidence changes, enabling high-resolution analysis of model inference dynamics.
A quantitative cognitive effort metric for LLMs derived from the divergence pattern of confidence trajectories between complex and simple tasks, providing a measurable indicator of task complexity.

A diagnostic technique using HyperLens to detect and quantify the reduction of cognitive effort caused by standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), enabling identification of performance degradation mechanisms in fine-tuned models.
A system for real-time monitoring of LLM inference confidence trajectories across layers, producing fine-grained confidence maps that reveal model reasoning patterns and task difficulty levels.
idea_ch: 一种利用Transformer深层内在放大机制追踪逐层置信度轨迹的高分辨率分析方法，通过放大微小置信度变化实现对模型推理动态的精细解析。
一种基于置信度轨迹分歧模式的LLM认知努力量化指标，利用复杂任务与简单任务间的轨迹差异建立可测量的任务复杂度评估方法。
一种使用HyperLens探针检测标准SFT导致认知努力降低的诊断技术，用于识别微调模型中性能退化的机制性原因。
一种跨层LLM推理置信度轨迹的实时监控系统，生成细粒度置信度图谱以揭示模型推理模式和任务难度级别。

title: Best Arm Identification in Generalized Linear Bandits via Hybrid Feedback
summary: We study fixed-confidence best arm identification in generalized linear bandits under a hybrid feedback model: at each round, the learner may query either (i) absolute reward feedback from a single arm or (ii) relative (dueling) feedback from an arm pair, both governed by generalized linear models. We introduce a likelihood-ratio--based confidence sequence that unifies heterogeneous generalized linear observations and yields an explicit ellipsoidal confidence set under a self-concordance assumption. Building on this confidence set, we propose a hybrid Track-and-Stop algorithm that adaptively allocates queries by tracking a minimax-optimal design over a joint action space of arms and pairs. We establish $δ$-correctness and provide high-probability upper bounds on the stopping time. We further extend the framework to a cost-aware setting that accounts for heterogeneous acquisition costs across feedback modalities. Empirical experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithms significantly improve sample efficiency over baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义线性bandits中固定置信度的最优臂识别问题，提出了一种混合反馈模型（绝对奖励+相对比较反馈），并基于似然比置信序列设计了混合Track-and-Stop算法，在理论上保证了δ正确性并给出了停止时间上界，实验证明其样本效率显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有最优臂识别研究大多局限于单一反馈类型，无法充分利用混合反馈信息（如同时存在绝对奖励和相对比较反馈）。此外，不同反馈模态的采集成本往往不同，需要一种能在统一框架下处理异构反馈并优化成本效率的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于似然比的置信序列，统一处理广义线性模型下的异构观测（绝对奖励和相对比较反馈）；2) 基于自洽性假设推导显式椭球置信集；3) 设计混合Track-and-Stop算法，在臂和臂对的联合行动空间上追踪极小化最优设计，自适应分配查询；4) 扩展到考虑不同反馈模态采集成本的成本感知框架。
AI.result: 理论结果：证明了算法的δ正确性，并给出了高概率意义下的停止时间上界。实验结果表明：所提算法在样本效率上显著优于基线方法，且成本感知版本能有效优化总采集成本。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的统一置信序列和混合Track-and-Stop算法有效融合了绝对奖励与相对比较两种反馈模式，为广义线性bandits中的最优臂识别提供了理论保证和实际性能提升，成本感知扩展进一步增强了实用性。
idea_en: A unified likelihood-ratio-based confidence sequence method for heterogeneous generalized linear observations that enables constructing explicit ellipsoidal confidence sets under self-concordance assumption.
A hybrid Track-and-Stop algorithm that adaptively allocates queries by tracking a minimax-optimal design over a joint action space of both arms and arm pairs.
A cost-aware framework for best arm identification that accounts for heterogeneous acquisition costs across different feedback modalities (absolute reward vs. relative comparison).
Method for unifying absolute reward feedback and dueling (relative) feedback under generalized linear models with provable δ-correctness guarantees.
idea_ch: 一种基于似然比的统一置信序列方法，用于异构广义线性观测，可在自洽性假设下构建显式椭球置信集。
一种混合Track-and-Stop算法，通过在臂和臂对的联合行动空间上追踪极小化最优设计，自适应分配查询资源。
一种成本感知的最优臂识别框架，能够处理不同反馈模态（绝对奖励vs相对比较）之间的异构采集成本。
在广义线性模型下统一绝对奖励反馈和相对比较反馈，并提供δ正确性保证的方法。

title: Evaluating Explainability in Safety-Critical ATR Systems: Limitations of Post-Hoc Methods and Paths Toward Robust XAI
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is increasingly rec ognized as essential for deploying machine learning systems in safety critical environments. In Automatic Target Recognition (ATR), where models operate on image, video, radar, and multisensor data, high pre dictive performance alone is insufficient. Model decisions must also be interpretable, reliable, and suitable for validation. This paper presents a structured evaluation of explainability methods in the context of safety-critical ATR systems: We identify major XAI paradigms, including saliency-based, attention-based, and surrogate ap proaches, as well as recent detection-aware extensions. Based on this, we formalize explainability as an assurance-oriented assessment problem, introduce a taxonomy, and assess these methods with respect to four key dimensions: interpretability, robustness, vulnerability to manipula tion, and suitability for validation and verification. The analysis identifies systematic limitations of current post-hoc explanation methods. In par ticular, we derive critical failure modes such as spurious explanations, instability under perturbations, and overtrust induced by visually con vincing outputs. These findings indicate that widely used XAI techniques may be insufficient for safety-critical deployment. Finally, we discuss implications for ATR systems and outline directions toward more robust, causally grounded, and physically informed explain ability methods. Our results emphasize the need to move beyond visually plausible explanations toward approaches that support reliable decision making and system-level assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了可解释人工智能（XAI）方法在安全关键型自动目标识别（ATR）系统中的应用，指出了当前事后解释方法存在虚假解释、扰动不稳定、过度信任等关键失效模式，并提出需要向更鲁棒、因果驱动和物理信息可解释性方法发展。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键的ATR系统中，模型不仅需要高预测性能，还需要可解释、可靠且可验证。现有XAI方法缺乏系统性的安全性评估框架。
AI.method: 论文提出一个以保障为导向的评估框架，识别主要XAI范式（显著性、注意力、替代方法等），并从可解释性、鲁棒性、抗操纵脆弱性、验证与确认适用性四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 发现当前事后解释方法存在系统性局限，包括虚假解释、扰动不稳定、视觉上令人信服但实际不可靠的输出导致过度信任等关键失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前广泛应用的事后XAI方法不足以支持安全关键部署，需要向因果驱动、物理信息更强的可解释性方法发展。
idea_en: A robustness-enhanced explanation generation method that evaluates and filters out spurious explanations by detecting instability under input perturbations in ATR systems.
A causality-driven XAI framework for safety-critical ATR that generates explanations grounded in causal inference rather than purely statistical correlations.
A physically informed explanation method that integrates domain-specific physical models (e.g., radar physics) into the explanation generation process for multi-sensor ATR systems.
An assurance-oriented explanation validation system that quantitatively assesses explanations across interpretability, robustness, and vulnerability dimensions for certification purposes.
An adversarial manipulation detection mechanism for XAI outputs in ATR, capable of identifying when explanations have been tampered with or are misleadingly visually convincing.
idea_ch: 一种鲁棒性增强的解释生成方法，通过检测输入扰动下的不稳定性来评估并过滤ATR系统中虚假解释的技术
面向安全关键ATR的因果驱动XAI框架，基于因果推断而非纯统计相关性生成解释的方法
物理信息引导的解释方法，将领域特定物理模型（如雷达物理）集成到多传感器ATR系统的解释生成流程中
以保障为导向的解释验证系统，从可解释性、鲁棒性和抗脆弱性三个维度定量评估解释质量，用于系统认证
ATR中XAI输出的对抗性操纵检测机制，能够识别解释是否被篡改或产生误导性视觉可信输出

title: Confidence is the key: how conformal prediction enhances the generative design of permeable peptides
summary: Generative models coupled with reinforcement learning (RL), such as REINVENT and PepINVENT, have emerged as a powerful framework for de novo molecular design. During the ideation process these generative frameworks utilize various predictive models as part of the optimization objectives. However, the utility of the predictive models can be limited by their domain of applicability. When RL is used to explore the chemical space with predictive models, it can suggest molecules that lie outside the predictor's domain of applicability. As a result, the predictions may become less reliable, potentially steering designs into high reward but also high uncertainty chemical spaces. This is particularly pronounced for cyclic peptides which show therapeutic promise due to their modifiability and large interaction surfaces but are understudied compared to small molecules. While passive membrane permeation in cyclic peptides has attracted interest, identifying optimal permeable designs remains challenging yet crucial for targeting intracellular sites. We present an RL-guided generative framework that designs permeable cyclic peptides using an uncertainty-aware permeability predictor as the scoring component. To address predictive uncertainty, especially impacted by novel chemistry, we integrate conformal prediction (CP) as our uncertainty quantification method. CP assesses designs based on the calibrated model under a user-defined confidence level. We demonstrate that rewarding generated peptides with CP-informed predictions improves both reliability and efficiency of peptide optimization process. This also discourages exploration outside the predictor's applicability domain. This approach bridges the gap between predictive uncertainty and RL-guided exploration, showing how generative modelling and conformal prediction can be combined for the first time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习(RL)与共形预测(CP)的生成框架，用于设计具有膜渗透性的环肽分子，通过不确定性感知的预测模型引导分子生成，避免探索超出预测模型适用域的高不确定性化学空间。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型结合RL进行分子设计时，预测模型的适用域有限，RL探索可能导致分子超出预测器适用范围，产生不可靠预测，尤其对于研究不足但具有治疗潜力的环肽分子而言，被动膜渗透性的优化设计面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出了RL引导的生成框架，利用不确定性感知的渗透性预测器作为评分组件，集成共形预测(CP)作为不确定性量化方法，在用户定义的置信水平下评估生成肽，奖励CP-informed预测的生成肽，提高优化过程的可靠性和效率。
AI.result: CP-informed预测的奖励机制提高了肽优化过程的可靠性和效率，抑制了超出预测器适用域的探索，弥合了预测不确定性与RL引导探索之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 首次将生成建模与共形预测相结合，为不确定性感知的RL引导分子设计提供了新范式，尤其适用于环肽等复杂分子的渗透性优化。
idea_en: A generative molecular design framework integrating reinforcement learning with conformal prediction (CP) for uncertainty-aware scoring of candidate molecules, where CP quantifies predictive uncertainty to guide exploration within the predictor's applicability domain.

A method for designing permeable cyclic peptides using an RL-guided generative model with an uncertainty-aware permeability predictor, where conformal prediction provides calibrated confidence intervals under a user-defined confidence level.

A reward mechanism for RL-based molecular generation that incorporates CP-informed predictions, penalizing molecules with high predictive uncertainty to discourage exploration outside the predictor's domain of applicability.

A system combining generative models and conformal prediction for de novo molecular design, where CP-based uncertainty quantification is used to filter or reweight candidate molecules during the iterative optimization process.
idea_ch: 一种将强化学习与共形预测(CP)相结合的生成式分子设计框架，通过CP量化预测不确定性，引导分子在预测器适用域内进行探索。
一种利用不确定性感知的渗透性预测器进行RL引导环肽设计的方法，其中共形预测在用户自定义置信水平下提供校准的置信区间。
一种基于CP信息的强化学习分子生成奖励机制，对高预测不确定性的分子进行惩罚，抑制超出预测器适用域的探索。
一种将生成模型与共形预测相结合的从头分子设计系统，在迭代优化过程中利用CP不确定性量化对候选分子进行过滤或重新加权。

title: CircuitFormer: A Circuit Language Model for Analog Topology Design from Natural Language Prompt
summary: Automating analog circuit design remains a longstanding challenge in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). While Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized software code generation, their application to analog hardware design is hindered by two critical limitations: (i) the scarcity of analog design datasets containing natural language description of a design and its corresponding netlist, and (ii) the inefficiency of general-purpose tokenizers (e.g., Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)) in capturing the inherent graph structure of circuits. To bridge this gap, first, we curate the largest annotated dataset of analog circuit netlists to date, comprising 31,341 netlist-natural language description pairs across all major circuit classes.
