Furthermore, we propose Circuit Tokenizer (CKT), a novel circuit graph tokenizer designed to encode netlist connectivity by explicitly mining frequent subcircuits. In terms of scalability, CKT overcomes the bottleneck of prior circuit graph serialization methods where vocabulary size scales linearly with maximum number of components in the dataset, n_max, (O(n_max)); instead, CKT decouples vocabulary growth from circuit complexity, achieving a constant O(1) complexity. Empirically, CKT outperforms standard BPE on circuit topology representation, reducing sequence length by 57% and achieving a 2.3x superior compression ratio using a compact, fixed vocabulary of size 512. Leveraging this optimized tokenization, we train a circuit-specific language model, CircuitFormer, a 511M parameter encoder-decoder transformer. Our model achieves 100% syntactic correctness and an 83% functional success rate across all major analog circuit categories, outperforming state-of-the-art open-source LLMs by 10% and 14%, respectively, while requiring 240x fewer parameters. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/touhid314/cktformer-dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CKT（电路分词器）和CircuitFormer，一个针对模拟电路设计自动化的新型方法。通过构建3.1万+注释数据集和基于频繁子图挖掘的电路专用分词器，显著提升了电路网表到自然语言描述的转换能力，实现了100%语法正确率和83%功能成功率，性能超越开源大模型，而参数量仅为其1/240。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路设计的自动化是EDA领域的长期挑战。虽然基于Transformer的LLM在代码生成方面取得突破，但应用到模拟硬件设计面临两个关键限制：(1)包含自然语言描述和对应网表的模拟设计数据集极度稀缺；(2)通用分词器（如BPE）无法有效捕捉电路固有的图结构信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建了迄今为止最大的带注释模拟电路网表数据集（31,341个网表-自然语言描述对）；2) 提出CKT（Circuit Tokenizer），一种新颖的电路图分词器，通过显式挖掘频繁子电路来编码网表连接关系，实现词汇表大小与电路复杂度解耦（O(1)复杂度）；3) 基于CKT分词训练了CircuitFormer，一个511M参数的编码器-解码器Transformer。
AI.result: CKT相比标准BPE在电路拓扑表示上：序列长度减少57%，压缩比提升2.3倍，仅需固定512词汇表。CircuitFormer在所有主要模拟电路类别上实现100%语法正确率和83%功能成功率，超越开源LLM 10%和14%，而参数量仅为后者的1/240。
AI.conclusion: 通过电路专用分词器和大规模标注数据集，有效解决了LLM在模拟电路设计自动化中的两大瓶颈，证明了专用化、轻量级模型在领域特定任务中相比通用大模型的显著优势。
idea_en: Circuit Tokenizer (CKT): A novel circuit graph tokenizer that explicitly mines frequent subcircuits from netlists to encode circuit connectivity, achieving O(1) vocabulary complexity independent of circuit size.
Method for decoupling vocabulary growth from circuit complexity in circuit graph serialization, where vocabulary size remains constant regardless of maximum number of components.

Circuit-specific language model (CircuitFormer) with 511M parameters using encoder-decoder transformer architecture, achieving 100% syntactic correctness and 83% functional success in analog circuit design.
Frequent subcircuit mining algorithm as a tokenization strategy for analog circuit netlists, enabling compact fixed vocabulary (size 512) for circuit representation.
Large-scale annotated dataset of 31,341 netlist-natural language description pairs across all major analog circuit classes.
idea_ch: CKT电路分词器：一种新颖的电路图分词方法，通过显式挖掘网表中的频繁子电路来编码电路连接关系，实现词汇表大小与电路复杂度解耦的O(1)复杂度。
电路图序列化中词汇表增长与电路复杂度解耦的方法：词汇表大小保持恒定，不随数据集最大组件数量线性增长。
CircuitFormer电路专用语言模型：511M参数的编码器-解码器Transformer架构，在模拟电路设计中实现100%语法正确率和83%功能成功率。
基于频繁子电路挖掘的网表分词策略：利用固定词汇表（512大小）实现电路的高效压缩表示，相比BPE序列长度减少57%、压缩比提升2.3倍。
大规模模拟电路网表-自然语言描述配对数据集构建方法：涵盖所有主要模拟电路类别的31,341个配对样本。

title: HEDP: A Hybrid Energy-Distance Prompt-based Framework for Domain Incremental Learning
summary: Domain Incremental Learning is a critical scenario that requires models to continuously adapt to new data domains without retraining. However, domain shifts often cause severe performance degradation. To address this, we propose Hybrid Energy-Distance Prompt, a domain-incremental framework inspired by Helmholtz free energy. HEDP introduces an energy regularization loss to enhance the separability of domain representations and a hybrid energy-distance weighted mechanism that fuses energy-based and distance-based cues to improve domain selection and generalization. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, including CORe50, show that HEDP achieves superior performance on unseen domains with a 2.57\% accuracy gain, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting and enhancing open-world adaptability. Our code is \href{https://github.com/dannis97500/HEDP/}{available here}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Helmholtz自由能的混合能量-距离提示框架(HEDP)，用于域增量学习，通过能量正则化损失和能量-距离加权机制提升域表示的可分离性和泛化能力，在CORe50等基准上取得2.57%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 域增量学习中域偏移会导致模型性能严重下降，现有方法在应对未知域和灾难性遗忘方面效果有限。
AI.method: 1) 能量正则化损失：基于Helmholtz自由能增强域表示的可分离性；2) 混合能量-距离加权机制：融合基于能量和基于距离的线索，改进域选择与泛化。
AI.result: 在包括CORe50在内的多个基准上，HEDP在未知域上取得2.57%的准确率提升，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，增强开放世界适应性。
AI.conclusion: HEDP框架通过能量视角为域增量学习提供了新思路，在域选择与泛化方面优于现有方法。
idea_en: A domain-incremental learning method using Helmholtz free energy as regularization to enhance domain representation separability
A hybrid energy-distance weighted mechanism that fuses energy-based and distance-based cues for improved domain selection and generalization
Energy regularization loss specifically designed to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in domain incremental learning scenarios
A prompt-based domain-incremental framework that leverages thermodynamic principles (Helmholtz free energy) for open-world domain adaptation
idea_ch: 基于Helmholtz自由能的能量正则化损失方法，通过热力学原理增强域增量学习中域表示的可分离性
混合能量-距离加权机制，融合能量基线索和距离基线索以优化域选择与泛化能力
一种专用于缓解域增量学习中灾难性遗忘的能量正则化损失函数设计
基于提示学习的域增量框架，结合热力学自由能原理实现开放世界域自适应

title: Von Neumann Networks
summary: In the mid-twentieth century, mathematician and polymath John von Neumann created a computational system on an array of cells as a simple model of the human brain, where each cell had one of a finite set of roles or states that he predicted would be modelled by a diffusion process. In this work, we show that such a system, when developed in a modern deep learning setting, enables the construction of an artificial neuron having specialized roles that can be learnt. We refer to this neuron as the Von Neumann neuron, and the resulting neural network from such neurons result in a self-engineered design whose architecture is only dependent on the structure and locations of its inputs and outputs on this cellular array. The mathematical framework for these Von Neumann Networks (VNNs) is also constructed and shows that they are based on the extension of neural operators and the learning of Green's functions with convolutions on a cellular topology having a diffusion signature. We also prove that these VNNs are part of a more general computational system called Cellular Machines that are computationally universal. Initial experiments show that VNN based multi-layered perceptrons outperform their equivalent deep learning variant on basic tasks, while being more parameter efficient and are capable of learning new types of tasks. This includes the ability to solve for and construct an extension of the Von Neumann (hardware) architecture common to all modern computers to cells and suggests new opportunities that could be explored.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于冯·诺依曼早期细胞阵列思想的现代深度学习神经元——冯·诺依曼神经元，并构建了冯·诺依曼网络（VNNs），该网络架构仅依赖于输入输出在细胞阵列上的位置和结构，在基础任务上优于传统MLP且参数效率更高。
AI.motivation: 受冯·诺依曼用细胞阵列模拟人脑的启发，希望在现代深度学习框架下构建一种可学习的、具有专业化角色的神经元，使网络架构能够自我设计，摆脱人工预定义结构。
AI.method: 1. 定义冯·诺依曼神经元，每个细胞具有可学习的专业化角色/状态；2. 基于神经算子（Neural Operators）和格林函数（Green's functions）学习扩展数学框架；3. 在细胞拓扑上通过卷积实现扩散特征建模；4. 构建冯·诺依曼网络（VNNs），证明其属于计算通用的细胞机器（Cellular Machines）范畴。
AI.result: VNN基础实验表明：（1）基于VNN的多层感知机在基础任务上优于传统深度学习变体；（2）参数效率更高；（3）能够学习新型任务，包括求解和构建冯·诺依曼硬件架构在细胞上的扩展。
AI.conclusion: VNNs是一种新的神经网络范式，架构自我工程设计，计算通用，为探索新型计算架构和深度学习模型提供了新方向。
idea_en: A self-engineering neural network architecture (Von Neumann Network) whose structure is determined solely by the locations and arrangements of inputs and outputs on a cellular array, eliminating the need for manually predefined network topologies.
A novel artificial neuron (Von Neumann neuron) with learnable specialized roles/states, implemented via a cellular array with a diffusion process signature in a deep learning framework.
A mathematical framework extending neural operators to cellular topologies by learning Green's functions with convolutions, enabling diffusion-based computation in neural networks.
A Cellular Machine architecture that is proven computationally universal, integrating von Neumann's cellular automaton concept with modern neural operators.
A method for extending the classic von Neumann computer hardware architecture to a cellular array using learnable diffusion processes, enabling hardware-software co-design at the cell level.
idea_ch: 一种自工程化神经网络架构（冯·诺依曼网络），其结构仅由输入输出在细胞阵列上的位置和布局决定，无需人工预定义网络拓扑。
一种具有可学习专业化角色/状态的新型人工神经元（冯·诺依曼神经元），在深度学习框架中通过具有扩散特征的细胞阵列实现。
一种将神经算子扩展到细胞拓扑的数学框架，通过带卷积的格林函数学习实现基于扩散的计算机制。
一种被证明为计算通用的细胞机器架构，将冯·诺依曼细胞自动机概念与现代神经算子相融合。
一种利用可学习扩散过程将经典冯·诺依曼计算机硬件架构扩展到细胞阵列的方法，实现细胞级别的软硬件协同设计。

title: Sheet as Token: A Graph-Enhanced Representation for Multi-Sheet Spreadsheet Understanding
summary: Workbook-scale spreadsheet understanding is increasingly important for language-model-based data analysis agents, but remains challenging because relevant information is often distributed across multiple sheets with heterogeneous schemas, layouts, and implicit relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically decompose spreadsheets into rows, columns, or blocks to improve scalability; however, such chunk-centric representations can fragment worksheets into isolated text spans and weaken global sheet-level semantics. We propose Sheet as Token, a graph-enhanced framework that treats each worksheet as a unified semantic unit for multi-sheet spreadsheet retrieval. Our method extracts schema-aware records from sheet names, column headers, representative values, and layout features, and encodes each worksheet into a compact dense token. Given a natural-language query, a Graph Retriever constructs a query-specific candidate graph over sheet tokens using semantic, query-conditioned, schema-consistency, and shape-compatibility relations, and composes these channels through a multi-stage graph transformer to retrieve supporting sheet sets. Experiments on a constructed multi-sheet spreadsheet corpus show that sheet-level tokenization learns stable representations, and that graph-enhanced cross-sheet reasoning improves listwise retrieval over a shallow graph baseline with limited additional graph-side computation. These results suggest that sheet-level tokenization is a promising abstraction for scalable multi-sheet spreadsheet understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出Sheet as Token框架，将每个工作表视为统一语义单元，通过图增强检索实现多工作表电子表格理解。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将电子表格分解为行/列/块导致语义碎片化，削弱全局工作表级语义，难以处理跨多表的信息检索。
AI.method: 1) 将每个工作表编码为紧凑密集token（提取表名、列头、代表值、布局特征）；2) 构建查询特定候选图（含语义、查询条件、模式一致性、形状兼容性四种关系）；3) 多阶段图Transformer组合上述通道进行支撑工作表集合检索。
AI.result: 工作表级token化学习到稳定表征；图增强跨表推理在列表检索任务上优于浅层图基线，且额外计算开销有限。
AI.conclusion: 工作表级token化是一种有前景的抽象方法，适用于可扩展的多工作表电子表格理解。
idea_en: Sheet-as-Token encoding: representing each worksheet as a compact dense token by extracting schema-aware records including sheet names, column headers, representative values, and layout features for multi-sheet retrieval.
Graph Retriever with multi-channel relations: constructing query-specific candidate graphs over sheet tokens using semantic, query-conditioned, schema-consistency, and shape-compatibility relations.
Multi-stage graph transformer for cross-sheet reasoning: composing multiple relation channels through a multi-stage graph transformer to retrieve supporting sheet sets.
Sheet-level tokenization for spreadsheet understanding: treating each worksheet as a unified semantic unit instead of chunking into rows/columns/blocks to preserve global sheet semantics.
idea_ch: Sheet-as-Token编码方法：通过提取表名、列头、代表值和布局特征等模式感知记录，将每个工作表编码为紧凑密集token，用于多工作表检索。
多通道关系图检索器：基于语义关系、查询条件关系、模式一致性关系和形状兼容性关系，构建查询特定的工作表token候选图。
多阶段图Transformer跨表推理：通过多阶段图Transformer组合多个关系通道，检索支撑工作表集合。
工作表级token化抽象：将每个工作表视为统一语义单元而非碎片化为行/列/块，保留全局工作表级语义信息。

title: Long-Horizon Q-Learning: Accurate Value Learning via n-Step Inequalities
summary: Off-policy, value-based reinforcement learning methods such as Q-learning are appealing because they can learn from arbitrary experience, including data collected by older policies or other agents. In practice, however, bootstrapping makes long-horizon learning brittle: estimation errors at later states propagate backward through temporal-difference (TD) updates and can compound over time. We propose long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which introduces a principled backstop against compounding error when learning the optimal action-value function. LQL builds on a prior optimality tightening observation: any realized action sequence lower-bounds what the optimal policy can achieve in expectation, so acting optimally earlier should not be worse than following the observed actions for several steps before switching to optimal behavior. Our contribution is to turn this inequality into a practical stabilization mechanism for Q-learning by using a hinge loss to penalize violations of these bounds. Importantly, LQL computes these penalties using network outputs already produced for the TD error, requiring no auxiliary networks and no additional forward passes relative to Q-learning. When combined with multiple state-of-the-art methods on a range of online and offline-to-online benchmarks, LQL consistently outperforms both 1-step TD and n-step TD learning at similar runtime.

title: AGPO: Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization for Verifiable Reasoning and Search Ads Relevance at JD
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated notable success in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal that while current RLVR methods improve sampling efficiency towards correct paths, they do not elicit fundamentally new reasoning patterns. Instead, the reasoning capability boundary of trained models often narrows compared to their base models, with base models achieving higher coverage at large sample sizes. In this work, we propose Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization (AGPO) to counteract this boundary shrinkage. AGPO adopts a negative-dominant reinforcement strategy to suppress incorrect reasoning paths, maintaining the base model's exploration capacity. For positive reinforcement, AGPO adopts a group advantage mechanism, which scales positive updates based on intra-group variance, allowing the model to focus on rare correct paths while suppressing updates from trivial paths. Our experiments on five mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that AGPO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while consistently improving pass@$k$ performance at scale. In a large-scale industrial application for search ads relevance optimization, AGPO effectively enhances the quality of the data annotation, leading to substantial performance gains in downstream student models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非对称组策略优化（AGPO），通过负向主导强化策略抑制错误推理路径，同时采用组优势机制基于组内方差调整正向更新，在保持基础模型探索能力的同时提升推理准确性，在数学基准和搜索广告工业应用中取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法虽然提升了对正确路径的采样效率，但未能激发全新推理模式，反而使训练模型的推理能力边界相比基础模型有所收缩（边界收缩问题），基础模型在较大采样量下反而覆盖度更高。
AI.method: 提出非对称组策略优化（AGPO），包含两个核心机制：(1) 负向主导强化策略：抑制错误推理路径；(2) 组优势机制：基于组内方差缩放正向更新，使模型聚焦于罕见正确路径，同时抑制平凡路径的更新。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上取得SOTA准确率，且持续提升pass@k性能。在搜索广告相关性优化的工业大规模应用中，有效提升数据标注质量，显著改善下游学生模型性能。
AI.conclusion: AGPO通过非对称的正负强化设计，在不牺牲基础模型探索能力的前提下，有效缓解了RLVR训练中的推理边界收缩问题，兼具学术价值和工业应用潜力。
idea_en: Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization (AGPO) with a negative-dominant reinforcement strategy that suppresses incorrect reasoning paths while maintaining exploration capacity of the base model
Group advantage mechanism that scales positive updates based on intra-group variance, enabling focus on rare correct paths while suppressing trivial path updates
Application of AGPO for search ads relevance optimization to enhance data annotation quality and downstream student model performance
idea_ch: 非对称组策略优化（AGPO）：采用负向主导强化策略抑制错误推理路径，同时保持基础模型的探索能力，解决RLVR训练中的推理边界收缩问题
组优势机制：基于组内方差动态缩放正向更新，使模型聚焦于罕见正确路径，抑制平凡路径的更新，实现精细化正向强化
将AGPO应用于搜索广告相关性优化：通过增强数据标注质量，显著提升下游学生模型在广告相关性任务中的性能表现

title: MolRecBench-Wild: A Real-World Benchmark for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) aims to translate molecular diagrams in scientific literature into machine-readable formats, but current systems remain unreliable on real-world images due to substantial visual and chemical complexity. We introduce MOSAIC, a dual-dimensional difficulty framework with 37 fine-grained labels that jointly characterize visual interference and chemical semantic challenges in molecular diagrams. Based on this framework, we construct MolRecBench-Wild, a benchmark of 5,029 structures from 820 recent chemistry papers, covering the full difficulty spectrum observed in real publications. To enable faithful semantic evaluation beyond SMILES and MolFile, we propose CARBON, a representation language capable of expressing valence variations, icon-based groups, and other non-standard chemical semantics. We further adopt a dual-track evaluation protocol supporting both CARBON and SMILES outputs for broad model compatibility. Comprehensive experiments over 18 OCSR-capable models reveal severe performance degradation on MolRecBench-Wild, exposing a large gap between previous patent benchmarks and real-world academic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOSAIC双维度难度框架（含37个细粒度标签），构建了包含5029个分子结构的MolRecBench-Wild基准，并提出CARBON表征语言用于忠实评估，通过对18个OCSR模型的实验揭示了现有系统在真实学术场景中的严重性能下降。
AI.motivation: 当前光学化学结构识别（OCSR）系统在真实世界图像上表现不可靠，由于存在显著的视觉和化学复杂性，而现有基准无法充分反映实际学术出版场景中的难度分布。
AI.method: 1) 提出MOSAIC双维度难度框架，包含37个细粒度标签，联合表征视觉干扰和化学语义挑战；2) 基于该框架构建MolRecBench-Wild基准，包含来自820篇近期化学论文的5029个结构；3) 提出CARBON表征语言，能够表达价态变化、图标基团等非标准化学语义；4) 采用支持CARBON和SMILES输出的双轨评估协议。
AI.result: 在18个OCSR模型上的实验表明，在MolRecBench-Wild上出现严重性能下降，揭示了以往专利基准与真实学术场景之间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有OCSR系统在真实学术场景中远不可靠，需要更具挑战性的基准和更鲁棒的识别方法。
idea_en: A dual-dimensional difficulty framework (MOSAIC) with 37 fine-grained labels that jointly characterize visual interference and chemical semantic challenges for molecular diagram analysis
A representation language (CARBON) capable of expressing valence variations, icon-based groups, and non-standard chemical semantics beyond conventional SMILES and MolFile formats
A dual-track evaluation protocol supporting both CARBON and SMILES outputs for broad model compatibility in OCSR tasks
MolRecBench-Wild: a benchmark dataset of 5,029 molecular structures from 820 recent chemistry papers covering the full difficulty spectrum of real-world academic publications
idea_ch: 一种双维度难度框架（MOSAIC），包含37个细粒度标签，联合表征分子图中的视觉干扰和化学语义挑战
一种表征语言（CARBON），能够表达价态变化、图标基团及其他非标准化学语义，超越传统SMILES和MolFile格式
一种双轨评估协议，支持CARBON和SMILES两种输出格式，实现广泛模型兼容性的OCSR任务评估方法
MolRecBench-Wild基准数据集：包含来自820篇近期化学论文的5029个分子结构，覆盖真实学术出版物中完整的难度谱系

title: On the Role of Language Representations in Auto-Bidding: Findings and Implications
summary: Auto-bidding is a crucial task in real-time advertising markets, where policies must optimize long-horizon value under delivery constraints (e.g., budget and CPA). Existing methods for auto-bidding rely on compact numerical state representations: while they can implicitly capture delivery dynamics, they offer limited support for explicitly representing and controlling high-level intent, evolving feedback, and operator-style strategic guidance in real campaigns. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a powerful method for encoding semantic information, it remains unclear when LLMs help and how to integrate them without sacrificing numerical precision. Through systematic preliminary studies, we find that (1) LLM embeddings contain bidding-relevant cues yet cannot replace numerical features, and (2) gains emerge only with careful semantic--numeric integration rather than naive concatenation. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textit{SemBid}, a novel auto-bidding framework that injects LLM-encoded semantics into offline bidding trajectories at the token level. SemBid introduces three semantic inputs: \textit{Task}, \textit{History}, and \textit{Strategy}. It injects these semantics as tokens alongside numerical trajectory tokens and uses self-attention to integrate them, improving controllability and generalization across objectives. Across diverse scenarios and budget regimes, SemBid outperforms competitive baselines from offline RL and generative sequence modeling, with more consistent gains in overall performance, constraint satisfaction, and robustness. Our code is available at: \href{https://github.com/AlanYu04/SemBid-KDD2026}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: SemBid是一个将大语言模型语义编码注入自动出价框架的新方法，通过引入任务、历史和策略三种语义输入，在token级别与数值轨迹特征融合，利用自注意力机制实现语义-数值集成，显著提升出价策略的长期价值优化、约束满足和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动出价方法依赖紧凑的数值状态表示，虽然能隐式捕获投放动态，但缺乏对高层意图、演化反馈和操作员式策略指导的显式表示与控制能力。大语言模型虽能编码语义信息，但如何在不牺牲数值精度的情况下与自动出价系统集成尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出SemBid框架，在离线出价轨迹的token级别注入LLM编码的语义信息，包括三种语义输入：Task（任务描述）、History（历史反馈）、Strategy（策略指导）。将这些语义作为token与数值轨迹token拼接，通过自注意力机制实现语义与数值的融合集成。
AI.result: 在多种场景和预算条件下，SemBid在整体性能、约束满足和鲁棒性方面均优于离线强化学习和生成式序列建模的基线方法，且改进具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM嵌入包含出价相关的有用线索但不能替代数值特征，语义-数值的精心集成（而非简单拼接）才能带来性能提升。SemBid通过token级语义注入有效提升了自动出价的可控性和泛化能力。
idea_en: A method for integrating LLM semantic embeddings with numerical trajectory features at token level via self-attention mechanism for auto-bidding in advertising markets.
A structured semantic input framework for auto-bidding comprising three semantic types: Task (high-level objective), History (evolving feedback), and Strategy (operator-style guidance).

A token-level semantic injection technique that encodes offline bidding trajectories with LLM-generated semantic tokens, enabling explicit representation and control of high-level intent in real-time bidding.
A multi-modal fusion approach for auto-bidding that combines numerical trajectory tokens with semantic tokens through shared self-attention layers, avoiding naive concatenation.
idea_ch: 一种在token级别通过自注意力机制将大语言模型语义嵌入与数值轨迹特征融合的自动出价方法
一种包含三种语义输入的结构化语义框架：Task（高层目标语义）、History（演化反馈语义）、Strategy（操作员式策略语义）
一种token级语义注入技术，利用LLM生成的语义token对离线出价轨迹进行编码，实现实时竞价中高层意图的显式表达与控制
一种面向自动出价的数值-语义多模态融合方法，通过共享自注意力层联合建模数值轨迹token和语义token，避免简单拼接带来的性能损失

title: Taklif.AI: LLM-Powered Platform for Interest-Based Personalized College Assignments
summary: Educators face significant challenges in creating engaging, personalized assignments that accommodate students' diverse interests and cognitive abilities. Traditional one-size-fits-all assignments frequently lead to decreased student engagement and increased reliance on unethical practices such as plagiarism. To address these challenges, we present Taklif.AI, a platform that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate personalized assignments tailored to individual student interests. Unlike existing AI-powered educational platforms that personalize based on academic performance metrics alone, Taklif.AI incorporates students' extracurricular interests and cultural contexts into the assignment generation process through a structured prompt engineering pipeline with input and output guardrails. The platform employs a serverless architecture on AWS with Next.js, using Llama 3.3 70B as the primary LLM via LiteLLM for multi-provider load balancing and LangChain for prompt orchestration. We describe the system architecture, the prompt design methodology, and the guardrails framework that ensures output quality. Preliminary user acceptance testing with 68 participants (65 students and 3 educators) indicates positive reception, with 84% of participants rating the personalization feature as beneficial. We discuss the platform's current capabilities and limitations, and outline directions for rigorous empirical evaluation of learning outcomes.

AI.tldr: Taklif.AI是一个利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成个性化作业的平台，通过融入学生的课外兴趣和文化背景，而非仅依赖学术表现指标，来提升学生参与度并减少抄袭行为。初步测试显示84%的参与者认可其个性化功能。
AI.motivation: 传统"一刀切"式作业导致学生参与度下降、抄袭行为增加，教育者缺乏有效工具生成兼顾学生兴趣与认知能力的个性化作业。
AI.method: 构建Taklif.AI平台，使用Llama 3.3 70B大语言模型，通过结构化提示工程管道（含输入/输出护栏）将学生课外兴趣和文化背景融入作业生成；采用AWS无服务器架构、Next.js前端、LiteLLM多提供商负载均衡和LangChain提示编排。
AI.result: 68名参与者（65名学生+3名教育者）的初步用户接受测试显示84%认为个性化功能有益，系统获积极反馈。
AI.conclusion: Taklif.AI展示了将学生兴趣与文化背景融入AI生成作业的可行性和积极效果，但需进一步严格评估学习成果。
idea_en: A structured prompt engineering pipeline with input and output guardrails for LLM-based personalized assignment generation incorporating student extracurricular interests and cultural contexts.
A serverless architecture combining Next.js, AWS, LiteLLM multi-provider load balancing, and LangChain for scalable AI-powered personalized education content generation.
A method of automated assignment personalization using LLMs that goes beyond academic performance metrics to include students' non-academic interests and cultural background.
idea_ch: 一种基于大语言模型的个性化作业生成结构化提示工程管道，包含输入和输出护栏机制，可融入学生课外兴趣和文化背景。
一种结合Next.js、AWS、LiteLLM多提供商负载均衡和LangChain的无服务器架构，用于可扩展的AI驱动个性化教育内容生成。
一种超越传统学术表现指标，利用大语言模型将学生非学术兴趣和文化背景纳入作业自动个性化的方法。

title: AirQualityBench: A Realistic Evaluation Benchmark for Global Air Quality Forecasting
summary: Air-quality forecasting models are commonly evaluated on regional, preprocessed, and normalized datasets, where missing observations are removed or artificially completed. Such protocols simplify comparison but hide the conditions that dominate real monitoring networks: uneven global coverage, structured missingness, heterogeneous pollutant scales, and deployment cost. We introduce \textbf{AirQualityBench}, a global multi-pollutant benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models under these realistic conditions. The benchmark contains hourly observations from 3,720 monitoring stations over 2021--2025, covers six major pollutants, and preserves provider-native observation masks. Rather than imputing a dense data tensor, AirQualityBench exposes missingness as part of the forecasting problem and reports errors on valid future observations after inverse transformation to physical concentration scales. Evaluating representative spatio-temporal models under this unified protocol shows that strong performance on sanitized datasets does not reliably transfer to global, fragmented monitoring streams. AirQualityBench therefore serves as a realistic testbed for scalable, mask-aware, and physically interpretable air-quality forecasting. All benchmark data, code, evaluation scripts, and baseline implementations are available at \href{https://github.com/Star-Learning/AirQualityBench}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AirQualityBench，一个面向真实世界空气质量预测的全球多污染物基准测试平台，涵盖3720个监测站、6种主要污染物，保留原始缺失模式而非插补处理，揭示了现有模型在标准化数据集上的表现无法可靠迁移到现实碎片化监测场景的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的空气质量预测模型多在被预处理和归一化的区域数据集上评估，缺失观测被移除或人为补全，这简化了比较但隐藏了真实监测网络中的关键问题：全球覆盖不均、结构化缺失、污染物尺度异质以及部署成本。
AI.method: 构建包含2021-2025年3720个监测站每小时观测数据的全球多污染物基准，保留提供者原始缺失掩码，不进行密集张量插补，将缺失性作为预测问题的一部分，并在逆变换到物理浓度尺度后仅在有效未来观测上报告误差。
AI.result: 代表性时空模型在该统一协议下的评估表明，在清理过的数据集上的强性能并不能可靠地迁移到全球碎片化监测流中。
AI.conclusion: AirQualityBench可作为可扩展、掩码感知且物理可解释的空气质量预测的真实测试平台。
idea_en: A method for evaluating air-quality forecasting models that treats missing observations as part of the prediction problem rather than imputing them, using provider-native observation masks.
A global multi-pollutant benchmark system that preserves raw missingness patterns across 3,720 monitoring stations for realistic model evaluation.
An evaluation protocol that reports prediction errors only on valid future observations after inverse transformation to physical concentration scales, avoiding artificial data completion.
A mask-aware spatio-temporal forecasting approach designed to handle structured missingness in global monitoring networks.
A system for heterogeneous pollutant scale handling across multiple pollutant types (O3, NO2, CO, SO2, PM2.5, PM10) with preserved observation masks.
idea_ch: 一种将缺失观测作为预测问题一部分而非进行插补的空气质量预测模型评估方法，使用提供者原始观测掩码。
一种保持3720个监测站原始缺失模式的全球多污染物基准测试系统，用于真实场景下的模型评估。
一种仅在逆变换到物理浓度尺度后的有效未来观测上报告预测误差的评估协议，避免人工数据补全。
一种面向全球监测网络中结构化缺失问题的掩码感知时空预测方法。
一种跨多种污染物类型（O3、NO2、CO、SO2、PM2.5、PM10）且保留观测掩码的异质污染物尺度处理系统。

title: SANEmerg: An Emergent Communication Framework for Semantic-aware Agentic AI Networking
comment: Accepted at IEEE/IFIP WiOpt Workshop, Columbus, OH, USA, June 2026
summary: Future networking systems are envisioned to become part of an agentic AI-native ecosystem in which a vast number of heterogeneous and specialized AI agents cooperate seamlessly to fulfill complex user requirements in real time. However, traditional networking paradigms are characterized by a rigid decoupling of communication and computation, which often leads to significant inefficiencies in large-scale agentic AI networking (AgentNet) systems. Emergent communication offers a novel solution by enabling autonomous agents that support task-specific signaling protocols for information exchange and collaborative coordination. In this paper, we consider a multi-agent emergent communication framework, tailored for semantic-aware AgentNet systems in which the user's semantic intent can be automatically detected, inferred, and linked to a set of sub-tasks to be assigned to a set of agents. We investigate how communication and signaling protocols can emerge among collaborative agents with computationally bounded intelligence under stringent bandwidth constraints. Our proposed framework, called SANEmerg, is designed to facilitate the emergence of communication for collaborative task fulfillment while adhering to the physical limits of AgentNet. SANEmerg incorporates a bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter that dynamically prioritizes the transmission of higher-contribution message dimensions, ensuring robust performance in bandwidth-limited environments. Furthermore, SANEmerg integrates a complexity-regularizer grounded in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle to facilitate the emergence of computationally bounded signaling. Evaluated via an AgentNet prototype and extensive experimentation, SANEmerg demonstrates significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art solutions, achieving superior task accuracy while significantly reducing bandwidth and computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SANEmerg框架，面向智能体AI原生网络（AgentNet），通过带宽自适应重要性过滤器和基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的复杂度正则化器，实现语义感知的多智能体紧急通信，在带宽受限环境下高效协作完成任务。
AI.motivation: 传统网络范式将通信与计算刚性解耦，导致大规模智能体AI网络（AgentNet）效率低下，难以满足异构专业化AI智能体实时协作完成复杂用户需求的目标。
AI.method: 提出SANEmerg框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 带宽自适应重要性过滤器（bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter），动态优先传输高贡献消息维度；(2) 基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的复杂度正则化器，促进计算有界信令的涌现。
AI.result: 通过AgentNet原型和大量实验，SANEmerg在任务准确率上显著优于现有方案，同时大幅降低了带宽和计算开销。
AI.conclusion: SANEmerg证明了在带宽受限环境下，通过自适应重要性过滤和MDL复杂度正则化，可以有效实现智能体间通信协议的涌现，为大规模AgentNet系统提供了高效协作的解决方案。
idea_en: 1. A bandwidth-adaptable importance-filter for dynamic prioritization of message dimensions in multi-agent emergent communication systems.
2. A complexity-regularizer based on Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle for computationally bounded signaling emergence in agentic networks.
3. A semantic-aware multi-agent framework (SANEmerg) that automatically detects, infers, and links user's semantic intent to sub-tasks for agent assignment in agentic AI-native networking systems.
4. An integrated system combining bandwidth-adaptive filtering and MDL-based regularization for efficient emergent communication under physical bandwidth constraints.
idea_ch: 1. 一种带宽自适应重要性过滤器，用于多智能体紧急通信系统中消息维度的动态优先级排序。
2. 基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理的复杂度正则化器，用于智能体网络中计算有界信令的涌现。
3. 一种语义感知的多智能体框架（SANEmerg），可自动检测、推断用户语义意图并将其链接到子任务，分配给AgentNet中的智能体。
4. 一种结合带宽自适应过滤与MDL正则化的集成系统，用于在物理带宽约束下实现高效紧急通信。

title: XDecomposer: Learning Prior-Free Set Decomposition for Multiphase X-ray Diffraction
summary: Multiphase powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) analysis remains a fundamental bottleneck in structure identification, as real-world synthesis often produces complex mixtures whose constituent phases (components) cannot be reliably disentangled. While recent advances in representation-based crystal retrieval and generation suggest the possibility of inferring structures directly from PXRD, existing approaches largely assume single-phase inputs and break down in multiphase settings. Here, we present XDecomposer, a prior-free framework for joint decomposition and identification of multiphase XRD patterns without requiring candidate phase lists, structural templates, or prior knowledge of phase number. We formulate multiphase diffraction analysis as a set prediction problem, where the model infers an unordered set of phase-resolved components, their mixture proportions, and corresponding structural representations within a unified architecture. A phase-query-driven decomposition mechanism, together with diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction, enables accurate source separation while preserving crystallographic fidelity. Extensive experiments on both simulated and experimental datasets show that XDecomposer substantially improves reconstruction accuracy and phase identification across diverse chemical systems, while maintaining strong generalization to unseen mixtures. These results provide a practical route toward data-driven, source-resolved multiphase XRD analysis and reduce long-standing dependence on prior-guided iteratively phase matching. The code is openly available at https://github.com/Licht0812/XDecomposer

AI.tldr: 提出XDecomposer框架，无需先验知识即可对多相粉末X射线衍射图谱进行联合分解与物相识别，将多相衍射分析建模为集合预测问题。
AI.motivation: 实际合成常产生复杂多相混合物，现有方法大多假设单相输入，无法处理多相衍射图谱的分解与识别问题。
AI.method: 将多相衍射分析建模为集合预测问题，采用相位查询驱动分解机制与衍射一致的物理重构，在统一架构中同时推断无序的相分解组分、混合比例及对应的结构表示。
AI.result: 在模拟和实验数据集上，XDecomposer显著提升了重构精度和物相识别能力，在多种化学体系中展现出对未知混合物的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 为数据驱动的多相XRD源分解分析提供了实用路径，减少了对先验引导迭代相位匹配的长期依赖。
idea_en: A prior-free set prediction framework for multiphase XRD pattern decomposition that jointly infers phase components, mixture proportions, and crystal structures without phase list or templates.
A phase-query-driven decomposition mechanism with diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction that ensures accurate source separation while preserving crystallographic fidelity.
A unified neural architecture that transforms multiphase powder diffraction analysis into an unordered set prediction problem, enabling generalization to unseen mixtures.
idea_ch: 一种无需先验知识的多相XRD图谱分解集合预测框架，可在没有物相列表或结构模板的情况下联合推断相组分、混合比例及晶体结构。
一种相位查询驱动的分解机制，结合衍射一致性物理重构，在保持晶体学保真度的同时实现精确的源分离。
一种统一的神经网络架构，将多相粉末衍射分析转化为无序集合预测问题，能够泛化至未见过的混合体系。

title: Agentic, Context-Aware Risk Intelligence in the Internet of Value
summary: The Internet of Value (IoV) is a heterogeneous, partially-trusted network in which the dominant marginal risk is composite (route, sentiment, liquidity, and the policy a system is willing to commit to) rather than a property of any single chain. We argue that a risk primitive adequate for this regime is a composition of five engines: a prediction engine over price, liquidity, volatility, and route health; a Bittensor verification subnet that decentralises and economically scores prediction outputs; a sentiment-fusion engine over text, on-chain flow, and grey-literature feeds; an agentic engine under constitutional, role-bound action constraints; and an API-risk and scenario engine that converts forecasts into pre-committed action programs in the sense of Monte-Carlo scenario generation. We anchor the architecture in two empirical artefacts: a 27-hour policy-constrained liquidity stress-response experiment on Solana, and a 168-hour prediction-router calibration arc reported with explicit class-imbalance honesty. The case study supports deployability; the validator-loss decomposition is stated formally and is falsifiable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向价值互联网（IoV）的复合风险基元架构，由预测引擎、Bittensor验证子网、情感融合引擎、智能体引擎和API风险场景引擎五部分构成，并基于Solana上的实证实验验证了其可部署性。
AI.motivation: 价值互联网（IoV）是一个异构、部分可信的网络，其主要边际风险是复合性的（路由、情绪、流动性和政策），而非单一链的属性。现有风险框架无法有效处理这种复合风险，需要一种新的风险基元。
AI.method: 提出了由五个引擎组成的复合风险基元架构：(1) 价格、流动性、波动率和路由健康的预测引擎；(2) Bittensor验证子网，去中心化并经济性评分预测输出；(3) 基于文本、链上流量和灰色文献的情感融合引擎；(4) 在宪法和角色约束下的智能体引擎；(5) API风险和场景引擎，将预测转化为蒙特卡洛预承诺行动程序。在Solana上进行了27小时政策约束流动性压力响应实验和168小时预测-路由校准实验。
AI.result: 实证案例支持该架构的可部署性；形式化地提出了验证器损失分解，且是可证伪的。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为该五引擎复合风险基元适用于IoV环境，并提供了可部署性的实证支撑和形式化的验证器损失分解理论。
idea_en: A composite risk primitive architecture comprising five engines (prediction, Bittensor verification subnet, sentiment-fusion, agentic engine under constitutional constraints, API-risk and scenario engine) for Internet of Value networks.
A decentralized verification mechanism using Bittensor subnet to economically score prediction outputs in heterogeneous partially-trusted networks.
A sentiment-fusion engine that integrates text, on-chain flow, and grey-literature feeds for risk assessment in IoV.
A method for converting forecasts into pre-committed action programs using Monte-Carlo scenario generation under constitutional role-bound constraints.
A policy-constrained liquidity stress-response experimental framework demonstrated on Solana blockchain (27-hour duration).
A prediction-router calibration method with explicit class-imbalance honesty reporting over a 168-hour evaluation arc.
idea_ch: 一种面向价值互联网（IoV）的复合风险基元架构，由预测引擎、Bittensor验证子网、情感融合引擎、宪法约束智能体引擎和API风险场景引擎五部分组成
利用Bittensor子网对异构部分可信网络中的预测输出进行去中心化经济评分的验证机制
融合文本、链上流量和灰色文献的情感融合引擎，用于IoV风险评估
基于蒙特卡洛场景生成将预测转化为宪法角色约束下预承诺行动程序的方法
在Solana区块链上实施的27小时政策约束流动性压力响应实验框架
在168小时评估周期内具有显式类别不平衡诚实报告的预测-路由器校准方法

title: Null Space Constrained Contrastive Visual Forgetting for MLLM Unlearning
summary: The core challenge of machine unlearning is to strike a balance between target knowledge removal and non-target knowledge retention. In the context of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), this challenge becomes even more pronounced, as knowledge is further divided into visual and textual modalities that are tightly intertwined. In this paper, we introduce an MLLM unlearning approach that aims to forget target visual knowledge while preserving non-target visual knowledge and all textual knowledge. Specifically, we freeze the LLM backbone and achieve unlearning by fine-tuning the visual module. First, we propose a Contrastive Visual Forgetting (CVF) mechanism to separate target visual knowledge from retained visual knowledge, guiding the representations of target visual concepts toward appropriate regions in the feature space. Second, we identify the null space associated with retained knowledge and constrain the unlearning process within this space, thereby significantly mitigating degradation in knowledge retention. Third, beyond static unlearning scenarios, we extend our approach to continual unlearning, where forgetting requests arrive sequentially. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves a strong balance between effective forgetting and robust knowledge retention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的机器遗忘方法，通过冻结LLM骨干网络、微调视觉模块，在遗忘目标视觉知识的同时保留非目标视觉知识和所有文本知识，并扩展到持续遗忘场景。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态大语言模型中机器遗忘的核心挑战——在移除目标知识（视觉模态）与保留非目标知识（其他视觉及文本模态）之间取得平衡，因为多模态知识紧密交织，传统方法难以精准分离。
AI.method: 1) 冻结LLM骨干，仅微调视觉模块实现遗忘；2) 提出对比视觉遗忘（CVF）机制，将目标视觉知识与保留视觉知识在特征空间中分离；3) 识别保留知识的零空间，约束遗忘过程在该空间内进行，减少知识保留的退化；4) 扩展至持续遗忘场景，处理顺序到达的遗忘请求。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法在有效遗忘与稳健知识保留之间取得了强平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结LLM、CVF机制和零空间约束，成功实现了多模态大语言模型中对特定视觉知识的选择性遗忘，并支持持续遗忘请求，为MLLM的隐私保护与合规提供了可行的技术路径。
idea_en: A method for multimodal large language model unlearning by freezing the LLM backbone and fine-tuning only the visual module to forget target visual knowledge while preserving non-target visual and all textual knowledge.

A Contrastive Visual Forgetting (CVF) mechanism that separates target visual knowledge from retained visual knowledge by guiding target visual concept representations to specific regions in feature space.

A null space constraint technique that identifies the null space associated with retained knowledge and restricts the unlearning process within this space to mitigate degradation of knowledge retention.
An extension of the unlearning approach to continual unlearning scenarios where forgetting requests arrive sequentially.
idea_ch: 一种多模态大语言模型遗忘方法：冻结LLM骨干网络，仅通过微调视觉模块来实现遗忘目标视觉知识，同时保留非目标视觉知识和所有文本知识。
对比视觉遗忘（CVF）机制：通过将目标视觉概念的表示引导至特征空间中的特定区域，从而将目标视觉知识与需保留的视觉知识分离开来。
基于零空间的约束技术：识别与保留知识相关联的零空间，将遗忘过程约束在该空间内进行，显著减轻知识保留能力的退化。
持续遗忘场景的扩展方法：将遗忘方法扩展到持续遗忘场景，能够顺序处理相继到达的遗忘请求。

title: PREFER: Personalized Review Summarization with Online Preference Learning
summary: Product reviews significantly influence purchasing decisions on e-commerce platforms. However, the sheer volume of reviews can overwhelm users, obscuring the information most relevant to their specific needs. Current e-commerce summarization systems typically produce generic, static summaries that fail to account for the fact that (i) different users care about different product characteristics, and (ii) these preferences may evolve with interactions. To address the challenge of unknown latent preferences, we propose an online learning framework that generates personalized summaries for each user. Our system iteratively refines its understanding of user preferences by incorporating feedback directly from the generated summaries over time. We provide a case study using the Amazon Reviews'23 dataset, showing in controlled simulations that online preference learning improves alignment with target user interests while maintaining summary quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在线学习框架，通过迭代式用户反馈生成个性化商品评论摘要，动态适应用户的潜在偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有电商摘要系统生成通用静态摘要，无法满足不同用户对不同产品特性的差异化偏好，且无法随用户交互动态调整。
AI.method: 提出在线学习框架，通过从生成的摘要中直接收集用户反馈，迭代式地优化对用户偏好的理解，实时生成个性化摘要。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews'23数据集上的仿真实验表明，在线偏好学习能提升摘要与目标用户兴趣的匹配度，同时保持摘要质量。
AI.conclusion: 在线偏好学习能有效解决用户偏好未知且动态变化的挑战，实现个性化商品评论摘要生成。
idea_en: An online learning framework for personalized e-commerce review summarization that iteratively refines user preference understanding by incorporating feedback directly from generated summaries.
A dynamic preference modeling method that captures evolving user interests during interactions with review summaries on e-commerce platforms.
A feedback loop system where summary generation and user preference learning are coupled, allowing the system to adapt in real-time without requiring explicit user profile input.
idea_ch: 一种在线学习框架，通过从生成的摘要中直接收集用户反馈，迭代式优化用户偏好理解，实现个性化电商评论摘要生成。
一种动态偏好建模方法，能够在用户与评论摘要交互过程中捕捉其兴趣演变，避免依赖静态预定义偏好。
一种摘要生成与用户偏好学习耦合的反馈循环系统，无需用户显式输入偏好即可实现实时自适应个性化摘要。

title: Wisteria: A Unified Multi-Scale Feature Learning Framework for DNA Language Model
summary: DNA language model aims to decipher the regulatory grammar and semantic of genomes by capturing long range dependencies in DNA sequences. Existing methods emphasize long range token interactions but often ignore the interplay between local motifs and global dependencies. In this paper, we propose Wisteria, a genomic language model that integrates multi scale feature learning within a unified framework for DNA sequence. Specifically, Wisteria augments the Mamba based architecture with gated dilated convolutions to capture local motifs and regulatory patterns, while gated multilayer perceptrons refine global dependencies. We further introduce a Fourier based attention mechanism to support frequency domain modeling, periodic extension and length generalization. Across four experimental settings with both short and long range dependencies, Wisteria demonstrates strong performance on downstream benchmarks against competitive DNA language model baselines. These results indicate that Wisteria effectively unifies local and global dependency modeling for multi scale genomic sequence analysis.

AI.tldr: Wisteria是一个DNA语言模型，通过集成门控扩张卷积、门控多层感知机和傅里叶注意力机制，在统一框架中同时捕获局部基序和全局依赖关系，在多个基因组下游任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有DNA语言模型注重长程token交互，但忽略了局部基序与全局依赖之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 1) 在Mamba架构上增强门控扩张卷积以捕获局部基序和调控模式；2) 门控多层感知机精炼全局依赖；3) 引入基于傅里叶的注意力机制支持频域建模、周期延拓和长度泛化。
AI.result: 在短程和长程依赖的四个实验设置中，Wisteria在下游基准测试中优于竞争性DNA语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: Wisteria有效统一了局部和全局依赖建模，适用于多尺度基因组序列分析。
idea_en: A genomic language model that integrates gated dilated convolutions within a Mamba-based architecture to simultaneously capture local DNA motifs and long-range dependencies.
A Fourier-based attention mechanism for frequency domain modeling of DNA sequences, enabling periodic extension and improved length generalization.
A unified framework combining gated dilated convolutions for local pattern extraction and gated multilayer perceptrons for global dependency refinement in genomic sequence analysis.
Multi-scale feature learning architecture for DNA sequences that processes both short-range local regulatory patterns and long-range genomic dependencies in a single model.
idea_ch: 一种在Mamba架构中集成门控扩张卷积的基因组语言模型，可同时捕获局部DNA基序和长程依赖关系。
一种基于傅里叶的注意力机制，用于DNA序列的频域建模，支持周期延拓和改进的长度泛化能力。
一种统一框架，结合门控扩张卷积进行局部模式提取和门控多层感知机进行全局依赖精炼，用于基因组序列分析。
一种面向DNA序列的多尺度特征学习架构，在单一模型中同时处理短程局部调控模式和长程基因组依赖关系。

title: Intentmaking and Sensemaking: Human Interaction with AI-Guided Mathematical Discovery
summary: Artificial intelligence offers powerful new tools for scientific discovery, but the interaction paradigms required to effectively harness these systems remain underexplored. In this paper, we present findings from a formative user study with 11 expert mathematicians who used AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding agent, to tackle advanced problems in their fields of expertise. We identify and characterize a distinct workflow we term intentmaking, the iterative process of discovering, defining, and refining one's experimental goals through active system interaction. We frame this as a natural extension to sensemaking, the cognitive process of building an understanding of complex or novel data. We suggest that users enter a cycle of intentmaking (defining and updating their experiment) and sensemaking (interpreting the results) which repeats many times during the course of an investigation. Our documentation of these themes suggests an approach to designing AI tools for scientific discovery that goes beyond the existing question/answer model of many current systems, treating them as collaborative instruments rather than opaque black-box assistants.

AI.tldr: 通过对11位数学家使用进化编码智能体AlphaEvolve的实证研究，发现了一种名为"意图构建"(intentmaking)的新型工作流——用户在迭代中不断发现、定义和完善实验目标，并与意义建构(sensemaking)形成循环，为AI科学发现工具的设计提供了超越简单问答模式的新范式。
AI.motivation: 当前AI科学发现工具的人机交互范式仍不成熟，大多停留在简单的问答模式，缺乏对用户如何通过系统交互来定义和调整研究目标的深入理解。
AI.method: 对11位专家数学家使用进化编码智能体AlphaEvolve进行前沿数学问题研究的形成性用户研究，通过观察和记录用户的交互行为，分析其工作流模式。
AI.result: 识别并定义了"意图构建"(intentmaking)这一工作流，即用户通过主动系统交互来迭代发现、定义和完善实验目标；发现用户在研究中会进入意图构建与意义建构的循环过程。
AI.conclusion: AI科学发现工具应被设计为协作工具而非黑箱助手，超越当前主流的问答模式，以更好地支持用户的意图构建与意义建构循环。
idea_en: A method for iterative intent-making interaction in AI-assisted scientific discovery, where users dynamically define, refine, and evolve experimental goals through active engagement with an evolutionary coding agent system.

A dual-cycle interaction framework combining intentmaking (goal definition/update) and sensemaking (result interpretation) for AI scientific discovery tools, enabling collaborative human-AI research workflows.
An evolutionary coding agent design that supports non-linear, exploratory goal formation by allowing users to iteratively modify experimental parameters based on intermediate results.
idea_ch: 一种AI辅助科学发现中的迭代意图构建交互方法，用户通过与进化编码智能体系统的主动交互，动态定义、优化和演进实验目标。
一种结合意图构建(目标定义/更新)和意义建构(结果解释)的双循环交互框架，用于AI科学发现工具，实现人机协作的研究工作流。
一种支持非线性探索性目标形成的进化编码智能体设计，允许用户根据中间结果迭代修改实验参数。

title: Which Are the Low-Resource Languages of the Semantic Web?
comment: ESWC 2026 - 23rd European Semantic Web Conference, May 2026, Dubrovnik, Croatia
summary: Emerging digital technologies are exacerbating the existing divide in Open Access Data (OAD) between high-and low-resource languages, excluding many communities from the global digital transformation. Multilingual Linked Open Data Knowledge Graphs (LOD KGs) could contribute to mitigating this divide through cross-lingual transfer; however, no clear quantitative definition of low-resource languages has yet been established in the context of LOD KGs. In this poster, we present a methodology to analyze the distribution of languages across LOD KGs and propose a preliminary multi-level categorization based on DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata. This categorization is leveraged to bring a formal definition of low-, high-, and medium-resource languages that could be later leveraged to select cross-lingual transfer candidates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于DBpedia、BabelNet和Wikidata的多级语言分类方法，用于定义LOD知识图谱中的低资源语言、高资源语言和中等资源语言，以解决数字技术加剧的开放获取数据语言鸿沟问题。
AI.motivation: 新兴数字技术正在加剧高低资源语言之间在开放获取数据（OAD）方面的鸿沟，使得许多社区被排除在全球数字转型之外。多语言关联开放数据知识图谱（LOD KGs）可以通过跨语言迁移来缓解这一鸿沟，但目前缺乏针对LOD KGs中低资源语言的明确定量定义。
AI.method: 提出了一种分析LOD KGs中语言分布的方法论，并基于DBpedia、BabelNet和Wikidata三大知识图谱提出了一个初步的多级语言分类体系。
AI.result: 建立了低资源、高资源和中等资源语言的正式定义，可用于后续选择跨语言迁移候选对象。
AI.conclusion: 该多级分类体系为LOD KGs中的语言资源程度提供了量化定义，有助于指导跨语言迁移策略，从而缓解数字鸿沟。
idea_en: A multi-level language categorization method for Linked Open Data Knowledge Graphs (LOD KGs) based on cross-KG analysis of DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata, enabling quantitative classification of languages into low-resource, medium-resource, and high-resource categories.

A cross-lingual transfer candidate selection system leveraging the defined language resource levels in LOD KGs to identify optimal source-target language pairs for data augmentation in under-resourced languages.

A unified metric framework for measuring language resource richness across heterogeneous multilingual knowledge graphs by integrating coverage, density, and connectivity features from multiple LOD KGs.
idea_ch: 一种基于DBpedia、BabelNet和Wikidata跨知识图谱分析的多级语言分类方法，能够将LOD知识图谱中的语言定量划分为低资源、中等资源和高资源三类。
一种利用LOD知识图谱中定义的语言资源等级来选择跨语言迁移候选对象的系统，用于识别最优的源语言-目标语言对，以实现低资源语言的数据增强。
一种跨异构多语言知识图谱的语言资源丰富度的统一度量框架，通过整合来自多个LOD知识图谱的覆盖度、密度和连通性特征来评估语言资源水平。

title: In Data or Invisible: Toward a Better Digital Representation of Low-Resource Languages with Knowledge Graphs
summary: Emerging digital technologies are exacerbating the existing divide in Open Access Data (OAD) between high-and low-resource languages, excluding many communities from participating in the global digital transformation. In this PhD proposal, we aim to address this gap, focusing on the language coverage of Linked Open Data knowledge graphs (LOD KGs). First, we identify key variables that characterize language distribution in LOD, including the number of Wikipedia articles per language edition and the number of language-tagged entities in LOD KGs. These variables are analyzed across three major multilingual LOD KGs, DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata, providing insights into the representation and distribution of languages within LOD. Building on this analysis, we intend to study the impact of cross-lingual transfer candidate selection on the task of multilingual KG completion. In particular, we plan to investigate strategies based on linguistic proximity and the availability of curated annotated alignments between languages. Language proximity also motivates us to explore the benefits of analogical reasoning that relies on (dis)similarities and has not yet been investigated to identify correspondences across languages to improve KG completion performance and enhance language coverage in LOD.

AI.tldr: 该博士论文旨在解决数字技术加剧的高资源与低资源语言之间的开放获取数据鸿沟，通过分析DBpedia、BabelNet和Wikidata三大多语言知识图谱中的语言分布特征，研究跨语言迁移候选选择对多语言知识图谱补全的影响，并探索基于语言相似性和类比推理的方法以提升低资源语言的知识图谱覆盖。
AI.motivation: 新兴数字技术加剧了高资源语言与低资源语言之间在开放获取数据上的鸿沟，使许多社群被排除在全球数字转型之外。论文旨在解决这一语言覆盖不均的问题。
AI.method: 1) 识别表征LOD中语言分布的关键变量（如维基百科文章数量、语言标注实体数量），分析DBpedia、BabelNet、Wikidata三大多语言知识图谱。2) 研究跨语言迁移候选选择对多语言KG补全任务的影响，探索基于语言邻近性和人工标注对齐的策略。3) 探索基于（不）相似性的类比推理方法，用于识别跨语言对应关系以提升KG补全性能。
AI.result: 尚处于博士提案阶段，预期成果包括：揭示多语言LOD知识图谱的语言分布规律；提出基于语言邻近性的跨语言迁移候选选择策略；开发基于类比推理的跨语言对应关系识别方法，以改善低资源语言的KG补全效果和LOD覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨语言迁移学习和类比推理，可以有效提升多语言知识图谱中低资源语言的覆盖率和补全性能，弥合数字语言鸿沟。
idea_en: A method for multilingual KG completion using cross-lingual transfer candidate selection based on linguistic proximity between high-resource and low-resource languages.
An analogical reasoning framework leveraging (dis)similarities to identify cross-lingual correspondences in Linked Open Data knowledge graphs.
A system for analyzing language distribution in LOD KGs using variables such as number of Wikipedia articles and language-tagged entities across DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata.
A strategy for enhancing low-resource language coverage in LOD by combining curated annotated alignments with linguistic proximity-based transfer learning.
idea_ch: 一种基于语言邻近性的跨语言迁移候选选择方法，用于高资源与低资源语言之间的多语言知识图谱补全。
利用（不）相似性进行类比推理的框架，用于识别关联开放数据知识图谱中的跨语言对应关系。
一种分析LOD知识图谱中语言分布的系统，通过维基百科文章数量和语言标注实体等变量对DBpedia、BabelNet、Wikidata进行跨库分析。
一种结合人工标注对齐与基于语言邻近性的迁移学习策略，用于增强LOD中低资源语言覆盖率的方案。

title: ICU-Bench:Benchmarking Continual Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across many domains, their training on large-scale multimodal datasets raises serious privacy concerns, making effective machine unlearning increasingly necessary. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static or short-sequence settings, offering limited support for evaluating continual privacy deletion requests in realistic deployments. To bridge this gap, we introduce ICU-Bench, a continual multimodal unlearning benchmark built on privacy-critical document data. ICU-Bench contains 1,000 privacy-sensitive profiles from two document domains, medical reports and labor contracts, with 9,500 images, 16,000 question-answer pairs, and 100 forget tasks. Additionally, new continual unlearning metrics are introduced, facilitating a comprehensive analysis of forgetting effectiveness, historical forgetting preservation, retained utility, and stability throughout the continual unlearning process. Through extensive experiments with representative unlearning methods on ICU-Bench, we show that existing methods generally struggle in continual settings and exhibit clear limitations in balancing forgetting quality, utility preservation, and scalability over long task sequences. These findings highlight the need for multimodal unlearning methods explicitly designed for continual privacy deletion.

AI.tldr: ICU-Bench 是一个持续多模态遗忘基准，基于隐私敏感文档数据（医疗报告和劳动合同），包含1,000份档案、9,500张图像、16,000个问答对和100个遗忘任务，用于评估多模态大模型在持续隐私删除场景下的遗忘能力。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘基准主要关注静态或短序列场景，无法支持现实部署中持续的隐私删除请求，缺乏针对多模态大模型在持续遗忘场景下的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了ICU-Bench基准数据集，包含医疗报告和劳动合同两个文档领域的隐私敏感档案，设计了持续遗忘指标（遗忘有效性、历史遗忘保持、保留效用、稳定性），并在该基准上测试了代表性遗忘方法。
AI.result: 现有遗忘方法在持续设置下普遍表现不佳，在遗忘质量、效用保留和长任务序列可扩展性方面存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 需要专门为持续隐私删除设计的多模态遗忘方法。
idea_en: A continual multimodal unlearning benchmark system specifically designed for privacy-critical document data, featuring medical reports and labor contracts with structured privacy-sensitive profiles.

A set of comprehensive continual unlearning metrics that simultaneously evaluate forgetting effectiveness, historical forgetting preservation, retained utility, and stability over long task sequences.
A multi-domain privacy document dataset construction method with 1,000 privacy-sensitive profiles, 9,500 images, 16,000 QA pairs, and 100 forget tasks for evaluating continual unlearning.
A systematic evaluation framework for analyzing trade-offs between forgetting quality, utility preservation, and scalability in continual multimodal unlearning scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种针对隐私关键文档数据的持续多模态遗忘基准系统，包含医疗报告和劳动合同两类文档，具有结构化的隐私敏感档案。
一套综合性的持续遗忘评估指标，同时评估遗忘有效性、历史遗忘保持、保留效用以及长任务序列下的稳定性。
一种多领域隐私文档数据集构建方法，包含1,000份隐私敏感档案、9,500张图像、16,000个问答对和100个遗忘任务，用于评估持续遗忘能力。
一种系统性的评估框架，用于分析持续多模态遗忘场景中遗忘质量、效用保留与可扩展性之间的权衡关系。

title: MAS-Algorithm: A Workflow for Solving Algorithmic Programming Problems with a Multi-Agent System
summary: Algorithmic problem solving serves as a rigorous testbed for evaluating structured reasoning in AI coding systems, as it directly reflects a model's ability to perform structured reasoning in complex scenarios.Existing approaches predominantly rely on model-centric strategies, such as architectural modifications and data scaling, which are costly and offer limited interpretability. Alternative methods leveraging external tools or prompting techniques (e.g., chain-of-thought) are often fragmented and lack a unified framework. In this paper, we propose MAS-Algorithm, a systematic multi-agent workflow for algorithmic problem solving inspired by the practices of competitive programmers and algorithm engineers. Our framework decomposes the end-to-end solving process into modular stages, enabling structured reasoning, tool integration, and flexible coordination among agents. The design emphasizes both rigor and extensibility, allowing it to generalize across diverse problem types.Experimental results on a self-constructed benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple Qwen series models, achieving an average gain of 6.48% in acceptance rate. In contrast, parameter-efficient fine-tuning on the same data yields only a marginal improvement of 0.89%. We further observe a 4.72% gain on LiveCodeBench-Pro, along with consistent improvements across additional accuracy and efficiency metrics.Beyond performance gains, we conduct comprehensive analyses to better understand the reasoning process within the workflow, including error patterns and cross-scenario behaviors. We further perform customized replacement and ablation studies to explore the upper bound of the framework, showing that individual agents can contribute improvements of up to 27.7%. These results highlight the strong potential of MAS-Algorithm for advancing AI-driven algorithmic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAS-Algorithm，一个基于多智能体工作流的算法问题求解框架，通过模块化分解、工具集成和灵活协作，在多个基准上显著提升AI编码系统的算法推理能力，平均接受率提升6.48%，远超参数高效微调的0.89%。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI算法问题求解方法主要依赖模型中心策略（架构修改、数据扩展），成本高且可解释性差；外部工具和提示工程技术则缺乏统一框架。需要一种系统化、可扩展且高效的多智能体协作方案。
AI.method: 将端到端求解过程分解为模块化阶段（结构化推理、工具集成、智能体灵活协调），模拟竞赛程序员和算法工程师的实践流程。框架兼顾严谨性和可扩展性，支持跨多种问题类型的泛化。
AI.result: 在自构建基准上，多个Qwen系列模型平均接受率提升6.48%（对比微调仅0.89%）；LiveCodeBench-Pro提升4.72%；单个智能体贡献最高达27.7%。
AI.conclusion: MAS-Algorithm框架在AI驱动的算法推理方面展现出强大潜力，通过多智能体协作实现了显著且可解释的性能提升，优于传统微调方法。
idea_en: A modular multi-agent workflow for algorithmic problem solving that decomposes the end-to-end process into distinct stages, each handled by specialized agents with structured reasoning capabilities.
A systematic framework integrating external tools (such as code executors and debuggers) with multi-agent coordination, enabling real-time validation and iteration of algorithmic solutions.

A competitive-programming-inspired agent orchestration mechanism where agents simulate the roles of human programmers (e.g., problem analyzer, algorithm designer, code implementer, debugger) in a collaborative pipeline.
A flexible coordination protocol among agents that supports both sequential and parallel execution patterns, allowing adaptive workflow adjustment based on problem complexity.
An agent-based error pattern analysis system that leverages cross-scenario behavior data to identify and correct systematic reasoning errors in algorithmic problem solving.
A customized agent replacement and ablation methodology to systematically evaluate individual agent contributions and optimize multi-agent workflow composition.

A tool-integrated multi-agent architecture for algorithmic reasoning that achieves consistent improvements across multiple model series and benchmarks without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning.
idea_ch: 一种用于算法问题求解的模块化多智能体工作流，将端到端求解过程分解为不同阶段，每个阶段由具有结构化推理能力的专门智能体处理。
一种集成外部工具（如代码执行器和调试器）与多智能体协调的系统化框架，支持算法解决方案的实时验证与迭代优化。
一种受竞赛编程启发的智能体编排机制，其中智能体在协作流水线中模拟人类程序员角色（如问题分析者、算法设计者、代码实现者、调试者）。
一种灵活的智能体间协调协议，同时支持顺序和并行执行模式，允许根据问题复杂度自适应调整工作流。
一种基于智能体的错误模式分析系统，利用跨场景行为数据识别和纠正算法问题求解中的系统性推理错误。
一种定制化智能体替换与消融分析方法，用于系统评估单个智能体贡献并优化多智能体工作流配置。
一种工具集成式多智能体架构，无需模型重训练或微调即可在多个模型系列和基准上实现一致的性能提升。

title: HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning
summary: World models enable model-based planning through learned latent dynamics, but imagined rollouts become unstable as the planning horizon grows or the dynamics distribution shifts. We argue that this instability reflects two missing structures in planner-facing latents: history-conditioned memory for approximate Markov completeness, and geometric organization that separates configuration, momentum, and task semantics. We propose HaM-World (HMW), a structured world model that decomposes the latent state into a canonical (q, p) subspace and a context subspace c, while using Mamba selective state-space memory as the history-conditioned input to the same latent dynamics. Within this interface, (q, p) evolves through an energy-derived Hamiltonian vector field plus learnable residual/control dynamics, while c captures semantic, dissipative, and non-conservative factors. This gives the planner a single latent state shared by dynamics prediction, reward/value estimation, imagined rollouts, and CEM action search. On four DeepMind Control Suite tasks, HaM-World reaches the highest Avg. AUC (117.9, +9.5%), reduces long-horizon rollout error to 45% of a strong baseline model, and wins 11/12 k in {3,5,7} MSE cells. Under 12 OOD perturbations spanning dynamics shifts, action delay, and observation masking, HaM-World achieves the highest return in every condition, with average OOD-return gains of 10.2% on Finger Spin and 13.6% on Reacher Easy. Mechanism diagnostics further show bounded action-free Hamiltonian-energy drift, structured energy variation under policy rollouts, and coherent control-induced energy transfer, supporting the intended Soft-Hamiltonian dynamics design.

AI.tldr: HaM-World (HMW)是一种结构化世界模型，将潜在状态分解为(位置,动量)子空间和上下文子空间，并利用Mamba选择性状态空间记忆作为历史条件输入，在长时程规划和OOD条件下显著提升稳定性和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在规划时长远或动力学分布偏移时，想象展开变得不稳定。该不稳定性源于规划器面向的潜在表征中缺少两种结构：基于历史条件的记忆以近似马尔可夫完备性，以及将构型、动量和任务语义分离的几何组织。
AI.method: 将潜在状态分解为规范(q,p)子空间和上下文c子空间，使用Mamba选择性状态空间记忆作为历史条件输入。在(q,p)子空间中通过能量导出的哈密顿向量场加上可学习残差/控制动力学进行演化，c子空间捕获语义、耗散和非保守因素。规划器使用共享的潜在状态进行动力学预测、奖励/价值估计、想象展开和CEM动作搜索。
AI.result: 在4个DeepMind Control Suite任务上，Avg. AUC达117.9（+9.5%），长时程展开误差降至强基线的45%，胜出11/12个{MSE,3,5,7}组合。在12种OOD扰动下，每个条件都获得最高回报，平均OOD回报增益在Finger Spin为10.2%，Reacher Easy为13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 哈米尔顿结构化世界模型设计有效，具有有界能量漂移、结构化能量变化和连贯的控制诱导能量转移，验证了Soft-Hamiltonian动力学设计的有效性。
idea_en: A structured world model that decomposes latent state into canonical (q,p) subspace and context subspace c for stable long-horizon planning
Use of Mamba selective state-space memory as history-conditioned input to latent dynamics for approximate Markov completeness
Hamiltonian vector field plus learnable residual/control dynamics for energy-derived latent evolution
Separation of configuration, momentum (q,p) from semantic, dissipative, and non-conservative factors (c) in latent space
Shared single latent state for dynamics prediction, reward/value estimation, imagined rollouts, and CEM action search
Soft-Hamiltonian dynamics design with bounded action-free energy drift for OOD robustness
idea_ch: 一种将潜在状态分解为规范(q,p)子空间和上下文c子空间的结构化世界模型，用于稳定长时程规划
利用Mamba选择性状态空间记忆作为历史条件输入到潜在动力学，实现近似马尔可夫完备性
哈密顿向量场结合可学习残差/控制动力学的能量导出潜在演化方法
在潜在空间中将构型、动量(q,p)与语义、耗散和非保守因素(c)分离
共享单一潜在状态同时用于动力学预测、奖励/价值估计、想象展开和CEM动作搜索
具有有界无动作能量漂移的软哈密顿动力学设计，用于分布外鲁棒性

title: Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust Learning for Debiased Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is fundamental to intelligent education systems, yet relies on educational logs that are selectively observed. The non-random nature of exercise recommendations and student choices inevitably induces severe selection bias. Most existing KT methods neglect this issue, training on observed logs using standard empirical risk, which yields biased mastery estimates and accumulates errors in subsequent recommendations. To address this, we introduce a doubly robust (DR) formulation for KT that integrates a propensity model with an error imputation model, theoretically guaranteeing unbiasedness if either model is accurate. Beyond unbiasedness, in the sequential setting of KT, we identify that the estimator's performance is compromised by variance-dependent stochastic deviations that accumulate over time, thereby causing training instability and limiting performance. To mitigate this, we derive a generalization bound that explicitly characterizes the impact of estimator variance and identifies temporal smoothness as a key factor in controlling it. Building on these theoretical insights, we propose the Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework. TSDR jointly optimizes the KT predictor and the imputation model with a smoothness regularizer, effectively reducing variance while preserving the unbiasedness guarantee of DR. Experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks demonstrate that TSDR consistently enhances various state-of-the-art KT backbones, underscoring the vital role of principled bias correction in KT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSDR框架，通过双重稳健估计结合时间平滑正则化，解决知识追踪中由非随机观测引起的选择性偏差问题，在保持无偏性的同时降低方差，显著提升多种KT骨干模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪（KT）依赖教育日志，但日志存在选择性偏差（非随机的习题推荐和学生选择），导致标准经验风险训练产生有偏的掌握度估计，进而累积错误影响后续推荐。
AI.method: 提出双重稳健（DR）公式，融合倾向性模型与误差插补模型，理论保证任一模型准确时无偏；推导泛化界揭示方差影响；提出TSDR框架，联合优化KT预测器与插补模型，加入时间平滑正则化项以降低方差且保持无偏性。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上，TSDR一致性地提升了多种现有KT骨干模型的性能，验证了有原则的偏差校正对KT的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 选择性偏差是KT中的关键但被忽视的问题，双重稳健估计结合时间平滑正则化能够有效解决偏差与方差的权衡问题，提升KT系统的准确性和稳定性。
idea_en: Doubly Robust formulation for Knowledge Tracing integrating propensity model and error imputation model to achieve unbiased mastery estimation under selective bias
Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework with smoothness regularizer that reduces variance-dependent stochastic deviations while preserving unbiasedness guarantee
Generalization bound for sequential KT setting that explicitly characterizes impact of estimator variance and identifies temporal smoothness as key controlling factor
Joint optimization of KT predictor and imputation model with temporal smoothness constraint for stable training in biased educational log scenarios
idea_ch: 针对知识追踪的选择性偏差问题，提出双重稳健（DR）估计方法，融合倾向性模型与误差插补模型，在任一模型准确时实现无偏掌握度估计
时间平滑双重稳健（TSDR）框架，通过平滑正则化项降低与方差相关的时间随机波动，同时保持DR的无偏性保证
推导序列化知识追踪场景下的泛化界，明确刻画估计器方差的影响并识别时间平滑性是控制方差的关键因素
联合优化知识追踪预测器与插补模型的技术方案，通过时间平滑约束实现有偏教育日志场景下的稳定训练

title: From Coordinate Matching to Structural Alignment: Rethinking Prototype Alignment in Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: Heterogeneous federated learning (HtFL) aims to enable collaboration among clients that differ in both data distributions and model architectures. Prototype-based methods, which communicate class-level feature centers (prototypes) instead of full model parameters, have recently shown strong potential for HtFL. Existing prototype-based HtFL methods typically reuse the MSE-based or cosine-based alignment mechanism developed for homogeneous FL when aligning client-specific representations with global prototypes. These approaches are essentially coordinate alignment, where representations of clients are forced to match the global prototypes in the embedding space in an element-wise manner. Such alignment implicitly assumes that all clients should map their representations into the feature subspace defined by the global prototypes. This assumption is reasonable in homogeneous FL, where all clients share the same feature extractor. However, it becomes problematic in HtFL, since heterogeneous feature extractors naturally induce client-specific feature subspaces, and forcing all clients to optimize within a single global subspace unnecessarily suppresses their learning capacity. We observe that coordinate alignment implicitly couples two distinct objectives: aligning inter-class semantic structure, which is directly beneficial for classification, and enforcing a shared feature basis, which is unnecessary and even harmful under model heterogeneity. Building on this insight, we design FedSAF, which shifts the alignment objective from absolute coordinates to inter-class relational structure. We demonstrate that structural alignment consistently outperforms coordinate alignment in heterogeneous settings. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our structural alignment outperforms state-of-the-art prototype-based HtFL methods by up to 3.52\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedSAF方法，将异构联邦学习中原型对齐从坐标对齐转变为结构对齐，解耦了类别间语义结构学习和共享特征基学习，实验证明优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于原型的异构联邦学习方法采用坐标对齐（MSE或余弦），强制异构客户端的特征表示嵌入到全局原型定义的统一特征子空间中，这抑制了异构特征提取器的学习能力。
AI.method: 提出FedSAF，将对齐目标从绝对坐标对齐转变为类别间关系结构对齐，解耦了"对齐类别间语义结构"和"强制共享特征基"两个不同的目标。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，FedSAF相比现有最先进的基于原型的异构联邦学习方法提升了最高3.52%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构对齐在异构联邦学习设置中始终优于坐标对齐，为异构联邦学习中的表征对齐提供了新范式。
idea_en: A structural alignment method for heterogeneous federated learning that aligns inter-class relational structures rather than absolute coordinates, decoupling semantic structure learning from shared feature basis enforcement.

A prototype-based heterogeneous federated learning framework (FedSAF) that preserves client-specific feature subspaces while maintaining cross-client semantic consistency through relational structure matching.
A method for heterogeneous federated learning that replaces MSE-based or cosine-based coordinate alignment with relational structure alignment between local prototypes and global prototypes.
idea_ch: 一种异构联邦学习的结构对齐方法，对齐类别间关系结构而非绝对坐标，将语义结构学习与共享特征基学习解耦。
一种基于原型的异构联邦学习框架FedSAF，通过关系结构匹配保留客户端特定特征子空间的同时维护跨客户端语义一致性。
一种异构联邦学习方法，用局部原型与全局原型之间的关系结构对齐替代基于MSE或余弦的坐标对齐。

title: TheraAgent: Self-Improving Therapeutic Agent for Precise and Comprehensive Treatment Planning
summary: Formulating a treatment plan is inherently a complex reasoning and refinement task rather than a simple generation problem. However, existing large language models (LLMs) mainly rely on one-shot output without explicit verification, which may result in rough, incomplete, and potentially unsafe treatment plans. To address these limitations, we propose TheraAgent, an agentic framework that replaces one-shot generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline. By mirroring the actual reasoning process of human experts who iteratively revise treatment plans, our framework progressively transforms coarse and incomplete drafts into precise, comprehensive, and safer therapeutic regimens. To facilitate the critical judge component, we introduce TheraJudge, a treatment-specific evaluation module integrated into the inference loop to enforce clinical standards. Experiments show TheraAgent achieves state-of-the-art results on HealthBench, leading in Accuracy and Completeness. In expert evaluations, it attains an 86% win rate against physicians, with superior Targeting and Harm Control. Moreover, the highly agreement between TheraJudge and HealthBench evaluations confirms the reliability of our framework.

AI.tldr: 提出TheraAgent框架，通过"生成-判断-优化"迭代流程取代LLM的一次性输出，模拟人类专家逐步修订治疗计划的过程，引入专门的治疗评估模块TheraJudge来确保临床标准，在HealthBench上达到SOTA，专家评估中胜率达86%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM主要依赖一次性输出，缺乏显式验证，导致治疗方案粗糙、不完整且可能存在安全隐患，而制定治疗方案本质上是复杂的推理和完善任务而非简单生成问题。
AI.method: 提出TheraAgent智能体框架，采用迭代式"生成-判断-优化"流水线替代一次性生成；引入TheraJudge作为治疗专用评估模块集成到推理循环中，强制执行临床标准；通过多轮迭代逐步将粗糙不完整的草稿转化为精确、全面、更安全的治疗方案。
AI.result: 在HealthBench上取得SOTA，准确性和完整性领先；专家评估中对医生的胜率达86%，靶向性和伤害控制表现优异；TheraJudge与HealthBench评估高度一致，验证了框架的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式"生成-判断-优化"框架能显著提升LLM生成治疗方案的质量、安全性和临床可靠性，TheraJudge可作为有效的自动化评估模块替代人工审核。
idea_en: An iterative generate-judge-refine agentic framework for treatment plan formulation that replaces one-shot LLM generation with multi-turn progressive refinement.
A treatment-specific evaluation module (TheraJudge) integrated into the LLM inference loop that enforces clinical standards and provides automated quality verification.
A method for progressively transforming coarse and incomplete treatment draft into precise, comprehensive, and safer therapeutic regimens through iterative human-expert-mimicking reasoning.
An automated judge module that achieves high agreement with standard clinical benchmarks (HealthBench), enabling reliable self-verification without external human evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种迭代式生成-判断-优化智能体框架，通过多轮渐进式精炼替代LLM一次性生成治疗方案，模拟人类专家逐步修订的推理过程。
一种集成到LLM推理循环中的治疗专用评估模块TheraJudge，可强制执行临床标准并提供自动化质量验证，确保治疗方案的准确性和安全性。
一种通过迭代推理将粗糙不完整治疗方案草稿逐步转化为精确、全面、更安全治疗方案的方法，模拟人类专家反复修订的思维过程。
一种自动化判断模块与标准临床基准（HealthBench）实现高度一致性的方法，使系统能够在无需外部人工评估的情况下进行可靠的自我验证。

title: BehaviorGuard: Online Backdoor Defense for Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep reinforcement learning (DRL). Current defenses typically rely on reward anomalies to reverse-engineer triggers and model finetuning to remove backdoors. However, complex trigger patterns undermine their robustness, and fine-tuning entails high costs, limiting practical utility. Therefore, we shift defense concerns to trigger-agnostic backdoor output behaviors and propose BehaviorGuard, an online behavior-based backdoor detection and mitigation framework for DRL. Specifically, we find that regardless of attacks, backdoored policies induce consistent shifts in action distributions to ensure reliable activation, leaving detectable traces in high-quantile regions and distribution tails, even in the absence of triggers. Based on this, we design a novel metric that captures behavioral drift in action distributions to identify and suppress backdoor actions at runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first online backdoor defense that counters attacks both in single- and multi-agent DRL. Evaluated across diverse benchmarks with different backdoor attacks, BehaviorGuard consistently surpasses prior methods in both efficacy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出BehaviorGuard，一种基于在线行为分析的深度强化学习后门防御框架，通过检测动作分布中的行为漂移来识别和抑制后门攻击，无需依赖触发器模式。
AI.motivation: 现有DRL后门防御依赖奖励异常和触发器逆向工程，但复杂触发器模式削弱了鲁棒性，且微调模型成本高昂，实用性受限。需要一种与触发器无关、低成本的在线防御方法。
AI.method: 发现后门策略无论攻击类型如何，都会引起动作分布的一致偏移，在高分位数区域和分布尾部留下可检测痕迹。基于此设计衡量动作分布行为漂移的新指标，在线识别并抑制后门动作。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试和不同后门攻击下，BehaviorGuard在有效性和效率上均优于现有方法。首次实现在单智能体和多智能体DRL中的在线后门防御。
AI.conclusion: BehaviorGuard提供了一种触发器无关、低成本、高效的在线后门防御方案，适用于单智能体和多智能体场景。
idea_en: A trigger-agnostic backdoor detection method for DRL that identifies backdoor behavior by analyzing shifts in action distribution at runtime, without requiring trigger patterns or reward anomalies.

An online behavior-based defense framework (BehaviorGuard) that monitors high-quantile regions and distribution tails of action distributions to detect and suppress backdoor actions in single- and multi-agent DRL.

A novel behavioral drift metric that captures consistent shifts in action distributions caused by backdoored policies, enabling real-time identification of backdoor activations even in trigger-absent states.
idea_ch: 一种与触发器无关的DRL后门检测方法，通过在运行时分析动作分布的偏移来识别后门行为，无需依赖触发器模式或奖励异常。
一种基于在线行为分析的防御框架(BehaviorGuard)，通过监控动作分布的高分位数区域和分布尾部，在单智能体和多智能体DRL中检测并抑制后门动作。
一种新型行为漂移度量指标，捕捉后门策略引起的动作分布一致偏移，即使在无触发器状态下也能实时识别后门激活。

title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
summary: When language model agents tackle complex software engineering tasks, they often degrade over long trajectories, which we define as *agent drift*. We focus on two recurring failure modes *overthinking* and *overacting*, i.e., where the agent repeatedly reasons over information it already has, and where it issues tool calls without integrating recent observations or acquiring new evidence. In this paper, we introduce TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate agent drift in the residual stream before it surfaces as a behavioral failure. In specific, we label trajectory steps as overthinking, overacting, or calibrated, and find that their hidden states can separate linearly along two *drift axes*, pointing from calibrated behavior toward each failure mode (AUC $\approx$ 0.9). To mitigate agent drift, we project each step's activation onto these axes at test time and pull drifted ones back toward the calibrated region. Experiments show that TACT outperforms unsteered baselines across SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.0, and CLAW-Eval, lifting average resolve rate by $+5.8$ pp on Qwen3.5-27B and $+4.8$ pp on Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it while cutting steps-to-resolve by up to $26\%$. These gains frame agent drift as a steerable direction in the residual stream, and position TACT as a viable handle for reliable long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TACT（Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering），通过残差流中的激活方向检测和缓解智能体在长轨迹任务中的"漂移"（过度思考和过度行动），在多个基准测试上提升解决率 4.8-5.8 个百分点，步骤数减少最高 26%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体在处理复杂软件工程任务时，随着轨迹变长会出现性能退化（即"智能体漂移"），主要表现为两种失败模式：过度思考（反复推理已有信息）和过度行动（未整合新观察就发出工具调用）。现有方法缺乏对这两种失效模式的检测与缓解机制。
AI.method: TACT 方法包含两步：(1) 将轨迹步骤标注为过度思考、过度行动或校准三类，发现其隐藏状态在校准行为指向两种失效模式的"漂移轴"上可线性分离（AUC≈0.9）；(2) 测试时，将每一步的激活值投影到漂移轴上，将已漂移的激活值拉回校准区域，从而缓解智能体漂移。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 CLAW-Eval 上，TACT 优于无引导基线：Qwen3.5-27B 平均解决率提升 +5.8 个百分点，Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 提升 +4.8 个百分点，步骤-解决比最高降低 26%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体漂移是残差流中的可引导方向，TACT 为构建可靠的长程智能体提供了一种有效的控制手段。
idea_en: A method for detecting and mitigating agent drift in language model agents by analyzing hidden state activations in the residual stream along two drift axes (overthinking and overacting)
A calibration technique that projects each step's activation onto drift axes at test time and pulls drifted activations back toward a calibrated region
A labeling mechanism for trajectory steps as overthinking, overacting, or calibrated, enabling linear separability analysis of failure modes in the residual stream
A real-time activation steering system for long-horizon software engineering agents that reduces steps-to-resolve by up to 26% without performance degradation
idea_ch: 基于残差流中隐藏状态激活分析的智能体漂移检测方法，通过两个漂移轴（过度思考和过度行动）识别智能体行为偏差
测试时将每一步激活值投影到漂移轴上，并将已漂移激活值拉回校准区域的激活引导校准技术
一种轨迹步骤标注机制（过度思考/过度行动/校准），实现对残差流中失效模式的线性可分性分析
用于长程软件工程智能体的实时激活引导系统，在不降低性能的情况下将步骤-解决比最高降低 26%

title: BioResearcher: Scenario-Guided Multi-Agent for Translational Medicine
summary:
Translational medicine turns underspecified development goals into evidence synthesis that must combine literature, trials, patents, and quantitative multi-omics analysis while preserving identifiers, uncertainty, and retrievable provenance. General-purpose foundation models and off-the-shelf tool-augmented or multi-agent systems are not built for this: they tend to produce single-shot answers or run open-endedly, and fall short on the auditable, scenario-specific workflows that heterogeneous biomedical sources demand.
  This paper introduces Ingenix BioResearcher, a scenario-guided multi-agent system that maps queries to versioned research playbooks, delegates to specialized subagents over 30+ tools and machine-learning endpoints, mixes structured database access with sandboxed code for genome-scale analyses, and applies claim-level multi-model reconciliation before editorial assembly.
  We evaluate BioResearcher across unit-level capabilities, open-ended biomedical reasoning, and end-to-end clinical discovery. It leads evaluated baselines on 109 single-step tests (83.49% pass rate; 0.892 average score), achieves strong biomedical benchmark performance (89.33% on BixBench-Verified-50 and the top 0.758 mean score on BaisBench Scientific Discovery), and leads on a 30-query clinical end-to-end benchmark with the highest positive hit rate (74.7% $\pm$ 3.3%) and negative clear rate (96.8% $\pm$ 0.2%). These results show broad, competitive performance across unit-level, open-ended, and end-to-end clinical evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Ingenix BioResearcher，一个面向转化医学的场景引导多智能体系统，它通过版本化的研究剧本、30余种工具/ML端点、沙盒代码执行以及声明级多模型协调，在异构生物医学数据源上实现可审计、可溯源的工作流，并在多项基准测试中取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 转化医学需要将文献、临床试验、专利和定量多组学分析整合为可溯源的证据综合，但通用基础模型和现成的工具增强/多智能体系统无法满足这一需求，因为它们倾向于给出单次性答案或无限运行，缺乏异构生物医学数据源所需的可审计、场景特定工作流。
AI.method: BioResearcher将查询映射到版本化的研究剧本，委派给覆盖30+工具和ML端点的专门子智能体，混合结构化数据库访问与沙盒代码执行以进行基因组规模分析，并在编辑整合前应用声明级多模型协调。
AI.result: 在109个单步测试上达到83.49%通过率和0.892平均分；BixBench-Verified-50上89.33%，BaisBench上0.758平均分；30查询临床端到端基准中正命中率74.7%±3.3%，负清除率96.8%±0.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在单元级、开放式和端到端临床评估中展现出广泛且具有竞争力的性能。
idea_en: A scenario-guided multi-agent system using versioned research playbooks to map queries into auditable, reproducible workflows for translational medicine evidence synthesis.
Claim-level multi-model reconciliation mechanism that resolves conflicting outputs from multiple specialized sub-agents before editorial assembly.
Sandboxed code execution environment integrated within a multi-agent system for genome-scale analyses with structured database access.
