Versioned research playbook architecture enabling reproducible and traceable execution of complex biomedical analysis pipelines.
Specialized sub-agent delegation system capable of orchestrating 30+ heterogeneous tools and machine-learning endpoints for domain-specific tasks.
idea_ch: 一种场景引导的多智能体系统，利用版本化研究剧本将查询映射为可审计、可重现的转化医学证据综合工作流。
声明级多模型协调机制，在编辑整合之前解决来自多个专门子智能体的冲突输出。
集成在多智能体系统中的沙盒代码执行环境，用于基因组规模分析并结合结构化数据库访问。
版本化研究剧本架构，支持复杂生物医学分析流程的可重现和可追溯执行。
专门子智能体委派系统，能够编排30余种异构工具和机器学习端点以执行领域特定任务。

title: Strat-LLM: Stratified Strategy Alignment for LLM-based Stock Trading with Real-time Multi-Source Signals
comment: Accepted by the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving into autonomous trading agents, yet existing benchmarks often overlook the interplay between architectural reasoning and strategy consistency. We propose Strat-LLM, a framework grounded in Stratified Strategy Alignment. Operating in a live-forward setting throughout 2025, it integrates heterogeneous data including sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports to eliminate look-ahead bias. Extensive stress tests on A-share and U.S. markets reveal: (1) reasoning-heavy models achieve peak utility in Free Mode via internal logic, whereas standard models require Strict Mode as a vital risk anchor; (2) alignment utility is regime-dependent, with Free and Guided modes capturing momentum in uptrending markets, while Strict Mode mitigates drawdowns in downtrends; (3) mid-scale models (35B) show optimal fidelity under strict constraints, whereas ultra-large models (122B) suffer an alignment tax under rigid rules but gain a performance premium in Guided Mode; (4) standard LLMs often fall into a high win-rate trap, optimizing for small gains at the expense of total returns, which can only be mitigated through deep reasoning or strict external guardrails. Project details are available at https://Strat-LLM.github.io.

AI.tldr: Strat-LLM是一个基于分层策略对齐的框架，用于评估LLM作为自主交易代理在实时市场中的表现，揭示了不同规模模型在不同交易模式下的策略一致性、收益表现和风险控制特性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试忽略了架构推理能力与策略一致性之间的相互作用，缺乏对LLM作为交易代理在真实市场环境中表现的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出Strat-LLM框架，基于分层策略对齐（Stratified Strategy Alignment），在2025年全年实时前向环境中运行，集成时序价格、实时新闻和年度报告等异构数据以消除前视偏差。
AI.result: (1)推理密集型模型在自由模式下通过内部逻辑达到最佳效用，标准模型需要严格模式作为风险锚；(2)对齐效用具有市场状态依赖性；(3)中型模型(35B)在严格约束下保真度最佳，超大型模型(122B)在严格规则下存在对齐税但在引导模式下获得溢价；(4)标准LLM易陷入高胜率陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 不同规模和类型的LLM在不同交易模式和市况下表现各异，推理能力与外部约束之间存在权衡，高胜率并不等同于高总收益。
idea_en: A stratified strategy alignment framework for LLM-based trading agents that dynamically switches between Free, Guided, and Strict modes based on market regimes and model reasoning capabilities.
A method to eliminate look-ahead bias in LLM trading evaluation by integrating sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports in a live-forward setting.

A high win-rate trap detection mechanism for standard LLMs that identifies when models prioritize small frequent gains over total returns, and mitigates it through deep reasoning or strict external guardrails.
A regime-dependent alignment utility system where Free and Guided modes capture momentum in uptrending markets while Strict Mode mitigates drawdowns in downtrends.
An alignment tax quantification method for ultra-large LLMs (122B) under rigid trading rules, with a corresponding performance premium mechanism in Guided Mode.
idea_ch: 一种基于市场状态和模型推理能力动态切换自由模式、引导模式和严格模式的分层策略对齐框架，用于LLM交易代理。
一种通过集成时序价格、实时新闻和年度报告在实时前向设置中消除前视偏差的LLM交易评估方法。
一种标准LLM高胜率陷阱检测机制，识别模型优先获取小额频繁收益而牺牲总回报的行为，并通过深度推理或严格外部护栏进行缓解。
一种市场状态依赖的对齐效用系统，在上涨市场中自由模式和引导模式捕捉动量，在下跌市场中严格模式减少回撤。
一种超大型LLM(122B)在严格交易规则下的对齐税量化方法，以及在引导模式下对应获得性能溢价的机制。

title: Pathways to AGI
summary: Our focus are five related questions that stem from a critical software studies perspective. Underpinning this view is the acknowledged need to avoid assumptions regarding the inevitability of the current situation relating to AI. What we need to see is the closeness of the linkage between current commercial AI development and our prevailing social, political and economic circumstances. This does mean that the perspectives presented here are done so critically and conditionally. Most importantly, Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is seen as being problematic both conceptually and definitionally. This conditioning of any view regarding AGI does lead the discussion in specific directions and to certain conclusions regarding the future. However, adopting this perspective enables the work to offer some final recommendations. We set out to ask the following questions, 1. What are the critical pathways that produced the current dominant generative AI tools (capabilities, product forms, adoption patterns)? 2. Which decision points acted as leverage nodes (small changes that had large downstream effects), and which dead ends reveal alternative possibilities that did not become dominant? 3. How do pathways differ across three foundational-model trajectories such as the frontier proprietary models, open-weight models or specific domain and sovereign models? 4. Which alternative projects branched from key leverage nodes, what is their current state, and why did some succeed, stall, fail or become absorbed? 5. Based on this analysis, what socio-technical development programmes could plausibly move toward AGI-adjacent capability while meeting requirements for transparency, moderation, wellbeing and sustainable business models?

AI.tldr: 本文从批判性软件研究视角出发，探讨了当前商业AI发展与社会政治经济环境的紧密关联，质疑了AGI的概念定义，并提出五个关键问题以分析生成式AI的发展路径、决策节点、模型轨迹差异、替代项目及未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 作者认为当前AI发展并非不可避免，而是深深嵌入特定的社会、政治和经济结构中，需要批判性地审视AGI概念本身的问题性，从而揭示被主流叙事掩盖的替代可能性。
AI.method: 采用批判性软件研究方法，通过提出五个结构化问题（发展路径、决策杠杆节点、三种模型轨迹对比、替代项目分析、社会技术发展方案）进行系统分析。
AI.result: 识别了生成式AI发展的关键路径和杠杆节点，区分了前沿专有模型、开放权重模型和特定领域/主权模型三类轨迹的差异，发现了从杠杆节点分支出的替代项目及其成败原因。
AI.conclusion: 提出了面向透明、适度、福祉和可持续商业模式的社会技术发展方案，这些方案可能接近AGI能力但避免AGI概念本身的问题。
idea_en: A method for analyzing critical pathways and leverage nodes in AI development trajectories to identify alternative socio-technical programs
A framework for comparing frontier proprietary models, open-weight models, and domain-specific models to determine optimal development strategies
A system for evaluating AGI-adjacent capability development under transparency, moderation, wellbeing and sustainable business constraints
idea_ch: 一种分析AI发展路径中关键决策点和杠杆节点的方法，用于识别替代性社会技术方案
一种比较前沿专有模型、开放权重模型和特定领域模型以确定最优开发策略的框架
一种在透明性、适度性、福祉和可持续商业约束下评估类AGI能力发展的系统

title: Novelty-based Tree-of-Thought Search for LLM Reasoning and Planning
summary: Although advances such as chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought or reinforcement learning have improved the performance of LLMs in reasoning and planning tasks, they are still brittle and have not achieved human-level performance in many domains, and often suffer from high time and token costs. Inspired by the success of width-based search in planning, we explore how the concept of novelty can be transferred to language domains and how it can improve tree-of-thought reasoning. A tree of thoughts relies on building possible "paths" of consecutive ideas or thoughts. These are generated by repeatedly prompting an LLM. In our paper, a measurable concept of novelty is proposed that describes the uniqueness of a new node (thought) in comparison to nodes previously seen in the search tree. Novelty is estimated by prompting an LLM and making use of embedded general knowledge from pre-training. This metric can then be used to prune branches and reduce the scope of the search. Although this method introduces more prompts per state, the overall token cost can be reduced by pruning and reducing the overall tree size. This procedure is tested and compared using several benchmarks in language-based planning and general reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将宽度优先搜索中的"新颖性"概念迁移到语言领域，通过测量树搜索中新节点与已见节点的独特性来剪枝，从而在保持推理质量的同时降低token成本。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理方法（如思维链、思维树、强化学习）在推理和规划任务中仍显脆弱，未达到人类水平，且存在高时间和token成本问题。
AI.method: 提出一种可量化的新颖性概念：通过提示LLM评估新节点（思维）与搜索树中已见节点的独特性，利用预训练嵌入的通用知识进行估计，以此作为剪枝依据缩减搜索范围。
AI.result: 在语言基础规划和通用推理的多个基准测试中进行了实验验证，结果表明该方法虽然每个状态引入更多提示，但通过剪枝减少整体树的大小，从而降低了总token成本。
AI.conclusion: 新颖性度量可有效优化思维树推理，在保证性能的同时降低计算开销。
idea_en: A novelty-based pruning method for tree-of-thought reasoning in LLMs, where node uniqueness is measured by prompting an LLM to compare new thoughts against previously explored ones in the search tree.
A token-cost optimization framework that reduces overall tree size in LLM reasoning by pruning branches based on a quantifiable novelty metric, despite introducing additional prompts per state.
A transferable novelty concept from width-based search planning to language domains, enabling efficient exploration-exploitation balance in LLM reasoning tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于新颖性度量的LLM思维树推理剪枝方法：通过提示LLM评估新思维节点与搜索树中已探索节点的独特性程度，据此进行分支剪枝。
一种LLM推理的token成本优化框架：利用可量化的新颖性指标对搜索树进行剪枝，尽管每个状态引入更多提示，但通过减小整体树规模降低总token消耗。
一种从宽度优先搜索规划迁移到语言领域的新颖性概念转移方法，用于平衡LLM推理任务中的探索与利用效率。

title: Visual Fingerprints for LLM Generation Comparison
comment: Submitted to the Short Paper track at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) outputs arise from complex interactions among prompts, system instructions, model parameters, and architecture. We refer to specific configurations of these factors as generation conditions, each of which can bias outputs in various ways. Understanding how different generation conditions shape model behaviors is essential for tasks such as prompt design and model evaluation, yet it remains challenging due to the stochastic and open-ended nature of text generation. We present an approach to visually compare LLM outputs across generation conditions by modeling responses as collections of linguistic choices, including content, expression, and structure. We extract these choices using natural language processing pipelines and represent their distributions across repeated samples. We then visualize these distributions as visual fingerprints, enabling direct, distribution-level comparison of condition-specific tendencies. Through four usage scenarios, we demonstrate how visual fingerprints reveal consistent patterns in LLM behavior that are difficult to observe through individual responses or aggregate metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过可视化“语言指纹”来比较LLM在不同生成条件下输出差异的方法，将文本输出解构为内容、表达和结构等语言选择，并利用NLP管道提取分布特征进行可视化对比。
AI.motivation: 理解不同生成条件（如提示词、系统指令、模型参数等）如何影响LLM的输出行为对于提示设计和模型评估至关重要，但由于文本生成的随机性和开放性，这一任务面临挑战。
AI.method: 将LLM输出建模为语言选择（内容、表达、结构）的集合，利用NLP管道提取这些选择，并在多次采样上表示其分布，最后通过可视化“指纹”实现条件间的分布级比较。
AI.result: 通过四个使用场景展示，视觉指纹能够揭示LLM行为中一致的模式，而这些模式难以通过单个响应或聚合指标观察到。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效比较不同生成条件下的LLM输出差异，为提示设计和模型评估提供了新的可视化分析工具。
idea_en: A method for visually comparing LLM outputs across different generation conditions by modeling responses as collections of linguistic choices (content, expression, structure) and visualizing their distributions as visual fingerprints.
A system that extracts linguistic choice features from LLM outputs using NLP pipelines and represents their distribution across repeated samples for comparative analysis.
A visual fingerprint technique that enables distribution-level comparison of condition-specific tendencies in LLM text generation.
idea_ch: 一种通过将LLM响应建模为语言选择（内容、表达、结构）集合并可视化其分布作为视觉指纹的方法，用于跨不同生成条件比较LLM输出。
一种利用NLP管道从LLM输出中提取语言选择特征，并通过多次采样表示其分布以进行对比分析的系统。
一种视觉指纹技术，能够在分布级别上比较不同生成条件下LLM文本生成的条件特定倾向。

title: VibeServe: Can AI Agents Build Bespoke LLM Serving Systems?
summary: For years, we have built LLM serving systems like any other critical infrastructure: a single general-purpose stack, hand-tuned over many engineer-years, meant to support every model and workload. In this paper, we take the opposite bet: a multi-agent loop that automatically synthesizes bespoke serving systems for different usage scenarios. We propose VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end. VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search over system designs, and an inner loop to implement candidates, check correctness, and measure performance on the target benchmark. In the standard deployment setting, where existing stacks are highly optimized, VibeServe remains competitive with vLLM, showing that generation-time specialization need not come at the cost of performance. More interestingly, in non-standard scenarios, VibeServe outperforms existing systems by exploiting opportunities that generic systems miss in six scenarios involving non-standard model architectures, workload knowledge, and hardware-specific optimizations. Together, these results suggest a different point in the design space for infrastructure software: generation-time specialization rather than runtime generality. Code is available at https://github.com/uw-syfi/vibe-serve.

AI.tldr: VibeServe 提出了一个多智能体循环框架，能够自动为不同的使用场景生成定制化的 LLM 服务系统，在标准场景下与 vLLM 性能相当，在非标准场景下通过利用通用系统忽略的优化机会实现更优性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的 LLM 服务系统采用单一通用栈设计，需要大量人工调优来支持各种模型和工作负载。作者认为这种"运行时通用性"的方法存在局限性，尤其是在非标准场景下无法充分利用特定模型架构、工作负载知识和硬件特性的优化机会。
AI.method: VibeServe 采用双循环结构：外层循环用于规划并追踪系统设计的搜索过程，内层循环负责实现候选方案、检查正确性并在目标基准上测量性能。通过这种方式自动搜索和合成最优的服务系统栈。
AI.result: 在标准部署场景中与高度优化的 vLLM 性能相当；在六种非标准场景（包括非标准模型架构、工作负载知识、硬件特定优化）中超越了现有系统。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基础设施软件的新设计思路：生成时特化（generation-time specialization）而非运行时通用性（runtime generality），表明自动化的系统定制化可以在不牺牲标准场景性能的前提下，在特殊场景中获得显著优势。
idea_en: A multi-agent loop system (VibeServe) that automatically synthesizes end-to-end LLM serving stacks tailored to specific usage scenarios

A dual-loop architecture for automated serving system design: outer loop for planning/search tracking and inner loop for candidate implementation, correctness verification, and performance benchmarking

Generation-time specialization approach for infrastructure software that automatically discovers optimization opportunities missed by general-purpose systems in non-standard scenarios (e.g., novel model architectures, workload-specific knowledge, hardware-specific optimizations)
idea_ch: 一种多智能体循环系统(VibeServe)，可自动为特定使用场景合成端到端的LLM服务栈
一种双循环架构用于自动化服务系统设计：外层循环负责规划与搜索追踪，内层循环负责候选实现、正确性验证以及性能基准测试
一种生成时特化的基础设施软件设计方法，能够在非标准场景（如新颖模型架构、工作负载特定知识、硬件特定优化）中自动发现通用系统无法利用的优化机会

title: Safety Certification is Classification
summary: The goal of this paper is certifying safety of dynamical systems subject to uncertainty. Existing approaches use trajectory data to estimate transition probabilities, and compute safety probabilities recursively via dynamic programming (DP). This recursion may lead to compounding errors in the certified safety probability, thus collapsing to a vacuous lower bound for growing horizons $T$. We propose a kernel embedding framework that treats safety certification as a classification problem on trajectory data, directly estimating the $T$-step safety probability without recursion. We show that the framework subsumes well-established approaches from the literature (e.g., barrier certificates, robust Markov models) as special cases, and allows us to go beyond their limitations. As the main consequence, it bypasses compounding error across the horizon and enables certification for systems with non-Markovian dynamics. We demonstrate that direct estimators remain stable independent of the certification horizon and in the non-Markovian setting, whilst DP-based certificates silently go unsound -- confirmed in simulation on a neural-controlled quadrotor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于核嵌入的框架，将安全认证视为轨迹数据的分类问题，直接估计T步安全概率，避免了动态规划递归导致的累积误差，适用于非马尔可夫动力学系统。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过动态规划递归计算安全概率，随着时间窗口T增长，累积误差会导致安全概率下界变得空洞无效。需要一种能避免递归累积误差的安全认证方法。
AI.method: 将安全认证建模为轨迹数据的分类问题，利用核嵌入框架直接估计T步安全概率，无需递归。该框架统一了势垒证书、鲁棒马尔可夫模型等现有方法。
AI.result: 直接估计器在认证时间窗口上保持稳定，不随T增长而退化；在非马尔可夫动力学场景下，DP方法会无声地失效，而所提方法依然可靠。在神经网络控制的四旋翼飞行器仿真中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的核嵌入框架避免了递归累积误差，能处理非马尔可夫动力学系统，为不确定性下的安全认证提供了更可靠的方法。
idea_en: A method for direct estimation of T-step safety probability using kernel embedding to classify trajectory data, bypassing recursive dynamic programming and eliminating compounding errors.
A unified kernel embedding framework that subsumes barrier certificates and robust Markov models as special cases for safety certification.
A safety certification technique that remains stable and sound for non-Markovian dynamical systems, where traditional DP-based methods fail.
A non-recursive safety certification approach for neural-controlled systems (e.g., quadrotors) that maintains reliability regardless of certification horizon length.
idea_ch: 基于核嵌入的T步安全概率直接估计方法：将安全认证转化为轨迹数据的分类问题，直接估计安全概率，避免动态规划递归导致的累积误差。
统一核嵌入安全认证框架：将势垒证书、鲁棒马尔可夫模型等现有方法作为特例纳入统一框架，突破各自局限性。
适用于非马尔可夫动力学的安全认证技术：在系统动力学不满足马尔可夫性时仍能保持可靠的安全概率估计。
基于轨迹分类的神经网络控制系统安全认证方法：针对神经网络控制的四旋翼飞行器等系统，在任意时间窗口内保持认证稳定性。

title: Shallow Prefill, Deep Decoding: Efficient Long-Context Inference via Layer-Asymmetric KV Visibility
summary: Long-context inference in decoder-only language models is costly because long prompts are processed during Prefill, cached at every layer, and repeatedly attended to during autoregressive Decode. We introduce \emph{Shallow Prefill, dEEp Decode} (SPEED), a phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy that materializes non-anchor prompt-token KV states only in lower layers while keeping Decode-phase tokens full-depth. Unlike previous approaches that make upper-layer prompt KV states cheaper to store or construct, SPEED removes prefill tokens from the upper-layer Decode visibility set altogether. With a minimal BoS anchor, this simple change preserves broad benchmark quality while reducing long-context cost. In a controlled Llama-3.1-8B instruction-tuning study, SPEED using only 75\% of layers for prefill tokens reaches 51.2 average score on OLMES-style benchmarks, compared with 51.4 for the full-depth baseline, while improving TTFT by 33\%, TPOT by 22\%, and reducing active KV memory by 25.0\% at 128K context. Layer-wise diagnostics suggest that this cutoff retains the main prompt-selection and representation-stabilization regions of the full-depth model. These results show that long-context prompt tokens need not always persist as full-depth KV-cache objects when Decode-phase tokens remain full-depth.

AI.tldr: SPEED提出了一种非对称KV可见性策略：Prefill阶段仅在低层（75%的层）保留提示词的KV状态，而Decode阶段的token保持全层可见，在不显著降低模型质量的前提下大幅降低长上下文推理的延迟和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 解码器-only语言模型的长上下文推理成本高昂，因为长提示词在Prefill阶段被完整处理、在每层缓存，并在自回归Decode阶段被反复关注。现有方法仅使上层提示KV更便宜，但未从根本上消除其开销。
AI.method: SPEED采用阶段非对称的KV可见性策略：Prefill阶段只将非锚点提示词的KV状态物化在较低层（如全部层的75%），而Decode阶段的token保持全深度可见。只需在BoS位置保留最小锚点，上层的Decode可见集完全排除预填充token。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B指令微调实验中，SPEED仅用75%层处理预填充token，OLMES基准平均得分51.2（基线51.4），同时TTFT降低33%，TPOT降低22%，128K上下文时活跃KV内存减少25.0%。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文提示词token在Decode阶段不必始终保持全深度KV缓存对象，只要Decode阶段的token保持全深度，这种非对称设计就能在保持质量的同时显著降低推理成本。
idea_en: Phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy where prefill tokens are only materialized in lower layers while decode tokens remain full-depth, reducing long-context inference cost.
Minimal BoS (Beginning-of-Sequence) anchor mechanism that preserves upper-layer attention stability without storing full prefill KV states in upper layers.
Adaptive layer-cutoff strategy that automatically determines which layers to keep prefill KV states based on layer-wise importance diagnostics.
idea_ch: 阶段非对称KV可见性策略：Prefill阶段提示词token仅在低层保留KV状态，Decode阶段token保持全深度，大幅降低长上下文推理成本。
最小BoS（序列起始）锚点机制：仅在最上层保留序列起始token的KV状态，无需存储完整预填充KV状态即可维持上层注意力稳定性。
基于逐层重要性诊断的自适应层截断策略：自动确定哪些层需要保留预填充KV状态，动态平衡质量与效率。

title: On Time, Within Budget: Constraint-Driven Online Resource Allocation for Agentic Workflows
summary: Agentic systems increasingly solve complex user requests by executing orchestrated workflows, where subtasks are assigned to specialized models or tools and coordinated according to their dependencies. While recent work improves agent efficiency by optimizing the performance--cost--latency frontier, real deployments often impose concrete requirements: a workflow must be completed within a specified budget and before a specified deadline. This shifts the goal from average efficiency optimization to maximizing the probability that the entire workflow completes successfully under explicit budget and deadline constraints. We study \emph{constraint-driven online resource allocation for agentic workflows}. Given a dependency-structured workflow and estimates of success rates and generation lengths for each subtask--model pair, the executor allocates models and parallel samples across simultaneously executable subtasks while managing the remaining budget and time. We formulate this setting as a finite-horizon stochastic online allocation problem and propose \emph{Monte Carlo Portfolio Planning} (MCPP), a lightweight closed-loop planner that directly estimates constrained completion probability through simulated workflow executions and replans after observed outcomes. Experiments on CodeFlow and ProofFlow demonstrate that MCPP consistently improves constrained completion probability over strong baselines across a wide range of budget--deadline constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对代理系统工作流在预算和截止日期约束下的资源分配问题，提出了一种名为蒙特卡洛组合规划（MCPP）的轻量级闭环规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要优化代理系统的平均效率（性能-成本-延迟折中），但实际部署中常常有明确的预算和截止日期约束。需要从平均效率优化转向在给定约束下最大化整个工作流成功完成的概率。
AI.method: 将问题建模为有限时域随机在线分配问题，提出MCPP方法：通过模拟工作流执行直接估计约束下的完成概率，并在观察到实际结果后进行重规划。
AI.result: 在CodeFlow和ProofFlow上的实验表明，MCPP在广泛的预算-截止日期约束下，始终优于强基线方法，提高了约束完成概率。
AI.conclusion: MCPP是一种有效的约束驱动在线资源分配方法，能够在预算和截止日期约束下最大化代理工作流的成功完成概率。
idea_en: A method for constrained online resource allocation in agentic workflows using Monte Carlo simulations to estimate workflow completion probability under budget and deadline constraints.
A closed-loop replanning mechanism that dynamically adjusts model allocation and parallel sampling across executable subtasks based on observed outcomes and remaining budget/time.
A finite-horizon stochastic online allocation formulation for dependency-structured workflows with heterogeneous subtask-model pairs.
idea_ch: 一种基于蒙特卡洛模拟的代理工作流约束在线资源分配方法，用于在预算和截止日期约束下估计工作流完成概率。
一种闭环重规划机制，根据观察到的实际结果和剩余预算/时间，动态调整可执行子任务的模型分配和并行采样策略。
一种针对依赖结构化工作流且包含异构子任务-模型对的有限时域随机在线分配问题建模方法。

title: CrossCult-KIBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Cultural Knowledge Insertion in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), trained primarily on English-centric data, frequently generate culturally inappropriate or misaligned responses in cross-cultural settings. To mitigate this, we introduce the task of cross-cultural knowledge insertion, which focuses on adapting models to specific cultural contexts while preserving their original behavior in other cultures. To facilitate research in this area, we introduce CrossCult-KIBench, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for assessing both the effectiveness of knowledge insertion and its unintended side effects on non-target cultures. The benchmark includes 9,800 image-grounded cases covering 49 culturally relevant visual scenarios across English, Chinese, and Arabic language-culture groups. It supports evaluation in both single-insert and sequential-insert settings. We also propose Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI) as a baseline method. MCKI retrieves relevant cultural knowledge from an external memory using frozen MLLM representations, prepending matched entries as conditional prompts when applicable. Extensive experiments on CrossCult-KIBench reveal that current approaches struggle to balance effective cultural adaptation with behavioral preservation, highlighting a key challenge in developing culturally-aware MLLMs. Our work thus underscores an important research direction for developing more culturally adaptive and responsible MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨文化知识插入任务，构建CrossCult-KIBench基准（含9800个覆盖49种视觉场景的英/中/阿三语文化案例），并提出MCKI基线方法，利用冻结MLLM表征从外部记忆检索相关文化知识作为条件提示，实验揭示当前方法在文化适应与行为保持间难以平衡。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）主要基于英语中心数据训练，在跨文化场景中常生成文化不恰当或错位的回应，亟需有效方法将特定文化知识注入模型同时保持其他文化行为不变。
AI.method: 提出Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI)：利用冻结的MLLM表征从外部文化知识记忆中检索相关条目，将匹配的文化知识作为条件性提示前缀注入模型输入，支持单次插入和顺序插入两种评估设置。
AI.result: 在CrossCult-KIBench上的实验表明，现有方法在有效文化适应与行为保持之间难以取得平衡，揭示了开发文化感知MLLM的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 跨文化知识插入是开发更具文化适应性和负责任的MLLM的重要研究方向，当前方法在目标文化适应和非目标文化行为保持之间存在显著矛盾。
idea_en: Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI): A method that retrieves relevant cultural knowledge from an external memory using frozen MLLM representations and prepends matched entries as conditional prompts for cross-cultural adaptation.

CrossCult-KIBench: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark with 9,800 image-grounded cases covering 49 culturally relevant visual scenarios across English, Chinese, and Arabic for assessing cross-cultural knowledge insertion effectiveness and side effects.
Single-insert and sequential-insert evaluation framework for systematically testing cultural knowledge insertion in MLLMs while monitoring behavioral preservation on non-target cultures.
External memory-based conditional prompt engineering for culture-specific knowledge injection without modifying MLLM parameters, enabling flexible cultural adaptation.
idea_ch: 记忆条件知识插入（MCKI）：利用冻结的MLLM表征从外部记忆库检索相关文化知识，将匹配条目作为条件提示前缀注入输入，实现跨文化适应的方法。
CrossCult-KIBench：包含9800个图像驱动案例、覆盖英/中/阿三语文化组49种文化视觉场景的综合评估基准，用于评估知识插入效果及对非目标文化的副作用。
单次插入与顺序插入评估框架：系统测试MLLM文化知识插入能力的同时，监测非目标文化行为保持情况的评估方法论。
基于外部记忆的条件提示工程：无需修改MLLM参数即可注入特定文化知识，支持灵活的文化适应切换。

title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Model Routing for Cost-Effective Reasoning
summary: Inference-time computation has greatly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks, but this strategy can incur high inference costs. One solution is to route intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) states to language models of different sizes; however, existing approaches rely on handcrafted routing strategies that limit performance, or on training large process reward models that may be infeasible in many applications. We formulate stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem, which we solve by training a small control policy using reinforcement learning in conjunction with threshold calibration to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff. We validate our method on three math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, and OmniMath) on both open and closed models. Our method consistently improves the accuracy-cost tradeoff compared to handcrafted approaches, while achieving a comparable tradeoff to methods that require training large process reward models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过强化学习训练小型控制策略，对推理过程中的链式思维（CoT）状态进行分步路由，将不同难度的中间状态分配给不同大小的语言模型，从而在保持推理性能的同时降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在推理任务中采用推理时计算虽然提升了性能，但推理成本高昂。现有方法要么依赖手工设计的路由策略（性能受限），要么需要训练大型过程奖励模型（在许多应用中不可行），因此需要一种更高效、实用的解决方案。
AI.method: 将分步模型路由建模为约束决策问题，通过强化学习训练一个小型的控制策略，并结合阈值校准来调节性能与效率的权衡。该策略在推理过程中动态判断每个中间CoT状态应该由哪个大小的模型处理。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500和OmniMath三个数学基准测试上，使用开源和闭源模型进行验证。该方法在准确率-成本权衡上一致优于手工设计的路由策略，并且达到了与需要训练大型过程奖励模型的方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习训练的小型控制策略可以有效替代手工路由和大型过程奖励模型，在推理时实现性能与效率的更好平衡，具有实际部署价值。
idea_en: A reinforcement-learning-based stepwise routing method for chain-of-thought reasoning states, where a small control policy dynamically assigns intermediate reasoning steps to language models of different sizes.
A constrained decision-making formulation for stepwise model routing that optimizes the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff during LLM inference.
A threshold calibration mechanism integrated with reinforcement learning to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff in model routing without requiring large process reward models.
idea_ch: 基于强化学习的分步路由方法，在推理过程中动态将链式思维中间状态分配给不同大小的语言模型，通过小型控制策略实现自适应路由。
将分步模型路由建模为约束决策问题，通过强化学习求解以优化推理准确率与计算成本之间的权衡。
结合强化学习与阈值校准的机制，无需训练大型过程奖励模型即可灵活调节推理性能与效率的平衡点。

title: Back to the Beginning of Heuristic Design: Bridging Code and Knowledge with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced automatic heuristic design (AHD) for combinatorial optimization (CO), where candidate heuristics are iteratively proposed, evaluated, and refined. Most existing approaches search over executable programs and distill insights from execution feedback to guide later iterations. Because this process moves from low-level implementations to high-level principles, we refer to it as a bottom-up paradigm. We argue that this view is incomplete and introduce a complementary top-down perspective: knowledge becomes the primary search object and code merely instantiates and tests it, making what is learned explicit and reusable across problems and trajectories. We formalize this shift through a statistical-learning view that exposes a distortion--compression trade-off, and instantiate it in both population-based and tree-based AHD frameworks. Across CO and tasks beyond it, knowledge-first search improves discovery efficiency, transfer, and generalization, often outperforming code-centric pipelines, while combining both strategies yields further gains. Our results suggest that progress in AHD depends on iteratively constructing and evolving interpretable hypotheses that retain value beyond a single search trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自顶向下的启发式自动设计范式，将知识而非代码作为主要搜索对象，并通过统计学习视角形式化了这种转变，实验表明该范式在组合优化及其他任务上提升了发现效率、迁移能力和泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM驱动的自动启发式设计(AHD)采用自底向上范式（从代码实现提炼高层原则），但这种视角不完整，导致学到的知识难以跨问题迁移和重用，且搜索效率有限。
AI.method: 提出自顶向下的"知识优先搜索"范式：以可解释的知识（如规则、原则）作为主要搜索对象，代码仅用于实例化和测试知识。通过统计学习视角形式化"失真-压缩权衡"，并在基于种群和基于树的AHD框架中实例化该范式。
AI.result: 在组合优化及其他任务上，知识优先搜索相比代码中心方法提升了发现效率、迁移能力和泛化性能；两种范式结合可获得更优效果。
AI.conclusion: AHD的进步依赖于迭代构建和演化可解释的假设，这些假设在单次搜索轨迹之外仍保留价值。
idea_en: A top-down knowledge-first automatic heuristic design (AHD) method where interpretable knowledge (e.g., rules, principles) is the primary search object instead of executable code, with code merely serving as a tool for instantiation and testing.
A statistical-learning framework for AHD that formalizes a distortion-compression trade-off, enabling principled balancing between heuristic accuracy and knowledge abstraction.
A dual-paradigm AHD system combining bottom-up (code-first) and top-down (knowledge-first) strategies in a unified pipeline, achieving complementary benefits in search efficiency and generalization.
idea_ch: 一种自顶向下的知识优先自动启发式设计方法，将可解释的知识（如规则、原则）作为主要搜索对象，代码仅作为实例化和测试的工具。
一种基于统计学习框架的AHD方法，形式化了'失真-压缩权衡'，能够在启发式准确性与知识抽象度之间进行原则性平衡。
一种结合自底向上（代码优先）和自顶向下（知识优先）双范式的统一AHD系统，在搜索效率和泛化能力上实现互补增益。

title: P-Guide: Parameter-Efficient Prior Steering for Single-Pass CFG Inference
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for high-fidelity conditional generation in flow matching, yet it imposes significant computational overhead by requiring dual forward passes at each sampling step. In this work, we address this bottleneck by introducing \textbf{P-Guide}, a framework that achieves high-quality guidance through a single inference pass by modulating only the initial latent state. We further show that, under a first-order approximation, P-Guide is equivalent to CFG in the sense that it steers generation from the prior space, without requiring explicit velocity field extrapolation during sampling. We consider both homoscedastic and \textbf{heteroscedastic} priors, and find that jointly modeling the mean and variance enables adaptive loss attenuation and improved robustness to data uncertainty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that P-Guide reduces inference latency by approximately 50\% while maintaining fidelity and prompt alignment competitive with standard dual-pass CFG baselines.

AI.tldr: P-Guide通过仅调制初始潜在状态实现单次前向传播的Classifier-Free Guidance，在流匹配中减少约50%推理延迟，同时保持与双通道CFG相当的质量。
AI.motivation: CFG在流匹配中需要双前向传播，计算开销大，本文旨在通过单次推理实现高质量引导，解决推理效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出P-Guide框架，通过仅调制初始潜在状态实现单次前向传播的引导；在一阶近似下证明与CFG等效；联合建模均值和方差实现异方差先验的自适应损失衰减。
AI.result: 推理延迟降低约50%，保真度和提示对齐性与标准双通道CFG相当。
AI.conclusion: P-Guide通过单次前向传播替代双通道CFG，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅提升推理效率，异方差建模进一步增强了鲁棒性。
idea_en: A method for single-pass classifier-free guidance in flow matching by modulating only the initial latent state, eliminating the need for dual forward passes at each sampling step.

A framework (P-Guide) that achieves equivalence to standard CFG under first-order approximation by steering generation from the prior space without explicit velocity field extrapolation during sampling.
Joint modeling of mean and variance in heteroscedastic priors for adaptive loss attenuation and improved robustness to data uncertainty in guided generation.
A technique for reducing inference latency by approximately 50% in conditional flow matching while maintaining fidelity and prompt alignment competitive with dual-pass CFG baselines.
idea_ch: 一种通过仅调制初始潜在状态实现流匹配中单次前向传播的Classifier-Free Guidance方法，消除每个采样步骤的双前向传播需求。
P-Guide框架，在一阶近似下实现与标准CFG的等效性，通过从先验空间引导生成，无需在采样过程中进行显式速度场外推。
异方差先验中联合建模均值和方差的技术，实现自适应损失衰减并增强对数据不确定性的鲁棒性。
一种在条件流匹配中降低约50%推理延迟的技术，同时保持与双通道CFG基线相当的保真度和提示对齐性。

title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: A persistent skill library allows language model agents to reuse successful strategies across tasks. Maintaining such a library requires three coupled capabilities. The agent selects a relevant skill, utilizes it during execution, and distills new skills from experience. Existing methods optimize these capabilities in isolation or with separate reward sources, resulting in partial and conflicting evolution. We propose Skill1, a framework that trains a single policy to co-evolve skill selection, utilization, and distillation toward a shared task-outcome objective. The policy generates a query to search the skill library, re-ranks candidates to select one, solves the task conditioned on it, and distills a new skill from the trajectory. All learning derives from a single task-outcome signal. Its low-frequency trend credits selection and its high-frequency variation credits distillation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that Skill1 outperforms prior skill-based and reinforcement learning baselines. Training dynamics confirm the co-evolution of the three capabilities, and ablations show that removing any credit signal degrades the evolution.

AI.tldr: Skill1提出了一种通过单一策略共同演化技能选择、利用和提炼的框架，仅使用任务结果信号驱动三个能力的协同进化，在ALFWorld和WebShop上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法孤立优化技能选择、利用和提炼这三个能力，或使用不同的奖励来源，导致部分和冲突的演化，缺乏统一的协同进化机制。
AI.method: Skill1训练单一策略：生成查询搜索技能库，重排序候选技能并选择一个，在技能条件下解决任务，从轨迹中提炼新技能。所有学习仅来自单一任务结果信号，其中低频趋势用于信用分配选择，高频变化用于信用分配提炼。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，Skill1超越了基于技能和强化学习的基线方法。训练动态证实了三种能力的共同进化，消融实验表明移除任何信用信号都会退化演化效果。
AI.conclusion: 单一任务结果信号可以驱动技能选择、利用和提炼的共同进化，三种能力的协同进化是关键成功因素。
idea_en: A unified single-policy framework for co-evolving skill selection, utilization, and distillation using a shared task-outcome objective
A skill library management method where a policy generates queries and re-ranks candidates for skill selection
A dual-frequency credit assignment mechanism: low-frequency trend for selection credit and high-frequency variation for distillation credit
An end-to-end learnable pipeline integrating skill search, selection, task execution, and skill distillation
idea_ch: 一种基于单一任务结果信号的统一策略框架，实现技能选择、利用和提炼的共同进化
策略生成查询并重排序候选技能的技能库管理方法
双频信用分配机制：低频趋势用于选择信用，高频变化用于提炼信用
集成技能搜索、选择、任务执行和技能提炼的端到端可学习流水线

title: Graphlets as Building Blocks for Structural Vocabulary in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models excel at language, where sentences become tokens, and vision, where images become pixels, because both reduce to discrete symbols on a shared, fixed grid. Knowledge Graphs share the discreteness, but not the geometry. Their entities and relations are discrete symbols, yet their arrangement is relational and lacks a common, fixed grid. Knowledge Graphs (KGs) share the discreteness, but not the geometry. They form irregular, non-Euclidean topologies whose local neighborhoods differ from graph to graph. Therefore, Knowledge Graph Foundation Models (KGFMs) rely on identifying structural invariances to produce transferable representations. Without a universal token set, KGFMs are limited in their ability to transfer representations across unseen KGs. We close this gap by treating graphlets, small connected graphs, as structural tokens that recur in heterogeneous KGs. In this paper, We introduce a model-agnostic framework based on a vocabulary of graphlets that mines a KG between relations via pattern matching. In particular, we considered closed and open 2- and 3-path, and star graphlets, to obtain robust invariances. The framework is evaluated on 51 KGs from a wide range of domains, for zero-shot inductive and transductive link prediction. Experiments show that adding simple graphlets to the vocabulary yields models that outperform prior KGFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于图结构（graphlet）作为结构标记的知识图谱基础模型框架，通过将图let视为类似语言token的结构单元，实现跨异构知识图谱的零样本迁移学习，在51个知识图谱上验证了链接预测性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱与语言/视觉不同，其实体和关系虽为离散符号但排列是关系性的、缺乏固定网格，导致知识图谱基础模型难以跨图谱迁移。现有方法缺乏通用标记集，限制了跨未知KG的表示迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的图结构框架，构建包含封闭/开放2-路径、3-路径和星型图结构的词汇表，通过模式匹配挖掘知识图谱中关系间的图结构，将图let作为可迁移的结构标记。
AI.result: 在51个跨领域知识图谱上的零样本归纳式与直推式链接预测实验中，添加图结构词汇表的模型优于现有知识图谱基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 图结构作为结构标记能够有效捕获异构知识图谱间的结构不变性，解决跨图谱迁移的通用表示问题。
idea_en: A method for constructing a structural token vocabulary for Knowledge Graph Foundation Models by treating graphlets (small connected subgraphs) as discrete structural tokens that recur across heterogeneous KGs, enabling transferable representations.

A model-agnostic framework that mines graphlets between relations via pattern matching, using closed and open 2-path, 3-path, and star graphlets as structural invariances for zero-shot cross-KG transfer.

A graphlet-based tokenization approach for knowledge graphs that converts irregular, non-Euclidean graph topologies into a universal set of structural symbols, analogous to tokens in language models and pixels in vision models.
idea_ch: 一种将图结构（graphlet）作为结构标记的知识图谱基础模型构建方法，通过将小连通子图视为离散的结构标记单元，实现异构知识图谱间的可迁移表示。
一种基于模式匹配的关系间图结构挖掘框架，利用封闭/开放2-路径、3-路径和星型图结构作为结构不变性特征，支持跨知识图谱的零样本迁移学习。
一种知识图谱的图结构标记化方法，将不规则的、非欧几里得图拓扑结构转化为通用结构符号集，类似于语言模型中的token和视觉模型中的像素。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Policy Invariance as a Reliability Test for LLM Safety Judges
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines have become the de facto evaluator for agent safety, yet existing benchmarks treat their verdicts as ground-truth proxies without checking whether the verdicts depend on the agent's behavior or merely on how the evaluation policy happens to be worded. We argue that any trustworthy safety judge must satisfy a basic property we call policy invariance, and we operationalize it as three testable principles: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rubric-threshold invariance under intentional strict-to-lenient shifts, and ambiguity-aware calibration so that verdict instability concentrates on genuinely ambiguous cases. Instantiating these principles as a stress-test protocol with four agent-class judges on trajectories drawn from ASSEBench and R-Judge, we surface a previously unmeasured failure mode: today's judges respond to meaningful normative shifts and to meaningless structural rewrites with comparable strength, and cannot tell the two apart. Content-preserving policy rewrites flip up to 9.1% of verdicts above baseline jitter, and 18-43% of all observed flips occur on unambiguous cases under such rewrites, so existing safety scores conflate what the agent did with how the evaluator was prompted. Beyond the diagnosis, we contribute the Policy Invariance Score and the Judge Card reporting protocol, which expose an order-of-magnitude spread in judge reliability that is invisible to accuracy-only leaderboards. We release the protocol and code so that future agent-safety benchmarks can audit their own evaluators rather than trust them by default.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略不变性"作为LLM安全评判的基本要求，发现现有评估者无法区分智能体行为变化与评估策略表述变化，导致安全评分混乱。作者提出了压力测试协议、策略不变性评分和评判者卡报告来暴露和衡量这一问题。
AI.motivation: 当前的LLM-as-a-Judge评估流程将评判结果视为真实代理，但未验证这些结果是否依赖于智能体行为本身，还是仅仅取决于评估策略的措辞方式。这种混淆导致安全评估不可靠。
AI.method: 1. 提出策略不变性(Policy Invariance)概念，包含三条可测试原则：rubric语义不变性、rubric阈值不变性、模糊感知校准。2. 设计压力测试协议，测试四种agent-class评判者在ASSEBench和R-Judge上的表现。3. 提出策略不变性评分(Policy Invariance Score)和评判者卡报告协议(Judge Card)。
AI.result: 内容保持的策略改写可翻转高达9.1%的裁决（超过基线抖动）；在无争议案例上，18-43%的翻转发生在此类改写下。现有安全评分混淆了智能体行为与评估提示的表述方式。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM安全评判者不满足策略不变性，无法区分有意义的规范变化和无意义的结构改写。需要引入策略不变性评分和评判者卡来暴露评判者可靠性的巨大差异，而传统仅看准确率的排行榜无法揭示这一问题。
idea_en: A method for stress-testing LLM-as-a-Judge safety evaluators using policy invariance principles, comprising three testable criteria: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rubric-threshold invariance under intentional strict-to-lenient shifts, and ambiguity-aware calibration.

A Policy Invariance Score (PIS) metric that quantifies how much a judge's verdicts change under content-preserving policy rewrites versus under meaningful normative shifts, enabling differentiation between agent behavior dependence and evaluation policy wording dependence.

A Judge Card reporting protocol that exposes the reliability profile of a safety evaluator across multiple invariance dimensions, revealing an order-of-magnitude spread in judge reliability invisible to accuracy-only leaderboards.

A method for detecting and quantifying the conflation between agent behavior and evaluation policy wording in safety benchmarks, using controlled policy rewrites that preserve semantic content but change structural formulation.
An ambiguity-aware calibration technique for safety judges that concentrates verdict instability on genuinely ambiguous cases while maintaining stability on unambiguous cases under policy rewrites.
idea_ch: 一种基于策略不变性原理的LLM安全评判者压力测试方法，包含三个可测试准则：认证等价改写下的rubric语义不变性、有意从严到宽改写下的rubric阈值不变性、以及模糊感知校准。
策略不变性评分(PIS)指标，通过量化评判者在内容保持的策略改写与有意义的规范变化下裁决的变化程度，实现对智能体行为依赖与评估策略措辞依赖的有效区分。
评判者卡报告协议，在多维不变性维度上暴露安全评估者的可靠性画像，揭示仅靠准确率排行榜无法发现的量级级评判者可靠性差异。
一种检测和量化安全基准中智能体行为与评估策略措辞混淆的方法，通过控制性策略改写（保留语义内容但改变结构表述）来识别混淆程度。
面向安全评判者的模糊感知校准技术，在策略改写下将裁决不稳定性集中于真正有争议的案例，同时在无争议案例上保持稳定性。

title: Post Reasoning: Improving the Performance of Non-Thinking Models at No Cost
summary: As the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates, token consumption from intermediate reasoning traces increasingly contributes to inference latency and operational cost. Recent studies suggest that many real-world tasks require little to no explicit reasoning, with additional reasoning sometimes even degrading performance. In this work, we propose \textbf{Post-Reasoning}, a simple yet effective approach that improves instruction-tuned models by conditioning them to justify their answers after generating the final response. By design, it enables the final answer to be obtained without additional latency or token cost, while still improving performance through simple instruction augmentation. We evaluate Post-Reasoning across \(117\) model--benchmark settings spanning \(13\) open and proprietary models, \(4\) model families, and \(9\) diverse reasoning and knowledge-intensive benchmarks, including AMC, HMMT, GSM8K, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and BIG-Bench Hard. Post-Reasoning improves performance in over \(88.19\%\) of evaluated settings, achieving a mean relative improvements of \(17.37\%\). Furthermore, we propose supervised post-reason tuning, which further improves performance in over \(91.11\%\) of evaluated settings, and exceeds the prompt-based post-reasoning baseline by an average of \(8.01\%\), demonstrating that post-reasoning can be effectively internalized through training. Ultimately, Post-Reasoning establishes a new performance ceiling for direct-answer capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Post-Reasoning方法，让模型先生成最终答案再提供推理过程，在不增加推理延迟和token成本的同时提升性能。在117个模型-基准测试中88.19%的设置性能提升，平均相对提升17.37%。进一步提出监督式后推理微调，在91.11%设置中超越提示基线，平均提升8.01%。
AI.motivation: LLM在推理过程中产生的中间推理token导致推理延迟和运营成本增加，且许多实际任务不需要显式推理，甚至额外推理有时会降低性能。
AI.method: Post-Reasoning方法：通过指令增强，让模型先输出最终答案，再生成推理过程（理由）。两种实现方式：(1) 基于prompt的post-reasoning，通过简单指令改写实现；(2) 监督式post-reason tuning，通过训练将后推理能力内化到模型中。
AI.result: 覆盖13个开源和商业模型、4个模型家族、9个多样化的推理和知识密集型基准，共117个模型-基准设置。Post-Reasoning在88.19%的设置中提升性能，平均相对提升17.37%。监督式后推理微调在91.11%设置中超过提示基线，平均提升8.01%。
AI.conclusion: Post-Reasoning可以作为一种新的直接回答能力性能上限的方法，通过后置推理机制在零额外延迟和token成本下提升模型性能。
idea_en: Post-Reasoning method that conditions LLMs to generate final answer first, then provide reasoning justification, reducing inference latency and token cost while improving performance.
Supervised post-reason tuning that internalizes the post-reasoning capability through training, further improving performance beyond prompt-based approaches.
Instruction augmentation technique that enables direct-answer capability with post-hoc reasoning without architectural changes to existing LLMs.
Performance evaluation methodology across 117 model-benchmark settings demonstrating consistent improvement through post-reasoning approach.
idea_ch: 后推理(Post-Reasoning)方法：让LLM先生成最终答案，再提供推理理由，在不增加推理延迟和token消耗的前提下提升模型性能。
监督式后推理微调(Supervised post-reason tuning)：通过训练将后推理能力内化到模型中，超越基于prompt的后推理基线方法。
指令增强技术：通过简单修改指令格式，使现有LLM无需架构变化即可实现先答后推的直接答案能力。
后推理在多种模型和基准上的评估方法论：覆盖13个模型、4个模型家族、9个基准的117个设置验证后推理有效性。

title: BioMedArena: An Open-source Toolkit for Building and Evaluating Biomedical Deep Research Agents
summary: Building a deep research agent today is an exercise in glue code: the same backbone evaluated on the same benchmark can report different accuracies in different papers because harness and tool registry all differ, and integrating a new foundation model into a comparable evaluation surface costs weeks of model-specific engineering. We call this the per-paper engineering tax and release BioMedArena, an open-source toolkit that not only alleviates it but also provides an arena for fair comparison of different foundation models when evaluating them as deep-research agents. BioMedArena decouples six layers of biomedical agent evaluation -- benchmark loading, tool exposure, tool selection, execution mode, context management, and scoring -- and exposes 147 biomedical benchmarks and 75 biomedical tools across 9 functional families. Adding a new model, benchmark, or tool reduces to registering a few-line provider adapter. We further provide 6 agent harnesses with 6 context-management strategies, which provide 12 backbones with competitive research capabilities and significantly improved performance, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on 8 representative biomedical benchmarks, with an average lift of +15.03 percentage points over prior SOTA. The toolkit, configurations, and per-task traces are available at https://github.com/AI-in-Health/BioMedArena

AI.tldr: BioMedArena是一个开源工具包，旨在解决深度研究智能体评估中的"每篇论文工程税"问题，它解耦了生物医学智能体评估的六个层次，集成了147个基准和75个工具，支持快速添加新模型、基准或工具，在8个代表性生物医学基准上实现了平均+15.03个百分点的SOTA提升。
AI.motivation: 当前深度研究智能体（deep research agents）的构建和评估存在严重的"胶水代码"问题：同一骨干网络在同一基准上因测试框架和工具注册差异而报告不同准确率；集成新基础模型到可比较的评估环境需要数周的模型特定工程。这种"每篇论文工程税"阻碍了公平比较和快速迭代。
AI.method: BioMedArena将生物医学智能体评估解耦为六个层次：基准加载（benchmark loading）、工具暴露（tool exposure）、工具选择（tool selection）、执行模式（execution mode）、上下文管理（context management）和评分（scoring）。它提供了147个生物医学基准和75个生物医学工具（覆盖9个功能家族），6个智能体框架（agent harnesses）和6种上下文管理策略。添加新模型、基准或工具只需注册几行适配器代码（provider adapter）。
AI.result: 在8个代表性生物医学基准上，采用12个骨干网络（含6种上下文管理策略的6个智能体框架）实现了具有竞争力的研究能力和显著提升的性能，达到了SOTA结果，平均提升幅度为+15.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BioMedArena通过解耦评估层次和提供标准化接口，有效消除了"每篇论文工程税"，为不同基础模型在深度研究智能体任务上的公平比较提供了竞技场（arena），并显著提升了生物医学研究任务的性能。
idea_en: A six-layer decoupled evaluation architecture (benchmark loading, tool exposure, tool selection, execution mode, context management, scoring) for deep research agents that enables modular and fair comparison across different foundation models.

A provider adapter pattern that reduces integration of new foundation models, benchmarks, or tools into an evaluation framework to just registering a few lines of code, eliminating model-specific engineering overhead.
A unified biomedical agent evaluation toolkit integrating 147 benchmarks and 75 tools across 9 functional families, with standardized harnesses and context management strategies.

An arena-based competitive evaluation methodology for deep research agents that uses multiple agent harnesses and context-management strategies simultaneously to achieve SOTA results across diverse biomedical tasks.
idea_ch: 一种面向深度研究智能体的六层解耦评估架构（基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、执行模式、上下文管理、评分），实现不同基础模型间的模块化公平比较。
一种提供者适配器模式，将新基础模型、基准或工具集成到评估框架中简化为仅需注册几行代码，消除了模型特定工程开销。
一个统一的生物医学智能体评估工具包，集成147个基准和75个工具（覆盖9个功能家族），配备标准化框架和上下文管理策略。
一种基于竞技场的深度研究智能体竞争性评估方法，同时使用多个智能体框架和上下文管理策略，在多样化生物医学任务上实现SOTA结果。

title: Rethinking Adapter Placement: A Dominant Adaptation Module Perspective
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that places trainable low-rank adapters into frozen pre-trained models. Recent studies show that using fewer LoRA adapters may still maintain or even improve performance, but existing methods still distribute adapters broadly, leaving where to place a limited number of adapters to maximize performance largely open. To investigate this, we introduce PAGE (Projected Adapter Gradient Energy), a gradient-based sensitivity probe that estimates the initial trainable gradient energy available to each candidate LoRA adapter. Surprisingly, we find that PAGE is highly concentrated on a single shallow FFN down-projection across two model families and four downstream tasks. We term this module the dominant adaptation module and show that its layer index is architecture-dependent but task-stable. Motivated by this finding, we propose DomLoRA, a placement method that places a single adapter at the dominant adaptation module. With only ~0.7% of vanilla LoRA's trainable parameters, DomLoRA outperforms it on average across various downstream tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. This method also improves other LoRA variants, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAGE方法发现LoRA适配器的可训练梯度能量高度集中于单个浅层FFN下投影层（主导适配模块），并据此提出DomLoRA，仅用约0.7%的参数即可超越原始LoRA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现使用更少的LoRA适配器仍可能保持或提升性能，但如何将有限数量的适配器放置在最合适的位置以最大化性能这一问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 提出PAGE（投影适配器梯度能量）作为基于梯度的敏感性探针，用于估计每个候选LoRA适配器的初始可训练梯度能量。基于PAGE发现，提出DomLoRA方法，仅将单个适配器放置于主导适配模块（单个浅层FFN下投影层）。
AI.result: 仅用约0.7%的原始LoRA可训练参数，DomLoRA在指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成、多轮对话等多种下游任务中平均表现优于原始LoRA，并能改进其他LoRA变体。
AI.conclusion: 主导适配模块的位置与架构相关但与任务稳定，可作为实用的适配器放置指南。
idea_en: A gradient-based sensitivity probe (PAGE) for estimating trainable gradient energy of each candidate LoRA adapter to identify the most impactful placement location
A dominant adaptation module selection method that places a single LoRA adapter at the shallow FFN down-projection layer identified by PAGE
A parameter-efficient fine-tuning method (DomLoRA) using ~0.7% of vanilla LoRA's trainable parameters while achieving superior performance across diverse tasks
A task-stable, architecture-dependent guideline for identifying the dominant adaptation module in pre-trained models
idea_ch: 一种基于梯度的敏感性探针（PAGE），用于估计每个候选LoRA适配器的可训练梯度能量，从而识别最具影响力的放置位置
一种主导适配模块选择方法，将单个LoRA适配器放置在PAGE识别的浅层FFN下投影层
一种参数高效微调方法（DomLoRA），仅使用原始LoRA约0.7%的可训练参数，在多种下游任务中实现更优性能
一种任务稳定、架构相关的主导适配模块识别指南，用于指导预训练模型中适配器的放置

title: Event-Causal RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Long Video Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
summary: Recent large vision-language models have achieved strong performance on short- and medium-length video understanding, yet they remain inadequate for ultra-long or even infinite video reasoning, where models must preserve coherent memory over extended durations and infer causal dependencies across temporally distant events. Existing end-to-end video understanding methods are fundamentally limited by the $O(n^2)$ complexity of self-attention, while recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches still suffer from fragmented clip-level memory, weak modeling of temporal and causal structure, and high storage and online inference costs. We present Event-Causal RAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for infinite long-video reasoning. Instead of indexing fixed-length clips, our method segments streaming videos into semantically coherent events and represents each event as a structured State-Event-State (SES) graph, capturing the event together with its surrounding state transitions. These graphs are merged into a global Event Knowledge Graph and stored in a dual-store memory that supports both semantic matching and causal-topological retrieval. On top of this memory, we design a bidirectional retrieval strategy to efficiently identify the most relevant event causal chains and provide them, together with the associated video evidence, to a backbone video foundation model for answer generation. Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Event-Causal RAG，一种轻量级检索增强框架，用于无限长视频推理。该方法将流式视频分割为语义连贯的事件，并用状态-事件-状态（SES）图表示每个事件，合并为全局事件知识图谱，支持语义匹配和因果拓扑检索，有效解决了长视频推理中的O(n²)注意力复杂度和片段级记忆碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型在短/中长度视频理解上表现良好，但在超长甚至无限视频推理中，模型需要在长时间跨度上保持连贯记忆并推断因果依赖关系，现有端到端方法受限于自注意力的O(n²)复杂度，检索增强方法则存在片段级记忆碎片化、时空因果结构建模弱、存储和推理成本高等问题。
AI.method: 1) 将流式视频分割为语义连贯的事件，而非固定长度的片段；2) 每个事件表示为结构化的状态-事件-状态（SES）图，捕获事件及其周围状态转换；3) 将这些图合并为全局事件知识图谱，存储在双存储内存中（支持语义匹配和因果拓扑检索）；4) 设计双向检索策略，高效识别最相关的因果事件链，连同视频证据一起提供给视频基础模型进行答案生成。
AI.result: 在长视频理解基准测试中，Event-Causal RAG在需要多事件整合和跨长时间间隙因果推理的问题上，一致优于强基线（基于片段的检索方法和长上下文视频模型），同时在内存效率和流式性能方面也取得了提升。
AI.conclusion: 以事件为中心的语义分割和因果图结构表示，相较于固定长度片段检索，能更有效地支持长视频中的复杂因果推理，为无限长视频理解提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案。
idea_en: A method for segmenting streaming videos into semantically coherent events rather than fixed-length clips, using event boundary detection based on semantic transitions.
A State-Event-State (SES) graph representation that captures each event together with its surrounding state transitions for structured causal modeling.
A dual-store memory architecture that simultaneously supports semantic matching retrieval and causal-topological retrieval for long-video reasoning.
A bidirectional retrieval strategy that efficiently identifies the most relevant event causal chains from the global Event Knowledge Graph.
A global Event Knowledge Graph constructed by merging individual SES graphs, enabling cross-event causal inference across temporally distant events.
A lightweight retrieval-augmented generation framework that integrates event-causal memory with video foundation models for infinite long-video reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种将流式视频分割为语义连贯事件而非固定长度片段的方法，基于语义转换进行事件边界检测。
一种状态-事件-状态（SES）图表示方法，捕获每个事件及其周围状态转换，用于结构化因果建模。
一种双存储内存架构，同时支持语义匹配检索和因果拓扑检索，用于长视频推理。
一种双向检索策略，从全局事件知识图谱中高效识别最相关的因果事件链。
一种通过合并单个SES图构建的全局事件知识图谱，支持跨时间远距离事件的因果推理。
一种轻量级检索增强生成框架，将事件因果记忆与视频基础模型集成，用于无限长视频推理。

title: OPSD Compresses What RLVR Teaches: A Post-RL Compaction Stage for Reasoning Models
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has recently emerged as an alternative to Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), promising higher accuracy and shorter responses through token-level credit assignment from a self-teacher conditioned on privileged context. However, this promise does not carry over to thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, where reported accuracy gains shrink and sometimes turn negative. We hypothesize that hindsight supervision can specify better token-level alternatives in short thinking-disabled outputs, but in long thinking-enabled traces it more readily identifies redundancy than supplies better replacements. To test this, we applied OPSD separately to correct and incorrect rollout groups, so that compression and correction can be observed in isolation. Our results show that in thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, OPSD behaves most reliably as a compression mechanism rather than a correction mechanism: training only on correct rollouts preserves accuracy while substantially shortening responses, whereas training only on incorrect rollouts damages accuracy. In light of these findings, we propose a revised post-training pipeline for thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning: SFT then RLVR then OPSD.

AI.tldr: OPSD在思考型数学推理中主要作为压缩机制而非校正机制——仅对正确轨迹训练可保持准确率并缩短响应，仅对错误轨迹训练会损害准确率。据此提出SFT→RLVR→OPSD的后训练流水线。
AI.motivation: 研究OPSD在思考型数学推理中效果不佳的原因，探究其是否更像压缩机制而非校正机制。
AI.method: 将OPSD分别应用于正确和错误的rollout组，独立观察压缩和校正效果。
AI.result: OPSD在思考型数学推理中主要作为压缩机制：仅对正确rollout训练可保持准确率并缩短响应；仅对错误rollout训练会损害准确率。
AI.conclusion: 提出改进的后训练流水线：SFT → RLVR → OPSD。
idea_en: A method for post-training language models in mathematical reasoning using a pipeline of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), followed by On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) applied only to correct rollouts to compress response length without sacrificing accuracy.

A technique for isolating compression and correction effects in On-Policy Self-Distillation by separately applying OPSD to correct and incorrect rollout groups, enabling analysis of whether OPSD primarily compresses or corrects in thinking-enabled reasoning tasks.

A system for token-level credit assignment in self-distillation where the self-teacher is conditioned on privileged context (e.g., ground truth answer) to provide hindsight supervision, specifically designed for short thinking-disabled outputs rather than long thinking-enabled traces.
idea_ch: 一种用于数学推理语言模型的后训练方法，采用监督微调(SFT)→可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)→仅对正确轨迹应用在线自蒸馏(OPSD)的流水线，在保持准确率的同时压缩响应长度。
一种通过分别对正确和错误rollout组应用OPSD来隔离在线自蒸馏中压缩与校正效果的技术，用于分析在思考型推理任务中OPSD主要起压缩还是校正作用。
一种基于特权上下文（如真实答案）条件化的自教师进行token级信用分配的在线自蒸馏系统，专门针对短的非思考型输出而非长的思考型轨迹设计。

title: Systematic Evaluation of Large Language Models for Post-Discharge Clinical Action Extraction
summary: The work in this paper evaluates zero-shot and few-shot large language models (LLMs) for safety-critical clinical action extraction using the CLIP discharge-note dataset, with particular emphasis on transitions of care and post-discharge patient safety. To manage the complexity of clinical documentation, we introduce a two-stage extraction framework that decomposes discharge notes, that are written in narrative form, into fine-grained, explicitly actionable clinical tasks through a staged prompting strategy. Our contributions include a systematic assessment of generative LLMs for clinical action extraction, a detailed comparison between general-purpose LLMs and task-specific supervised BERT-based models, and an analysis of annotation inconsistencies across different action categories. We show that contemporary LLMs achieve performance comparable to or exceeding supervised models on binary actionability detection, while supervised baselines retain a meaningful advantage on fine-grained multi-label category classification, despite the absence of task-specific fine-tuning and under strict data-privacy constraints. Qualitative error analysis reveals that many failures stem from misalignment between model reasoning and dataset annotation conventions, particularly in cases involving implicit clinical actions and rigid structural labeling rules. These results indicate that reported performance reflects model limitations due to lack of clinical reasoning, that is not captured by plain annotations. Labels without rationales make it impossible to distinguish clinical reasoning failures from annotation convention mismatches. Advancing clinical NLP requires reasoning-annotated datasets that document why specific spans are actionable, not merely which spans were labeled, enabling proper evaluation of model clinical understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了零样本和少样本大语言模型在安全关键的临床行动提取任务中的表现，提出了一种两阶段提取框架，将叙事性出院小结分解为可执行的临床任务，并发现LLMs在二分类行动检测上可与监督模型媲美，但在细粒度多标签分类上仍不及监督模型。错误分析表明，许多失败源于模型推理与标注规范之间的错位，强调了需要包含推理过程的标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 临床文档中的行动提取对患者安全和护理交接至关重要，但现有方法难以处理叙事性临床文档的复杂性，且缺乏对生成式大语言模型在该任务上的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出两阶段提取框架，通过分阶段提示策略将叙事性出院小结分解为细粒度、可执行的临床任务；系统评估了零样本和少样本LLMs，并与任务特定的监督BERT模型进行了对比。
AI.result: LLMs在二分类行动检测上达到或超过监督模型性能，但在细粒度多标签分类上监督模型仍有显著优势。错误分析揭示模型推理与数据集标注惯例之间的错位是主要失败原因。
AI.conclusion: 当前性能报告反映的是模型缺乏临床推理能力，而非简单的标注问题；需要构建包含推理过程标注的数据集，以区分临床推理失败与标注惯例不匹配。
idea_en: A two-stage extraction framework that decomposes narrative discharge notes into fine-grained, explicitly actionable clinical tasks through a staged prompting strategy.
A method for evaluating zero-shot and few-shot large language models for safety-critical clinical action extraction under strict data-privacy constraints.
A reasoning-annotated dataset that documents why specific clinical spans are actionable, not merely which spans were labeled, enabling proper evaluation of model clinical understanding.
A systematic comparison methodology between general-purpose LLMs and task-specific supervised BERT-based models for clinical action extraction across binary and multi-label classification tasks.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段提取框架，通过分阶段提示策略将叙事性出院小结分解为细粒度的、明确可执行的临床任务。
一种在严格数据隐私约束下评估零样本和少样本大语言模型用于安全关键临床行动提取的方法。
一种包含推理过程标注的数据集，不仅记录哪些临床片段是可行动的，还记录其可行动的原因，从而实现对模型临床理解能力的正确评估。
一种通用LLMs与任务特定监督BERT模型在临床行动提取上的系统对比方法，涵盖二分类和多标签分类任务。

title: The Granularity Axis: A Micro-to-Macro Latent Direction for Social Roles in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are routinely prompted to take on social roles ranging from individuals to institutions, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations encode the granularity of such roles, from micro-level individual experience to macro-level organizational, institutional, or national reasoning. We show that they do. We define a contrast-based Granularity Axis as the difference between mean macro- and micro-role hidden states. In Qwen3-8B, this axis aligns with the principal axis (PC1) of the role representation space at cosine 0.972 and accounts for 52.6% of its variance, indicating that granularity is the dominant geometric axis organizing prompted social roles. We construct 75 social roles across five granularity levels and collect 91,200 role-conditioned responses over shared questions and prompt variants, then extract role-level hidden states and project them onto the axis. Role projections increase monotonically across all five levels, remain stable across layers, prompt variants, endpoint definitions, held-out splits, and score-filtered subsets, and transfer to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The axis is also causally relevant: activation steering along it shifts response granularity in the predicted direction, with Llama moving from 2.00 to 3.17 on a five-point macro scale under positive steering on prompts that admit local responses. The two models differ in controllability, suggesting that steering depends on each model's default operating regime. Overall, our findings suggest that social role granularity is not merely a stylistic surface feature, but a structured, ordered, and causally manipulable latent direction in role-conditioned language model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型（LLMs）的内部表征能够编码社会角色的粒度（从微观个体到宏观机构/国家），并证明粒度是角色表征空间中的主导几何轴，可通过激活干预进行因果操控。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs经常被提示扮演从个人到机构等不同社会角色，但尚不清楚其内部表征是否能编码这些角色的粒度差异（从微观个体经验到宏观组织/国家推理）。本文旨在验证这一假设。
AI.method: 定义基于对比的"粒度轴"（宏观与微观角色隐藏状态均值之差）；构建75个社会角色（5个粒度层级）、收集91,200个角色条件响应；提取角色级隐藏状态投影到轴上，验证单调性、跨层稳定性、跨模型迁移性；通过激活干预（activation steering）验证因果相关性。
AI.result: 粒度轴与角色表征空间的主轴（PC1）高度对齐（余弦0.972），解释52.6%方差；角色投影在5个层级上单调递增；轴在跨层、提示变体、数据集划分等条件下保持稳定；因果干预使Llama模型从2.00提升至3.17（5分宏观量表）。
AI.conclusion: 社会角色粒度不仅是表面的风格特征，而是有结构、有序、可因果操控的潜在方向，且不同模型在可操控性上存在差异。
idea_en: A method for constructing a Granularity Axis in LLM representation space by computing the difference between mean macro-role and micro-role hidden states, enabling quantitative measurement of social role granularity.

A patent for activation steering technique that shifts LLM response granularity along a defined Granularity Axis, allowing controllable adjustment from micro-level individual to macro-level institutional reasoning.

A system for constructing structured social role sets across multiple granularity levels (individual, group, organization, institution, nation) with corresponding role-conditioned prompt-response datasets for training and evaluation.

A method for projecting role-level hidden states onto a learned Granularity Axis and using the projection values as a quantitative metric to assess and compare the granularity level of different model responses.
A cross-model transferable Granularity Axis representation that maintains monotonic granularity ordering across different LLM architectures (Qwen, Llama) without retraining.
idea_ch: 一种通过计算宏观角色与微观角色隐藏状态均值之差构建LLM表征空间中粒度轴的方法，用于定量测量社会角色粒度。
一种沿定义的粒度轴进行激活干预的技术，可因果性地改变LLM响应粒度，实现从微观个体到宏观机构推理的可控调节。
一种构建多粒度层级结构化社会角色集（个体、群体、组织、机构、国家）及对应角色条件提示-响应数据集的系统，用于训练和评估。
一种将角色级隐藏状态投影到学习的粒度轴上，并使用投影值作为定量指标来评估和比较不同模型响应粒度级别的方法。
一种跨模型可迁移的粒度轴表征，能够在不同LLM架构（Qwen、Llama）间保持单调粒度排序而无需重新训练。

title: Towards Annotation-Free Validation of MLLMs: A Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric
summary: Dominant accuracy evaluation might reward unwarranted guessing of Large Language Models, and it might not be applicable to novel tasks for model validation without ground-truth (gt) annotation. Based on basic logic principle, we propose a novel framework to evaluate the vision-language logical consistency of MLLMs on both sufficient and necessary cause-effect relations. We define Vision-Language Logical Consistency Metric (VL-LCM) on traditional MC-VQA tests, and recent NaturalBench tests without the need for gt annotation. Through systematic experiments on representative VL benchmark MMMU and recent VL challenges like NaturalBench, we evaluated 11 recent open-source MLLMs from 4 frontier families. Our findings reveal that, despite significant progress of recent MLLMs on accuracy, logical consistency lags behind significantly. Extensive evaluations on the correlations of VL-LCM with metrics on gt, the reliability of LCM, and the relation of VL-LCM with response distribution justify the validity and applicability of VL-LCM even without gt annotation. Our findings suggest that, beyond accuracy, logical consistency could be employed for both accuracy and reliability. VL-LCM can also be employed for MLLM selection, validation, and reliable answer justification in novel tasks without gt annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需真实标注即可评估多模态大语言模型视觉-语言逻辑一致性的框架VL-LCM，发现当前模型在准确性提升的同时逻辑一致性严重滞后。
AI.motivation: 传统准确率评估会奖励大语言模型的随意猜测，且在没有真实标注的新任务中无法进行模型验证，需要一种不依赖真实标注的逻辑一致性评估方法。
AI.method: 基于基本逻辑原理，定义视觉-语言逻辑一致性度量（VL-LCM），分别应用于传统MC-VQA测试和NaturalBench测试，无需真实标注即可评估充分性和必要性因果关系中的逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 在MMMU和NaturalBench等基准上评估了11个开源MLLMs，发现尽管准确率显著提升，但逻辑一致性严重滞后。VL-LCM与真实标注指标的相关性、LCM的可靠性以及与响应分布的关系验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑一致性可作为准确率之外的另一评估维度，VL-LCM可用于无真实标注的新任务中的模型选择、验证和可靠答案推理。
idea_en: A vision-language logical consistency evaluation framework (VL-LCM) that assesses both sufficient and necessary causal relations without requiring ground-truth annotations.
A metric system decoupling accuracy from logical consistency, enabling identification of models that achieve high accuracy through unwarranted guessing.
A method for model validation on novel tasks without ground-truth annotation using logical consistency as a proxy signal.
An automated logical consistency scoring approach for multi-choice VQA that works across diverse multimodal models and benchmark datasets.
idea_ch: 一种无需真实标注即可评估充分性和必要性因果关系中视觉-语言逻辑一致性的评估框架VL-LCM
将准确率与逻辑一致性解耦的度量系统，可识别通过无根据猜测获得高准确率的模型
利用逻辑一致性作为代理信号，实现无真实标注新任务中的模型验证方法
一种跨多种多模态模型和基准数据集的多选视觉问答自动逻辑一致性评分方法

title: Beyond Fixed Benchmarks and Worst-Case Attacks: Dynamic Boundary Evaluation for Language Models
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) today rests on fixed benchmarks that apply the same set of items to any model, producing ceiling and floor effects that mask capability gaps. We argue that the most informative evaluation signal lies at the boundary, where the per-prompt pass probability is near $0.5$ under random-sampling decoding, and propose Dynamic Boundary Evaluation (DBE), which actively locates each model's boundary and places it on a globally comparable difficulty scale. DBE delivers three artifacts: (i) a calibrated item bank covering safety, capability, and truthfulness, with per-item difficulty labels validated across $9$ reference LLMs; (ii) Skill-Guided Boundary Search (SGBS), a search algorithm that finds boundary items for a given target LLM using only API-level query access; and (iii) an evaluation protocol that places a new LLM on a unified ability scale and grows the evaluation set adaptively when the target falls outside the bank's coverage. We instantiate DBE on four categories spanning safety (harmful request refusal and over-refusal), capability (constrained instruction following), and truthfulness (multi-turn sycophancy resistance). The resulting evaluation covers a broader model spectrum without saturation while remaining compatible with existing datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出动态边界评估（DBE）框架，通过定位LLM的边界能力区域（通过概率接近0.5的提示项）进行更精准的评估，避免固定基准的天花板和地板效应。
AI.motivation: 现有固定基准评估LLM时存在天花板/地板效应，掩盖了模型间真实能力差距；最有效的信息位于模型边界区域（通过概率约0.5处），需主动定位该边界并进行全局可比性校准。
AI.method: 构建三部件：(1) 经9个参考LLM验证的带难度标签的校准题库；(2) 技能引导边界搜索算法(SGBS)，仅通过API查询即可为目标模型定位边界项；(3) 评估协议，将新模型置于统一能力尺度，在题库覆盖不足时自适应扩展。
AI.result: 在安全（有害请求拒绝/过度拒绝）、能力（约束指令遵循）、真实性（多轮谄媚抵抗）四类场景实例化，覆盖更广模型谱系且无饱和，与现有数据集兼容。
AI.conclusion: DBE通过主动定位模型能力边界并统一标尺，提供了更精细、可扩展、无饱和的LLM评估方案。
idea_en: Dynamic Boundary Evaluation (DBE) framework that actively locates the boundary region of an LLM's capability (where per-prompt pass probability is near 0.5) and places it on a globally comparable difficulty scale.
Skill-Guided Boundary Search (SGBS) algorithm that finds boundary-difficulty items for a target LLM using only API-level query access, without requiring internal model parameters.
A calibrated item bank with per-item difficulty labels validated across 9 reference LLMs, enabling standardized difficulty measurement across safety, capability, and truthfulness dimensions.
An adaptive evaluation protocol that grows the evaluation set when the target model's ability falls outside the bank's coverage, ensuring extensibility to new models.
Application of DBE to safety evaluation: distinguishing harmful request refusal from over-refusal by positioning these tasks on the same boundary-based difficulty scale.
Unified ability scale for comparing LLMs across diverse categories (safety, capability, truthfulness) using boundary-relative positioning rather than absolute benchmark scores.
idea_ch: 动态边界评估（DBE）框架：主动定位LLM能力边界区域（通过概率约0.5的提示项），将模型置于全局可比的能力标尺上，避免固定基准的天花板和地板效应。
技能引导边界搜索算法（SGBS）：仅通过API级查询即可为目标模型定位边界难度项目，无需模型内部参数或梯度信息，实现黑盒评估。
跨9个参考LLM验证的校准题库：为每个项目标注难度标签，支持安全、能力、真实性等多维度的标准化难度度量。
自适应扩展评估协议：当目标模型能力超出题库覆盖范围时，自动生长评估集以保持评估的完整性和公平性。
边界定位法在安全评估中的应用创新：将有害请求拒绝和过度拒绝两类任务置于同一边界难度标尺上进行区分评估。
统一能力标尺构建方法：通过边界相对定位而非绝对基准分数，实现跨不同类别（安全、能力、真实性）的LLM能力比较。

title: Joint Consistency: A Unified Test-Time Aggregation Framework via Energy Minimization
summary: This paper studies test-time aggregation, an approach that generates multiple reasoning traces and aggregates them into a final answer. Most existing methods rely on evaluation signals collected from candidate traces in isolation or answer frequencies, while ignoring comparative interactions among candidates. We propose Joint Consistency (JC), formulated as a constrained Ising-type energy minimization problem, where independent evaluation signals act as external fields and pairwise comparisons act as interactions. JC provides a unified framework for test-time aggregation that subsumes existing voting and weighted aggregation methods as special cases. Our construction of the interaction matrix leverages LLM-as-a-judge comparisons, and admits a theoretical interpretation under answer-level homogeneity assumptions. Moreover, we develop an efficient approximation strategy that makes interaction modeling practical for large-scale test-time aggregation. Experiments on math and code reasoning benchmarks show that JC consistently outperforms existing baselines across tasks, judge models, trace budgets, and trace-generation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联合一致性（JC）方法，通过约束伊辛型能量最小化问题统一测试时聚合框架，利用LLM评判的成对比较交互信号，超越传统基于孤立评估或频率的方法，在数学和代码推理任务中持续取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时聚合方法仅依赖候选推理轨迹的孤立评估信号或答案频率，忽略了候选之间的成对比较交互信息，导致聚合质量受限。
AI.method: 将测试时聚合形式化为约束伊辛型能量最小化问题：独立评估信号作为外场，成对比较作为交互作用；利用LLM-as-a-judge构建交互矩阵，并提出高效近似策略使其可规模化应用。
AI.result: 在数学和代码推理基准上，JC方法在多个任务、评判模型、轨迹预算和轨迹生成设置下均持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: JC提供了一个统一的测试时聚合框架，理论证明了投票和加权聚合是其特例，并通过实验验证了成对交互建模的有效性。
idea_en: A constrained Ising-type energy minimization framework (Joint Consistency) for test-time aggregation that unifies independent evaluation signals (external fields) and pairwise comparison signals (interactions).
An interaction matrix construction method leveraging LLM-as-a-judge for pairwise comparisons among reasoning traces, with theoretical interpretation under answer-level homogeneity assumptions.
An efficient approximation strategy that makes pairwise interaction modeling practical for large-scale test-time aggregation scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种基于约束伊辛型能量最小化的联合一致性（Joint Consistency）测试时聚合框架，将独立评估信号视为外场、成对比较信号视为相互作用，统一了投票和加权聚合方法。
一种利用LLM-as-a-judge构建推理轨迹间成对比较交互矩阵的方法，并在答案级同质性假设下提供理论解释。
一种高效近似策略，使得大规模测试时聚合场景中的成对交互建模变得实用可行。

title: Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment for Ambiguous User Queries
summary: Natural-language instance navigation becomes challenging when the initial user request does not uniquely specify the target instance. A practical agent should reduce the user's burden by actively asking only the information needed to distinguish the target from similar distractors, rather than requiring a detailed description upfront. Existing approaches often fall short of this goal: they may stop at the first plausible candidate before sufficiently exploring alternatives, or, even after collecting multiple candidates, ask about the target's attributes derived from individual candidates rather than questions selected to distinguish candidates in the pool. As a result, despite the dialogue, the agent may still fail to distinguish the target from distractors, leading to premature decisions and lengthy user responses. We propose Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment (ProCompNav), a two-stage framework that first constructs a candidate pool and then identifies the target through comparative judgment. At each round, ProCompNav extracts an attribute-value pair that splits the current pool, asks a binary yes/no question, and prunes all inconsistent candidates at once. This reframes disambiguation from open-ended target description to pool-level discriminative questioning, where each question is chosen to narrow the candidate set. On CoIN-Bench, ProCompNav improves Success Rate over interactive baselines with the same minimal input and non-interactive baselines with detailed descriptions, while substantially reducing Response Length. ProCompNav also achieves state-of-the-art Success Rate on TextNav, suggesting that comparative judgment is broadly useful for instance-level navigation among similar distractors.

AI.tldr: 提出ProCompNav框架，通过构建候选池并利用比较判断（分池式二元问答）进行主动实例导航，在减少用户回答长度的同时提升导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在实例导航中要么过早停止于第一个候选目标，要么提出的问题无法有效区分候选池中的干扰项，导致用户仍需提供冗长描述或做出错误决策。需要一种能主动提出最具区分力问题的智能体。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段构建候选池；第二阶段通过比较判断进行主动消歧。每轮提取一个属性-值对来分割当前候选池，询问二元是/否问题，一次剪枝所有不一致的候选目标，将消歧从开放式目标描述重构为池级区分性提问。
AI.result: 在CoIN-Bench上，ProCompNav相比交互式基线和非交互式基线均提升了成功率，并显著减少了回答长度。在TextNav上取得了最先进的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 比较判断方法在相似干扰物环境下的实例级导航中具有广泛适用性，通过主动、高效的提问策略有效降低了用户负担。
idea_en: A two-stage instance navigation framework that first constructs a candidate pool of possible targets, then actively asks binary yes/no questions based on attribute-value pairs that split the current pool to prune multiple inconsistent candidates simultaneously.

A comparative judgment method that reframes instance disambiguation from open-ended target description to pool-level discriminative questioning, where each question is specifically selected to narrow the candidate set.
A proactive questioning mechanism that extracts attribute-value pairs at each round to maximally distinguish the target from similar distractors in the candidate pool, reducing user response length.

A candidate pool pruning technique that uses binary yes/no questions about attribute-value pairs to eliminate all inconsistent candidates in a single step, rather than asking about individual candidates sequentially.
An interactive navigation system that requires only minimal initial user input and actively seeks only the information needed to uniquely identify the target instance.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段实例导航框架，先构建候选目标池，然后基于可分割当前池的属性-值对主动询问二元是/否问题，一次性剪枝多个不一致的候选目标。
一种比较判断方法，将实例消歧从开放式目标描述重构为池级区分性提问，每个问题都专门选择以缩小候选集。
一种主动提问机制，每轮提取能最大程度区分目标与候选池中相似干扰物的属性-值对，降低用户回答长度。
一种候选池剪枝技术，通过关于属性-值对的二元是/否问题，单步消除所有不一致的候选目标，而非顺序询问单个候选目标。
一种交互式导航系统，仅需最少初始用户输入，主动获取唯一标识目标实例所需的信息。

title: A Versatile AI Agent for Rare Disease Diagnosis and Risk Gene Prioritization
summary: Accurate and timely diagnosis is essential for effective treatment, particularly in the context of rare diseases. However, current diagnostic workflows often lead to prolonged assessment times and low accuracy. To address these limitations, we introduce Hygieia, a multi-modal AI agent system designed to support precision disease diagnosis by integrating diverse data sources, including phenotypic features, genetic profiles, and clinical records. Hygieia features a router-based and knowledge-enhanced framework that mitigates hallucination and tailors diagnostic strategies to different disease categories. Notably, it prioritizes risk-related genomic factors for rare diseases and provides confidence scores to assist clinical decision-making. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation demonstrating that Hygieia achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple diagnostic benchmarks. In collaboration with clinical experts from Yale School of Medicine and Duke-NUS Medical School, we further validated its practical utility by showing (1) Hygieia's superior diagnostic performance compared to physicians with an improvement from 12%-60% and (2) its effectiveness in assisting clinicians with medical records for handling real-world cases. Our findings indicate that Hygieia not only enhances diagnostic accuracy and interpretability but also significantly reduces clinician workload, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool in clinical decision support systems.

AI.tldr: Hygieia是一个多模态AI智能体系统，通过整合表型特征、基因图谱和临床记录等多元数据，支持精准疾病诊断，在罕见病诊断中实现SOTA性能，将医生诊断准确率提升12%-60%。
AI.motivation: 当前诊断流程耗时长、准确率低，尤其在罕见病领域问题突出，亟需一种能整合多源数据、减少幻觉、提供可信诊断建议的AI系统。
AI.method: 采用基于路由器和知识增强的框架，整合表型特征、遗传谱和临床记录等多模态数据，针对不同疾病类别定制诊断策略，优先关注罕见病风险相关基因组因素，并提供置信度评分辅助临床决策。
AI.result: 在多个诊断基准上达到SOTA性能，与耶鲁大学医学院和杜克-新加坡国立大学医学院临床专家合作验证：相比医生诊断准确率提升12%-60%，并能有效辅助医生处理真实病例。
AI.conclusion: Hygieia不仅提高了诊断准确率和可解释性，还显著减少了临床医生的工作负担，展示了作为临床决策支持系统的巨大潜力。
idea_en: Multi-modal AI agent system integrating phenotypic features, genetic profiles, and clinical records for precision disease diagnosis
Router-based and knowledge-enhanced framework that mitigates hallucination in diagnostic AI systems
Risk-prioritization mechanism for genomic factors specifically tailored to rare disease diagnosis
Confidence scoring system for AI-assisted clinical decision-making in disease diagnosis
Hierarchical diagnostic strategy customization based on disease categories using a router architecture
idea_ch: 一种基于路由器架构的多模态AI智能体系统，融合表型特征、基因图谱和临床记录用于精准疾病诊断
知识增强和路由选择机制相结合的框架，用于减少AI诊断系统中的幻觉问题
针对罕见病诊断的基因组风险因子优先级排序方法，优先关注高风险相关基因变异
用于辅助临床决策的置信度评分系统，为诊断建议提供可信度量化指标
基于疾病类别的分层诊断策略定制方法，通过路由器架构自动选择最优诊断路径

title: Price of Fairness in Short-Term and Long-Term Algorithmic Selections
comment: The short version of this paper appears in the proceedings of IJCAI-26
summary: Algorithmic decision-making in high-stakes settings can have profound impacts on individuals and populations. While much prior work studies fairness in static settings, recent results show that enforcing static fairness constraints may exacerbate long-run disparities. Motivated by this tension, we study a stylized sequential selection problem in which a decision-maker repeatedly selects individuals, affecting both immediate utility and the population distribution over time.
