We introduce notions of group fairness for both the short and long term and theoretically analyze the trade-off between fairness and utility via the Price of Fairness (PoF). We characterize optimal and fair policies in the short term and show that the PoF can be large even when group distributions are nearly identical. In contrast, we show that long-term disparities can vanish under simple investment policies that achieve a low PoF. We also empirically validate these theoretical observations using both synthetic and real datasets.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了动态环境中算法决策的公平性问题，分析了短期公平约束可能加剧长期不平等，并提出了短期和长期群体公平性概念，通过公平价格(PoF)理论分析公平与效用的权衡，证明了简单投资策略能有效降低长期差异。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性研究大多针对静态环境，但近期研究表明静态公平约束可能加剧长期不平等。作者希望系统性地理解动态决策中短期公平与长期公平之间的张力，以及公平与效用的权衡关系。
AI.method: 构建了一个重复顺序选择问题的数学模型，决策者反复选择个体，影响即时效用和人口分布。定义了短期和长期群体公平性概念，通过公平价格(PoF)理论分析权衡，理论上表征了最优公平策略，并进行了合成数据和真实数据的实证验证。
AI.result: 1) 短期公平约束下，即使群体分布几乎相同，公平价格(PoF)也可能很大；2) 长期来看，采用简单的投资策略可以有效消除群体间差异，且实现较低的PoF；3) 实证结果验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 动态环境下的公平性需要考虑时间维度，短期公平约束可能带来高昂的成本且无法解决长期不平等，而着眼于长期的投资策略能够以较低成本消除群体差异。
idea_en: A sequential selection system with dynamic fairness constraints that evaluates both short-term and long-term group fairness metrics and adjusts selection policies in real-time to prevent exacerbation of disparities over time.

A price-of-fairness (PoF) optimization method for algorithmic decision-making that dynamically calculates the utility cost of fairness constraints and recommends optimal trade-off policies between fairness and utility.

A long-term investment policy for sequential selection that automatically allocates resources to disadvantaged groups over multiple decision cycles to reduce long-term disparities while maintaining low PoF.

A fairness monitoring system for high-stakes algorithmic decisions that continuously tracks short-term and long-term group distribution shifts and triggers corrective actions when disparities exceed thresholds.
idea_ch: 一种动态公平约束的序列选择系统，同时评估短期和长期群体公平指标，实时调整选择策略以防止随时间推移加剧不公平现象。
一种面向算法决策的公平价格(PoF)优化方法，动态计算公平约束的效用成本，并推荐公平与效用之间的最优折衷策略。
一种用于序列选择的长期投资策略，在多个决策周期中自动向弱势群体分配资源，以降低长期差异并保持较低的PoF。
一种面向高风险算法决策的公平监控系统，持续跟踪短期和长期的群体分布变化，当差异超过阈值时触发纠正措施。

title: Safactory: A Scalable Agent Factory for Trustworthy Autonomous Intelligence
summary: As large models evolve from conversational assistants into autonomous agents, challenges increasingly arise from long-horizon decision making, tool use, and real environment interaction. Existing agenticinfrastructure remain fragmented across evaluation, data management, and agent evolution, making it difficult to discover risks systematically and improve models in a continuous closed loop. In this report, we present \textbf{Safactory}, a scalable agent factory for trustworthy autonomous intelligence. Safactory integrates three tightly coupled platforms: a \textbf{Parallel Simulation Platform} for trajectory generation, a \textbf{Trustworthy Data Platform} for trajectory storage and experience extraction, and an \textbf{Autonomous Evolution Platform} for asynchronous reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation. As far as we know, Safactory is the first framework to propose a unified evolutionary pipeline for next-generation trustworthy autonomous intelligence.

AI.tldr: Safactory是一个用于可信自主智能的可扩展智能体工厂，集成了并行仿真、可信数据管理和自主进化三大平台，形成闭环进化管线。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基础设施在评估、数据管理和智能体进化方面碎片化严重，难以系统性地发现风险并持续闭环改进模型。
AI.method: 提出Safactory框架，包含三个紧密耦合的平台：并行仿真平台(轨迹生成)、可信数据平台(轨迹存储与经验提取)、自主进化平台(异步强化学习与策略蒸馏)。
AI.result: 首次提出统一的进化管线用于下一代可信自主智能，实现了从轨迹生成到策略优化的完整闭环。
AI.conclusion: Safactory为构建可信自主智能体提供了系统化的基础设施，有望解决长程决策、工具使用和真实环境交互中的风险发现与模型改进问题。
idea_en: A scalable agent factory system integrating parallel simulation, trustworthy data management, and autonomous evolution platforms for closed-loop trustworthy autonomous intelligence.
An asynchronous reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation mechanism for continuously evolving autonomous agents.
A parallel simulation platform specifically designed for trajectory generation in autonomous agent decision-making scenarios.
A trustworthy data platform for trajectory storage and experience extraction to support agent safety and reliability.
A unified evolutionary pipeline framework that combines evaluation, data management, and agent improvement in a continuous closed loop.
idea_ch: 一种集成并行仿真、可信数据管理和自主进化平台的智能体工厂系统，用于实现闭环可信自主智能。
一种异步强化学习与在策略蒸馏机制，用于自主智能体的持续进化。
一种专为自主智能体决策场景设计的并行仿真轨迹生成平台。
一种用于轨迹存储和经验提取的可信数据平台，支撑智能体的安全性与可靠性。
一种统一进化管线框架，将评估、数据管理和智能体改进整合在持续闭环中。

title: Data Language Models: A New Foundation Model Class for Tabular Data
summary: Every major data modality now has a foundation model that understands it natively: text has language models, images have vision models, audio has audio models. Tabular data, the modality on which many consequential real-world AI decisions are made, does not. Every approach to tabular AI today, from gradient-boosted trees to the latest tabular foundation models, requires a preprocessing pipeline before any model can consume the data. None of them understand tabular data as a modality. We introduce the Data Language Model (DLM), the missing foundation model for tabular data. A DLM understands tables the way a language model understands sentences: natively, without serialization or preprocessing, directly from raw cell values. It is the tabular data layer on which AI models, agents, and vertical AI applications can be built, eliminating the preprocessing pipelines that currently stand between raw data and every AI system that consumes it. We present Schema-1, the first DLM: a 140M parameter model trained on more than 2.3M synthetic and real-world tabular datasets. Schema-1 outperforms gradient-boosted ensembles, AutoML stacks, and the tabular foundation models we evaluate on established row-level prediction benchmarks. On missing value reconstruction it achieves lower reconstruction error than all classical statistical methods and frontier large language models on mean performance across conditions, establishing that structural understanding of a dataset's own distributional geometry is more useful for imputation than world knowledge encoded in language. It identifies the industry sector of any unseen dataset from raw cell values alone, reliably across any domain, a task no prior tabular model can perform. It is the native tabular understanding layer that has been missing from the AI stack.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据语言模型(DLM)和首个实现Schema-1，让表格数据像文本被语言模型理解一样被原生理解，无需预处理管线，在行级预测、缺失值重建和数据集行业识别等任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI模型处理表格数据均需预处理管线（序列化、特征工程等），没有模型能像语言模型理解句子一样原生理解表格数据，这成为AI堆栈中缺失的关键层次。
AI.method: 提出Data Language Model (DLM)架构，直接以原始单元格值作为输入，无需任何预处理或序列化。训练了Schema-1模型（1.4亿参数），在超过230万个合成和真实表格数据集上训练。
AI.result: Schema-1在行级预测上超越梯度提升集成、AutoML堆栈和现有表格基础模型；在缺失值重建上平均误差低于所有经典统计方法和前沿大语言模型；能从原始单元格值识别任意未见数据集的行业领域，这是此前表格模型无法完成的任务。
AI.conclusion: 表格数据终于有了原生理解层DLM，消除了AI系统与原始数据之间的预处理瓶颈，证明对数据集自身分布几何结构的理解比语言模型的世界知识对表格任务更有效。
idea_en: A Data Language Model (DLM) architecture that natively understands tabular data directly from raw cell values without serialization or preprocessing pipelines.
A method for training a DLM on both synthetic and real-world tabular datasets to achieve structural understanding of a dataset's distributional geometry.
A tabular understanding model (Schema-1) that can identify the industry sector of any unseen dataset from raw cell values alone, without any metadata or domain-specific features.

A missing value reconstruction technique for tabular data that leverages dataset-internal distributional geometry rather than external world knowledge, outperforming both classical statistical methods and large language models.
A unified tabular data layer that serves as a foundation for AI models, agents, and vertical AI applications, eliminating the need for separate preprocessing pipelines for each downstream task.
idea_ch: 一种数据语言模型(DLM)架构，直接从原始单元格值原生理解表格数据，无需序列化或预处理管线。
一种在合成和真实表格数据集上训练DLM的方法，使其获得对数据集分布几何结构的结构性理解。
一种能够仅从原始单元格值识别任意未见数据集所属行业领域的表格理解模型(Schema-1)，无需任何元数据或领域特征。
一种利用数据集内部分布几何结构而非外部世界知识的缺失值重建技术，在平均性能上超越经典统计方法和前沿大语言模型。
一种统一的表格数据理解层，作为AI模型、智能体和垂直AI应用的基础，消除每个下游任务需要单独预处理管线的需求。

title: Addressing Labelled Data Scarcity: Taxonomy-Agnostic Annotation of PII Values in HTTP Traffic using LLMs
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE European Symposium on Security and Privacy Workshops (EuroS&PW)
summary: Automated privacy audits of web and mobile applications often analyse outbound HTTP traffic to detect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) leakage. However, existing learning-based detectors typically depend on scarce, manually labelled traffic and are tightly coupled to fixed label taxonomies, limiting transferability across domains and evolving definitions of PII. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can support taxonomy-agnostic annotation of explicitly transmitted PII values in HTTP message bodies when the taxonomy is provided at runtime. We introduce a multi-stage LLM-based pipeline that combines deterministic pre-processing with label-level classification, targeted instance-level value annotation, and output validation. To enable controlled evaluation and exemplar-based prompting without relying on sensitive real-user captures, we further propose an LLM-based generator for synthetic HTTP traffic with manually validated, taxonomy-derived PII annotations. We evaluate the approach across three taxonomies spanning different PII domains and granularity levels. Results show that the pipeline accurately detects PII types and extracts corresponding values for concrete PII taxonomies. Overall, our findings position LLMs as a promising foundation for flexible, taxonomy-agnostic traffic annotation and for creating labelled data under evolving privacy taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的多阶段流水线，用于对HTTP流量中明确传输的个人身份信息（PII）进行与分类无关的自动标注，并设计了合成流量生成器以支持评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的PII检测器依赖稀缺的手动标注流量，且与固定标签分类紧密耦合，难以跨领域迁移和适应PII定义的演变。
AI.method: 提出多阶段LLM流水线：①确定性预处理；②标签级分类；③目标实例级值标注；④输出验证。同时提出基于LLM的合成HTTP流量生成器，用于生成带人工验证的PII标注数据。
AI.result: 在三个不同粒度和领域的PII分类体系上评估，该流水线能够准确检测PII类型并提取对应值。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为灵活、与分类无关的流量标注基础，并可用于在演变的隐私分类体系下创建标注数据。
idea_en: A multi-stage LLM pipeline for taxonomy-agnostic PII annotation in HTTP traffic, combining deterministic preprocessing with LLM-based classification and instance-level value extraction.

An LLM-based synthetic HTTP traffic generator that produces realistic PII-annotated traffic data with manually validated, taxonomy-derived annotations, eliminating the need for sensitive real-user data.
A runtime taxonomy injection mechanism enabling LLM-based PII detectors to adapt to evolving and domain-specific PII definitions without retraining.
A validation module in the pipeline that leverages LLM reasoning to verify extracted PII values against the provided taxonomy, reducing false positives.
A method for exemplar-based prompting using synthetic traffic data to improve LLM performance on PII annotation tasks without exposing real user information.
idea_ch: 一种多阶段LLM流水线，结合确定性预处理与LLM分类及实例级值提取，实现HTTP流量中与分类无关的PII自动标注。
一种基于LLM的合成HTTP流量生成器，可生成带人工验证、分类派生标注的逼真PII流量数据，避免使用敏感真实用户数据。
一种运行时分类体系注入机制，使基于LLM的PII检测器无需重新训练即可适应不断演变的领域特定PII定义。
流水线中的验证模块，利用LLM推理能力根据提供的分类体系验证提取的PII值，减少误报。
一种基于合成流量数据的示范提示方法，在不暴露真实用户信息的前提下提升LLM在PII标注任务上的性能。

title: Measuring Black-Box Confidence via Reasoning Trajectories: Geometry, Coverage, and Verbalization
summary: Reliable confidence estimation enables safe deployment of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning through text-only APIs. Yet the dominant black-box baseline, self-consistency over K samples, is linearly expensive and ignores the geometry of the trace. We propose a black-box trajectory-confidence score: we embed a CoT as a sliding-window trajectory and measure its convergence to external answer anchors with a one-parameter softmax. The method needs no logits, hidden states, or supervised calibrators. Across six (benchmark, reasoner) settings on MedQA-USMLE, GPQA Diamond, and MMLU-Pro with Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6, fusing this score with coverage and verbalized-confidence channels at K=4 yields Pareto improvements over self-consistency at K=8 in 6/6 settings (median AUC 0.78 vs 0.71, deltaAUC=+0.075). A fixed-pick control (+0.060) and E5 cross-embedder replication rule out answer switching and single-vendor artifacts. Geometry peaks in the penultimate window across benchmarks and reasoners, and inverts at the terminal window on GPQA Diamond. Three unscaffolded regimes separate black-box confidence into a judge-mediated Coverage prior (C), within-trace Geometry (G), and a conditional Verbalization channel (V). Across 18 benchmark x reasoner x proposer settings, C and G provide independent signal in 18/18 and 16/18, while V contributes residual signal in 6/18. Swapping the judge from GPT-5-mini to Claude Sonnet 4.6 leaves G-only AUC unchanged (|delta|<=0.013) and shifts C-only AUC by at most +/-0.02 (kappa=0.82). Fusion beats the best single channel in 17/18 settings (median AUC 0.78, max 0.92).

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于轨迹几何的链式思维置信度评分方法，无需模型内部信息，在K=4时即超越自一致性K=8的效果。将CoT嵌入为滑动窗口轨迹，通过软最大化测量其与答案锚点的收敛性，结合覆盖度、几何度和语言化三个置信度通道实现帕累托改进。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒置信度估计方法（如自一致性）计算成本随采样数线性增长，且忽略了推理轨迹本身的几何结构信息。
AI.method: 将CoT嵌入为滑动窗口轨迹序列，用单参数软最大计算轨迹与外部答案锚点的收敛度，融合三种置信度通道：覆盖度（C，基于裁判模型）、几何度（G，轨迹收敛性）、语言化（V，模型自述置信度）。
AI.result: 在MedQA-USMLE、GPQA Diamond、MMLU-Pro上，K=4融合评分优于K=8自一致性（中位AUC 0.78 vs 0.71）。几何度在倒数第二个窗口达到峰值，终端窗口在GPQA Diamond上反转。C和G在18/18和16/18设置中提供独立信号，融合在17/18设置中优于单一通道。
AI.conclusion: 基于轨迹几何的置信度估计是高效且可靠的黑盒替代方案，可显著降低计算成本同时提升置信度估计准确性，且对不同裁判模型具有鲁棒性。
idea_en: A black-box trajectory-confidence scoring method for chain-of-thought reasoning that embeds CoT as a sliding-window trajectory sequence and measures convergence to external answer anchors using a single-parameter softmax function, requiring no logits, hidden states, or supervised calibrators.

A three-channel confidence fusion framework for black-box reasoning systems comprising: a judge-mediated Coverage prior (C), a within-trace Geometry score (G) based on trajectory convergence, and a conditional Verbalization channel (V), with a fusion mechanism that achieves Pareto improvements over single-channel approaches.

A sliding-window trajectory embedding technique for chain-of-thought reasoning paths that captures geometric convergence patterns, with the discovery that geometry peaks in the penultimate window across benchmarks and inverts at the terminal window on specific datasets like GPQA Diamond.

A compute-efficient confidence estimation method that achieves superior performance (AUC 0.78) at K=4 samples compared to self-consistency at K=8 samples (AUC 0.71), reducing computational cost by 50% while improving accuracy.

A judge-agnostic confidence channel architecture where the Geometry-only score remains unchanged (|delta|<=0.013) when swapping judge models between GPT-5-mini and Claude Sonnet 4.6, demonstrating vendor-independent robustness.
idea_ch: 一种黑盒链式思维置信度评分方法，将CoT推理路径嵌入为滑动窗口轨迹序列，通过单参数软最大函数测量轨迹与外部答案锚点的收敛程度，无需logits、隐藏状态或有监督校准器。
三通道黑盒置信度融合框架，包括：基于裁判模型的覆盖度先验（C）、基于轨迹收敛的几何度（G）以及条件语言化通道（V），融合机制在17/18的设置中优于单一通道。
一种滑动窗口轨迹嵌入技术，捕捉链式思维推理路径的几何收敛模式，发现几何度在倒数第二个窗口达到峰值，在特定数据集（如GPQA Diamond）的终端窗口发生反转。
一种计算高效且对裁判模型具有鲁棒性的置信度估计方法，几何度评分在更换裁判模型（GPT-5-mini与Claude Sonnet 4.6）时几乎不变（|delta|<=0.013），覆盖度评分变化不超过+/-0.02。

title: A Regime Theory of Controller Class Selection for LLM Action Decisions
summary: Deployed language and vision-language models must decide, on each input, whether to answer directly, retrieve evidence, defer to a stronger model, or abstain. Contrary to the common monotonicity intuition, greater per-input expressivity is not uniformly beneficial in finite samples: under identical strict cross-validation, different benchmarks prefer different controller classes. This reflects a finite-sample limitation of instance-level uncertainty signals, which can be exhausted at a distribution-dependent scale. We organize controllers into a nested lattice of four classes: fixed actions, partition routers, instance-level controllers, and prior-gated controllers, ordered by complexity. We prove a regime theory that turns three data-estimable bottlenecks into a class choice: how much improvement is possible beyond the best fixed action, whether there are enough samples for instance-level controllers to make reliable decisions, and how much improvement a coarse partition router can recover when instance-level signal is unreliable. The resulting Bernstein-tight threshold has a matching information-theoretic lower bound, and strict nested cross-validation provably selects a near-best class. Across SMS-Spam, HallusionBench, A-OKVQA, and FOLIO, the predicted class matches the empirical winner; the prior-gated controller wins on TextVQA when OCR tokens supply a label-free prediction-time prior. Code is available at https://github.com/Anonymous-Awesome-Submissions/Regime-Theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"机制理论"(Regime Theory)，用于在有/无语言模型部署中选择最优的控制器类别（固定动作、分区路由器、实例级控制器、先验门控控制器），通过三个数据可估计的瓶颈来确定在有限样本下哪种控制器最有效，并证明严格的嵌套交叉验证能选择出近乎最优的类别。
AI.motivation: 在部署语言模型和多模态模型时，系统需要在每个输入上决定是直接回答、检索证据、委托给更强模型还是弃权。然而，更大的每输入表达能力（灵活性）在有限样本下并不总是有益的，不同基准测试偏好不同的控制器类型。需要一种理论来指导在有限样本下如何选择最优的控制器类别。
AI.method: 将控制器组织成四个嵌套类别的格结构：固定动作、分区路由器、实例级控制器、先验门控控制器。提出机制理论，利用三个数据可估计的瓶颈：1) 比最优固定动作能改进多少；2) 实例级控制器是否有足够样本做出可靠决策；3) 当实例级信号不可靠时，粗粒度分区路由器能恢复多少改进。推导出Bernstein紧阈值及其信息论下界，并用严格嵌套交叉验证选择近似最优类别。
AI.result: 在SMS-Spam、HallusionBench、A-OKVQA和FOLIO数据集上，预测的控制器类别与经验最优结果一致。在TextVQA上，当OCR令牌提供无标签的预测时先验时，先验门控控制器获胜。
AI.conclusion: 证明了在有限样本下，实例级不确定性信号存在一个信息极限，该极限取决于数据分布。提出的机制理论能够根据三个可估计的瓶颈指标准确选择最优的控制器类别，为部署语言模型时的决策策略提供了理论指导。
idea_en: A nested lattice classification system for language model controllers (fixed actions, partition routers, instance-level controllers, prior-gated controllers) with provable class selection via nested cross-validation
A regime theory method that uses three data-estimable bottleneck metrics to determine the optimal controller class for language model deployment under finite-sample constraints
A Bernstein-tight threshold method with matching information-theoretic lower bound for selecting controller complexity in deployed language models
A prior-gated controller mechanism that leverages label-free prediction-time priors (e.g., OCR tokens in TextVQA) to improve language model decision-making
idea_ch: 一种嵌套格结构的语言模型控制器分类系统（固定动作、分区路由器、实例级控制器、先验门控控制器），通过嵌套交叉验证实现可证明的类别选择
一种机制理论方法，利用三个数据可估计的瓶颈指标，在有限样本条件下确定语言模型部署中的最优控制器类别
一种Bernstein紧阈值方法及其匹配的信息论下界，用于选择部署语言模型中的控制器复杂度
一种先验门控控制器机制，利用无标签的预测时先验（如TextVQA中的OCR令牌）改进语言模型的决策能力

authors: Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho
title: Mind the Gap? A Distributional Comparison of Real and Synthetic Priors for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models are pre-trained on one of three classes of corpus: curated datasets drawn from benchmark repositories, tables harvested at scale from the web, or synthetic tables sampled from a parametric generative prior. Despite the centrality of pre-training data to model performance, little is known about how these corpora relate to one another in distribution, and the impact this has on downstream performance. In this work we take three canonical, archetypal datasets used to train tabular foundation models; the T4 dataset represents web-scraped corpora, the TabFM dataset curated tables from Kaggle, and the TabICL dataset as the only well-used synthetic prior with publicly available parameters. We characterise each corpus using aggregate features over whole tables, columns and correlations, and compare them using discriminator AUCs and k-NN coverage metrics. We find that the TabICL synthetic prior occupies a narrow region of the space of real tables, that this mismatch cannot be closed by optimising prior hyper-parameters across more than 86 thousand configurations, and that curated and web-scraped corpora are broadly interchangeable on a distributional level in feature space. Surprisingly, the distributional gap between synthetic pre-training data and real tables has a clearly detectable effect on performance under neither feature-based proximity measures or TabICL's own internal representations, suggesting that coverage of the real-data distribution is not the primary driver of TabICL's generalisation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了表格基础模型的三种预训练数据来源（网络爬取、精选数据集、合成数据），发现合成先验（TabICL）仅覆盖真实表格分布的狭窄区域，且无法通过超参数优化弥补，而精选与网络爬取语料在分布上可互换。令人惊讶的是，分布差异对下游性能影响微弱，表明覆盖真实数据分布并非TabICL泛化的主要驱动力。
AI.motivation: 探索表格基础模型预训练数据的分布特性及其对下游性能的影响，揭示不同数据来源之间的关系。
AI.method: 选取三个代表性数据集（T4网络爬取、TabFM精选、TabICL合成），通过表级、列级和相关性聚合特征进行表征，利用判别器AUC和k-NN覆盖度量进行比较，并测试超参数优化效果。
AI.result: TabICL合成先验仅覆盖真实表格的狭窄区域；超参数优化无法弥合分布差距；精选与网络爬取语料在分布上基本可互换；分布差距对下游性能影响微弱。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖真实数据分布并非TabICL泛化的主要驱动力，表格基础模型的数据选择需更关注其他因素。
idea_en: A method for characterizing tabular data distributions using aggregate features across whole tables, columns, and correlations to compare pre-training corpora.
A technique for measuring distributional coverage of synthetic tabular priors using discriminator AUC and k-NN coverage metrics.
A systematic hyperparameter optimization approach over 86k+ configurations to evaluate whether synthetic prior gaps can be closed.
A finding that distributional mismatch between synthetic and real tabular data does not strongly correlate with downstream performance, challenging assumptions about pretraining data selection.
idea_ch: 一种利用表级、列级和相关性聚合特征对表格数据分布进行表征的方法，用于比较不同预训练语料库的分布特性。
一种基于判别器AUC和k-NN覆盖度量的合成表格先验分布覆盖性评估技术。
一种对8.6万+超参数配置进行系统性优化的方法，用于评估合成先验与真实数据分布差距能否被弥合。
发现合成与真实表格数据之间的分布失配与下游性能弱相关，挑战了预训练数据选择需匹配真实数据分布的传统假设。

title: More Than Can Be Said: A Benchmark and Framework for Pre-Question Scientific Ideation
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures; Code is available at https://github.com/Paradoxtcal/InciteResearch.git
summary: AI research agents have shown strong potential in automating literature search and manuscript refinement, yet most assume a clear and actionable initial input, operating only after a research question has been made explicit. In contrast, human research often begins with tacit friction, a sense of misalignment before a question can be formed. We introduce InciteResearch, a multi-agent framework designed to make a researcher's implicit understanding explicit, inspectable, and actionable. InciteResearch decomposes the logical chain of Socratic questioning and distributes it across the entire pipeline that: (1) Elicits a structured five-dimensional researcher profile state anchored by specific friction points from vague, even domain-unrelated inputs; (2) Violates hidden assumptions by maximizing the feasibility-novelty product with enforcing a 7-stage causal derivation trace; and (3) check whether the proposed method is a Necessary consequence of the reframed insight. We further introduce TF-Bench, the first benchmark for tacit-to-explicit research assistance that distinguishes domain-related from domain-unrelated inspirations across four scientific modes. On TF-Bench, InciteResearch achieves leapfrogging gains over a prompt-based baseline (novelty/impact from 3.671/3.806 to 4.250/4.397), shifting generated proposals from recombination to architectural insight. Our work demonstrates that AI can serve as an extension of thinking itself, rather than merely automating downstream execution.

AI.tldr: 提出了InciteResearch多智能体框架，通过苏格拉底式提问链将研究者的隐性知识显性化、可检查、可操作，并引入TF-Bench基准测试，实现从模糊输入到高创新性研究提案的转化。
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究助手假设研究者已有明确可操作的问题输入，而人类研究往往始于"隐性摩擦"（tacit friction）——在问题形成之前的一种不协调感。本文旨在让AI不仅能处理明确问题，还能帮助研究者将模糊、隐性的理解显性化。
AI.method: 提出InciteResearch多智能体框架，包含三个核心步骤：(1)从模糊甚至与领域无关的输入中，引导出结构化的五维研究者画像，锚定特定摩擦点；(2)通过最大化可行性-新颖性乘积并强制执行7阶段因果推演轨迹，违反隐藏假设；(3)检查所提方法是否为重构洞见的必然结果。同时提出TF-Bench基准，区分领域相关与领域无关的灵感来源。
AI.result: 在TF-Bench上，InciteResearch相比基于提示的基线实现了跨越式提升（新颖性从3.671提升至4.250，影响力从3.806提升至4.397），将生成的提案从重组式创新转向架构级洞见。
AI.conclusion: AI可以作为思考本身的延伸，而不仅仅是自动化执行下游任务。该工作证明了AI能够帮助研究者处理研究初期模糊、隐性的认知阶段。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework that decomposes Socratic questioning into a distributed pipeline for making implicit researcher understanding explicit, inspectable, and actionable
A structured five-dimensional researcher profile state elicitation method that anchors on specific friction points from vague or domain-unrelated inputs
A feasibility-novelty product maximization technique with enforced 7-stage causal derivation trace to violate hidden assumptions
A method for checking whether a proposed research method is a Necessary consequence of the reframed insight
The first benchmark (TF-Bench) for tacit-to-explicit research assistance that distinguishes domain-related from domain-unrelated inspirations across four scientific modes
idea_ch: 一种将苏格拉底式提问分解为分布式管道的多智能体框架，用于将研究者隐性理解显性化、可检查化和可操作化
一种基于结构化五维研究者画像状态引导方法，从模糊甚至领域无关的输入中锚定特定摩擦点
一种最大化可行性-新颖性乘积并强制执行7阶段因果推演轨迹的技术，用于违反隐藏假设
一种检查所提研究方法是否为重构洞见之必然结果的方法
首个面向隐性到显性研究辅助的基准测试TF-Bench，能够在四种科学模式下区分领域相关与领域无关的灵感来源

title: Prediction and Empowerment: A Theory of Agency through Bridge Interfaces
comment: This is a working draft: feedback and criticism is most welcome
summary: We study agency under partial observability in deterministic physical or simulated worlds, where apparent randomness arises from uncertainty over initial conditions, fixed law bits, and unrolled exogenous noise. We model sensing and actuation as bridge interfaces split between agent-controlled parameters and environment-controlled channel state, inducing a deterministic POMDP through a prior over latent microstates and many-to-one observation coarsening. Within this framework, we prove a separation between prediction, compression, and empowerment. Perfect prediction can be achieved either by identifying the hidden quotient relevant to the target family or by overwrite control that makes the future target action-determined; high empowerment alone is insufficient. Under refinable interfaces and sufficient memory, action-conditioned observation-compression progress reduces posterior uncertainty about the latent quotient, and when refinement requires steering world-side channel conditions, this creates target-conditioned interface empowerment. A bit-string specialization with a conserved information budget makes the resulting tradeoff explicit: prediction by identification requires internal capacity at least the relevant latent entropy, whereas overwrite control requires terminal action capacity over the controlled quotient. For modern AI agents, the results suggest a design principle rather than a theorem of inevitability: objectives should distinguish hidden-state identification, interface refinement, task-relevant controllability, and mere overwrite or distractor control. Human--AI alignment is partly an interface-design problem, where the relevant bridge is between human intent, agent internal state, external tools, and world-side channel conditions. This is a working draft: feedback and criticism is most welcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了确定性物理/模拟世界中部分可观测条件下的智能体行为，建立了预测、压缩与赋能之间的分离定理，指出完美预测可通过识别隐藏商或覆盖控制实现，而高赋能本身不足。同时提出，人机对齐本质上是接口设计问题。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测的确定性世界中，智能体面临的不确定性源于初始条件、固定律比特和外生噪声的展开。作者希望理清预测、压缩与赋能之间的关系，为现代AI智能体提供设计原则。
AI.method: 将感知和驱动建模为桥接接口，分为智能体控制参数和环境控制信道状态两部分，通过潜在微观态先验和多对一观测粗粒化诱导确定性POMDP。通过比特串特化模型与守恒信息预算分析预测、压缩与赋能间的权衡。
AI.result: 证明了预测与赋能的分离：预测可通过识别隐藏商或覆盖控制实现，高赋能不足以保证预测。识别需要内部容量至少等于相关潜在熵，覆盖控制需要终端动作容量。在可细化接口和足够记忆下，动作条件观测压缩可减少潜在商的后验不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 现代AI智能体的设计应区分隐藏状态识别、接口细化、任务相关可控性与覆盖控制。人机对齐部分是接口设计问题，涉及人类意图、智能体内部状态、外部工具和世界侧信道条件之间的桥接。
idea_en: A bridge interface model that splits sensing/actuation into agent-controlled parameters and environment-controlled channel state for deterministic POMDPs
Prediction-by-identification method achieving perfect prediction via identifying hidden quotient relevant to target family
Overwrite control method achieving prediction by making future target action-determined
Target-conditioned interface empowerment mechanism under refinable interfaces with action-conditioned observation-compression
Bit-string specialization model with conserved information budget for analyzing prediction-compression-empowerment tradeoffs
Interface refinement method requiring steering world-side channel conditions to enable prediction
idea_ch: 一种桥接接口模型，将感知/驱动拆分为智能体控制参数与环境控制信道状态，用于构建确定性POMDP
通过识别目标族相关隐藏商实现完美预测的'识别式预测'方法
通过使未来目标动作确定化实现预测的'覆盖控制'方法
在可细化接口下基于动作条件观测压缩的目标条件接口赋能机制
利用守恒信息预算的比特串特化模型来分析预测-压缩-赋能权衡
一种需要操控世界侧信道条件以实现预测的接口细化方法

title: From Agent Loops to Deterministic Graphs: Execution Lineage for Reproducible AI-Native Work
summary:
Large language model systems are increasingly deployed as agentic workflows that interleave reasoning, tool use, memory, and iterative refinement. These systems are effective at producing answers, but they often rely on implicit conversational state, making it difficult to preserve stable work products, isolate irrelevant updates, or propagate changes through intermediate artifacts.
  We introduce execution lineage: an execution model in which AI-native work is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of artifact-producing computations with explicit dependencies, stable intermediate boundaries, and identity-based replay. The goal is not to make the model a better one-shot writer, but to make evolving AI-generated work maintainable under change.
  We compare execution-lineage replay against loop-centric update baselines on two controlled policy-memo update tasks. In an unrelated-branch update, DAG replay preserved the final memo exactly in all runs, with zero churn and zero unrelated-branch contamination, while loop baselines regenerated the memo and frequently imported unrelated context. In an intermediate-artifact edit, all systems reflected the new constraint in the final memo, but only DAG replay achieved perfect upstream preservation, downstream propagation, unaffected-artifact preservation, and cross-artifact consistency.
  These results show that final answer quality and maintained-state quality are distinct. Strong loop baselines can remain competitive at producing polished final outputs when the task is a bounded synthesis/update problem and all current sources fit in context, but immediate task success can mask partial state inconsistency that may compound over future revisions. Execution lineage provides stronger guarantees about what should change, what should remain stable, and how work evolves across revisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出执行谱系（Execution Lineage）——一种基于DAG的AI工作执行模型，通过显式依赖、稳定中间边界和基于身份的复现，来维持AI生成工作的可维护性和状态一致性，优于传统循环式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent系统依赖隐式对话状态，难以保存稳定工作产物、隔离无关更新以及在中间工件间传播变更，导致状态不一致问题随迭代累积。
AI.method: 将AI原生工作表示为有向无环图（DAG），每个节点是产生工件的计算步骤，具有显式依赖关系和稳定边界；支持基于身份的复现（identity-based replay）。
AI.result: 在无关分支更新任务中，DAG复现零污染、零变动地保留最终备忘录；在中间工件编辑任务中，DAG实现了完美的上游保留、下游传播、无关工件保留和跨工件一致性，而循环基线存在状态不一致。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案质量与维护状态质量是不同维度；执行谱系对变更范围、稳定性和跨版本演化提供了更强保证，是构建可维护AI工作流的关键架构。
idea_en: Execution lineage model: Representing AI-native work as a DAG of artifact-producing computations with explicit dependencies and stable intermediate boundaries.
Identity-based replay mechanism for selectively re-executing only affected nodes in the DAG when updates occur.
Intermediate artifact isolation technique that prevents unrelated-branch contamination during AI workflow updates.
Cross-artifact consistency guarantee method through explicit dependency tracking in AI generation pipelines.
Upstream preservation and downstream propagation system for atomic edits in AI-generated multi-artifact workflows.
idea_ch: 执行谱系模型：将AI原生工作表示为产生工件的计算节点的有向无环图，具有显式依赖和稳定中间边界。
基于身份的复现机制：当发生更新时，仅选择性重新执行DAG中受影响的节点。
中间工件隔离技术：在AI工作流更新过程中防止无关分支污染。
通过显式依赖追踪实现AI生成管线中的跨工件一致性保证方法。
AI生成多工件工作流中原子编辑的上游保留与下游传播系统。

title: Debiased Multimodal Personality Understanding through Dual Causal Intervention
summary: Multimodalpersonalityunderstandingplaysacriticalroleinhuman centered artificial intelligence. Previous work mainly focus on learn-ing rich multimodal representations for video personality under standing. However, they often suffer from potential harm caused by subject bias (e.g., observable age and unobservable mental states), as subjects originate from diverse demographic backgrounds. Learn ing such spurious associations between multimodal features and traits may lead to unfair personality understanding. In this work, weconstruct aStructural Causal Model (SCM)toanalyze theimpact of these biases from a causal perspective, and propose a novel Dual Causal Adjustment Network (DCAN) to mitigate the interference of subject attributes on personality understanding. Specifically, we design a Back-door Adjustment Causal Learning (BACL) module to block spurious correlations from observable demographic factors via a prototype-based confounder dictionary, and subsequently ap ply a Front-door Adjustment Causal Learning (FACL) module to ad dress latent and unobservable biases throughalearnedmediatordic tionary intervention, thereby achieving causal disentanglement of representations for deconfounded reasoning. Importantly, we con struct a Demographic-annotated Multimodal Student Personality (DMSP) dataset to support the analysis and discussion of fairness related factors. Extensive experiments on the benchmark dataset CFI-V2 and our DMSPdataset demonstrate that DCAN consistently improves prediction accuracy, reaching 92.11% and 92.90%, respec tively. Meanwhile, the improvementsinthefairnessmetricsofequal opportunity and demographic parity are 6.57% and 7.97% on CFI-V2, and 15.38% and 20.06% on the DMSP dataset. Our code and DMSP dataset are available at https://github.com/Sabrina-han/DCAN

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双因果调整网络（DCAN），通过结构因果模型分析并消除多模态个性理解中的主体偏差（如年龄、心理状态等），实现去混淆推理，在公平性和准确性上均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 以往多模态个性理解工作主要关注丰富表征学习，但忽略了来自不同人口统计学背景的主体偏差（如可观察的年龄和不可观察的心理状态）导致的虚假关联，造成不公平的个性理解。
AI.method: 构建结构因果模型（SCM）分析偏差影响；提出双因果调整网络（DCAN），包含：1) 后门调整因果学习（BACL）模块，通过基于原型的混淆词典阻断可观察人口因素的虚假关联；2) 前门调整因果学习（FACL）模块，通过学习中介词典干预解决潜在不可观察偏差，实现表征的因果解耦和去混淆推理。
AI.result: 在CFI-V2和自建DMSP数据集上分别达到92.11%和92.90%的预测准确率；公平性指标中，等机会和人口统计奇偶性在CFI-V2上提升6.57%和7.97%，在DMSP上提升15.38%和20.06%。
AI.conclusion: DCAN通过因果调整有效缓解了主体偏差对多模态个性理解的干扰，在提高预测精度的同时显著改善了公平性。
idea_en: A Dual Causal Adjustment Network (DCAN) for multimodal personality understanding that uses back-door adjustment via a prototype-based confounder dictionary to block spurious correlations from observable demographic factors
A front-door adjustment causal learning module that addresses latent and unobservable biases through a learned mediator dictionary intervention for causal disentanglement of representations
A Structural Causal Model (SCM) framework specifically designed to analyze the impact of subject biases (observable age and unobservable mental states) on personality understanding tasks
A Demographic-annotated Multimodal Student Personality (DMSP) dataset that supports fairness analysis in personality understanding
idea_ch: 一种双因果调整网络（DCAN），通过基于原型的混淆词典进行后门调整，阻断可观察人口统计因素的虚假关联，用于多模态个性理解
一种前门调整因果学习模块，通过学习中介词典干预解决潜在不可观察偏差，实现表征的因果解耦
一种专门用于分析主体偏差（可观察年龄和不可观察心理状态）对个性理解任务影响的结构因果模型（SCM）框架
一种支持个性理解公平性分析的人口统计注释多模态学生个性（DMSP）数据集

title: Rethinking Vacuity for OOD Detection in Evidential Deep Learning
summary: Vacuity, or Uncertainty Mass (UM), is commonly used as a metric to evaluate Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL). It generally involves dividing the number of classes ($K$) by the total strength of belief ($S$) of the model's predictions, where $S$ is derived from summing the Dirichlet parameters. As such, UM is sensitive to the cardinality of $K$. In particular, it is unlikely in practice that there is a linear relationship between $K$ and $S$ as $K$ and $S$ increase due to the nature of EDL (suppressing incorrectly assigned evidence). As a result, when comparing In Distribution (ID) and OOD results, it is important that $K_{\mathrm{ID}}$ and $K_{\mathrm{OOD}}$ are equal; something that is not always ensured in practice. We provide an empirical demonstration of how results for AUROC and AUPR can substantially differ when class cardinality between ID and OOD differs by 1, with AUROC differing by as much as 0.318 and AUPR by 0.613 for standard EDL, and AUROC by 0.360 and AUPR by 0.683 for IB-EDL. More concretely, our findings isolate an evaluation artefact: when K differs between ID and OOD, AUROC/AUPR can be artificially inflated without any change in model predictions. We further discuss the evaluation of EDL over causal language models using Multiple-Choice Question-Answer (MCQA) datasets and argue for clearer definitions of ID and OOD in this context. Our primary contribution is an empirical and theoretical demonstration that vacuity-based OOD detection in EDL-fine-tuned LLMs is highly sensitive to uncontrolled differences in evaluated class cardinality.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于不确定性质量（Vacuity/UM）的OOD检测方法在证据深度学习（EDL）中对类别数量K高度敏感。当训练与测试的类别数不同时，AUROC和AUPR指标会被人为夸大，最大差异可达0.683。这一现象在EDL微调的大语言模型中同样存在。
AI.motivation: 现有EDL方法使用不确定性质量（UM）进行OOD检测，但UM指标严重依赖类别数K。在实践中，K_ID和K_OOD往往不相等，导致评估结果被扭曲，需要深入研究这一评估伪影。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和实证实验，对比标准EDL和IB-EDL在不同K值下的AUROC/AUPR差异；在因果语言模型的MCQA任务上进一步验证该问题。
AI.result: 当ID与OOD的类别数相差1时，标准EDL的AUROC差异可达0.318，AUPR差异可达0.613；IB-EDL的AUROC差异可达0.360，AUPR差异可达0.683。该差异是评估伪影，与模型预测无关。
AI.conclusion: 基于Vacuity的OOD检测方法对类别数K的差异高度敏感，评估时需确保K_ID与K_OOD相等；同时在LLM的MCQA场景中需明确定义ID与OOD。
idea_en: A method for out-of-distribution detection that normalizes uncertainty mass by a data-dependent calibration factor to eliminate sensitivity to class cardinality differences between training and testing sets.

An evidential deep learning system with adaptive Dirichlet strength scaling that automatically adjusts the total strength of belief S based on the effective number of classes encountered during inference.
A robust evaluation framework for OOD detection that measures the artificial inflation effect caused by class cardinality mismatch and corrects AUROC/AUPR scores accordingly.
A causal language model fine-tuning method that enforces class cardinality consistency between in-distribution and out-of-distribution sets during multiple-choice question answering tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于数据依赖校准因子的不确定性质量归一化方法，消除训练集与测试集类别数差异对OOD检测的影响
一种自适应狄利克雷强度缩放的证据深度学习系统，根据推理时有效类别数自动调整总信念强度S
一种OOD检测鲁棒评估框架，可测量由类别数不匹配引起的人为膨胀效应并校正AUROC/AUPR分数
一种因果语言模型微调方法，在多项选择问答任务中强制保持分布内与分布外集合的类别数一致性

title: Automated alignment is harder than you think
summary: A leading proposal for aligning artificial superintelligence (ASI) is to use AI agents to automate an increasing fraction of alignment research as capabilities improve. We argue that, even when research agents are not scheming to deliberately sabotage alignment work, this plan could produce compelling but catastrophically misleading safety assessments resulting in the unintentional deployment of misaligned AI. This could happen because alignment research involves many hard-to-supervise fuzzy tasks (tasks without clear evaluation criteria, for which human judgement is systematically flawed). Consequently, research outputs will contain systematic, undetected errors, and even correct outputs could be incorrectly aggregated into overconfident safety assessments. This problem is likely to be worse for automated alignment research than for human-generated alignment research for several reasons: 1) optimisation pressure means agent-generated mistakes are concentrated among those that human reviewers are least likely to catch; 2) agents are likely to produce errors that do not resemble human mistakes; 3) AI-generated alignment solutions may involve arguments humans cannot evaluate; and 4) shared weights, data and training processes may make AI outputs more correlated than human equivalents. Therefore, agents must be trained to reliably perform hard-to-supervise fuzzy tasks. Generalisation and scalable oversight are the leading candidates for achieving this but both face novel challenges in the context of automated alignment.
